4.5.17.i.s: uttānāyai jāghanyai devānāṃ patnībhyo 'vadyati nīcyā agnaye gṛhapataye /
4.5.17.i.d: उत्तानायै जाघन्यै देवानां पत्नीभ्यो ऽवद्यति नीच्या अग्नये गृहपतये ।
4.5.17.i.m: From the tail-portion turned upwards he cuts off [portions] for the wives of the gods; from it turned downwards, for Agni householder.

4.5.17.j.s: uttānāyai jāghanyai hotra iḍām ādadhāti nīcyā agnīdhe ṣaḍavattam̐ saṃpādayati /
4.5.17.j.d: उत्तानायै जाघन्यै होत्र इडाम् आदधाति नीच्या अग्नीधे षडवत्तम्̐ संपादयति ।
4.5.17.j.m: From the tail-portion turned upwards he places the iḍā for the hotṛ; from it turned downwards, he makes up the six portions for the agnīdh.

4.5.17.k.s: prāśitāyāṃ jāghanīśeṣaṃ patny adhvaryave dadāti bāhum̐ śamitre /
4.5.17.k.d: प्राशितायां जाघनीशेषं पत्न्य् अध्वर्यवे ददाति बाहुम्̐ शमित्रे ।
4.5.17.k.m: When it has been consumed, the sacrificer's wife gives the remainder of the tail-portion to the adhvaryu, and the arm to the slaughterer.

4.5.17.l.s: tam̐ sa brāhmaṇāya dadāti yady abrāhmaṇo bhavati /
4.5.17.l.d: तम्̐ स ब्राह्मणाय ददाति यद्य् अब्राह्मणो भवति ।
4.5.17.l.m: He gives it to a brāhmaṇa if he is not a brāhmaṇa.

4.5.17.m.s: yajña yajñaṃ gaccha \ yajñapatiṃ gaccha \\ iti juhvāhavanīye 'dhvaryus trīṇi samiṣṭayajūm̐ṣi juhoti /
4.5.17.m.d: यज्ञ यज्ञं गच्छ \ यज्ञपतिं गच्छ \\ इति जुह्वाहवनीये ऽध्वर्युस् त्रीणि समिष्टयजूम्̐षि जुहोति ।
4.5.17.m.m: With: "O sacrifice, go to the sacrifice; go to the lord of the sacrifice," the adhvaryu offers the three samiṣṭayajus offerings into the āhavanīya fire with the juhū.

4.5.17.o.s: asam̐spṛśan hṛtvā śug asi \ tam abhiśoca \\ iti śuṣkasya cārdrasya ca saṃdhāv udvāsayati /
4.5.17.o.d: असम्̐स्पृशन् हृत्वा शुग् असि \ तम् अभिशोच \\ इति शुष्कस्य चार्द्रस्य च संधाव् उद्वासयति ।
4.5.17.o.m: Carrying it without touching [the ground], he deposits it at the junction of the dry and the wet with: "You are heat; burn him [whom we hate]."

4.5.17.p.m: And where it is wet, [water] is poured down there.

4.5.17.q.m: They revere [the spit] with: "From abode to abode..."

4.5.17.r.m: They purify themselves with: "May [the waters] be friendly to us..."

4.5.17.s.d: एधो ऽस्य् एधिषीमहि \\ इत्य् आहवनीये समिधो ऽभ्यादधति ।
4.5.17.s.m: They put sticks of firewood on the āhavanīya fire with: "You are kindling; may we thrive."

4.5.17.t.s: apo anvacāriṣam ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhanta evaṃ patnī gārhapatye 'bhyādhāyopatiṣṭhate /
4.5.17.t.d: अपो अन्वचारिषम् इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्त एवं पत्नी गार्हपत्ये ऽभ्याधायोपतिष्ठते ।
4.5.17.t.m: They revere the āhavanīya fire with: "I have followed the waters..."; likewise the sacrificer's wife, having put [a stick of firewood] on the gārhapatya fire, reveres [it].

4.5.17.u.m: This is the rule for all animal sacrifices.

4.5.17.v.m: The animal is a modification of the morning milking, because of the similarity of time.

4.5.17.x.m: In the case of the offerings to Agni and to Indrāgni, and in their modifications, this [procedure] is unmodified.

4.5.17.y.s: agnīṣomīye tad vikāreṣu cāśvavālaḥ prastara aikṣavī tiraścī kārṣmaryamayāḥ paridhayo 'dhikāḥ pautudāravebhyas \\ amuṣmā amuṣya vapāyā medasaḥ preṣya \\ amuṣmai puroḍāśasya preṣya \\ amuṣmā amuṣya haviṣaḥ preṣya \\ iti paśor daivate saṃpreṣyati /
4.5.17.y.d: अग्नीषोमीये तद् विकारेषु चाश्ववालः प्रस्तर ऐक्षवी तिरश्ची कार्ष्मर्यमयाः परिधयो ऽधिकाः पौतुदारवेभ्यस् \\ अमुष्मा अमुष्य वपाया मेदसः प्रेष्य \\ अमुष्मै पुरोडाशस्य प्रेष्य \\ अमुष्मा अमुष्य हविषः प्रेष्य \\ इति पशोर् दैवते संप्रेष्यति ।
4.5.17.y.m: In the offering to Agni-Soma and in its modifications, a strew of horse-tail grass, a transverse piece made of reed, and enclosure sticks made of kārṣmarya wood are used in addition to those of pūtudāru wood; he gives the directions for the deity of the animal: "Prompt for the omentum and fat of such-and-such [animal] for such-and-such [deity]"; "Prompt for the sacrificial cake for such-and-such [deity]"; "Prompt for the sacrificial oblation of such-and-such [animal] for such-and-such [deity]."

4.5.17.z.s: aindre sārasvatyāṃ tadvikāreṣu ca dārśapūrṇamāsikaḥ pracaraṇakalpaḥ pracaraṇakalpaḥ //
4.5.17.z.d: ऐन्द्रे सारस्वत्यां तद्विकारेषु च दार्शपूर्णमासिकः प्रचरणकल्पः प्रचरणकल्पः ॥
4.5.17.z.m: In the offering to Indra, that to Sarasvatī, and in their modifications, the procedure is that of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices, the procedure is that of the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

5.1.1.a.m: Imperishable indeed is the merit of the performer of the Four-Month sacrifices.

5.1.1.b.s: tāny ālabhamānaḥ phālgunyāṃ paurṇamāsyāṃ caitryāṃ vā pūrvasya parvaṇa aupavasthye 'hani pañcahotāraṃ manasānudrutya sagraham̐ hutvānvārambhaṇīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati vaiśvānaraṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ pārjanyaṃ carum /
5.1.1.b.d: तान्य् आलभमानः फाल्गुन्यां पौर्णमास्यां चैत्र्यां वा पूर्वस्य पर्वण औपवस्थ्ये ऽहनि पञ्चहोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य सग्रहम्̐ हुत्वान्वारम्भणीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति वैश्वानरं द्वादशकपालं पार्जन्यं चरुम् ।
5.1.1.b.m: Undertaking them on the Full Moon day of the month of Phālguna or Caitra, on the day of fasting of the preceding lunar fortnight, having recited the Pañcahotṛ formula mentally and having offered it with the cup, he pours out the initiatory sacrifice: a sacrificial cake on twelve potsherds for Vaiśvānara and a mess of boiled rice for Parjanya.

5.1.1.c.m: He sacrifices with the Vaiśvadeva on ground sloping to the east,

5.1.1.d.m: either after moving away [to another site] or without moving away.

5.1.1.e.m: Having brought forward the fire according to the ritual procedure of the fire,

5.1.1.f.m: having placed a tuft of wool in the fire-place and firmly established the fire,

5.1.1.g.s: agnīn anvādhāyāmikṣāyai vaiśvadevyai sāyaṃdohāya vatsān apākaroti /
5.1.1.g.d: अग्नीन् अन्वाधायामिक्षायै वैश्वदेव्यै सायंदोहाय वत्सान् अपाकरोति ।
5.1.1.g.m: having fueled the fires, he separates the calves for the evening milking for the curd-clot intended for the Viśvedevas.

5.1.1.i.s: prasūnaṃ barhis trīn kalāpān saṃnahyaukadhyaṃ punaḥ saṃnahyati /
5.1.1.i.d: प्रसूनं बर्हिस् त्रीन् कलापान् संनह्यौकध्यं पुनः संनह्यति ।
5.1.1.i.m: Having bound the flowering sacred grass into three bundles, he binds it again into a single bundle.

5.1.1.k.m: The ritual rule applies to the re-binding.

5.1.1.l.s: pātrasam̐sādanakāle yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti juhūṃ dve copabhṛtau pṛṣadājyadhānīṃ dvitīyāṃ dhruvāṃ dve ājyasthālyau dadhidhānīṃ dvitīyāṃ pālāśaṃ vājinapātram̐ srucaṃ camasaṃ vā /
5.1.1.l.d: पात्रसम्̐सादनकाले यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति जुहूं द्वे चोपभृतौ पृषदाज्यधानीं द्वितीयां ध्रुवां द्वे आज्यस्थाल्यौ दधिधानीं द्वितीयां पालाशं वाजिनपात्रम्̐ स्रुचं चमसं वा ।
5.1.1.l.m: At the time of setting down the vessels, he prepares the vessels according to need: a juhū, two upabhṛts, the second being the container for speckled butter, a dhruvā, two clarified butter pots, the second being the curd container, and a cup or offering spoon made of palāśa wood for the whey.

5.1.1.m.s: nirvapaṇakāla āgneyam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati saumyaṃ carum̐ sāvitraṃ dvādaśakapālam̐ sārasvataṃ caruṃ pauṣṇaṃ carum etāni pañca saṃcarāṇi /
5.1.1.m.d: निर्वपणकाल आग्नेयम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति सौम्यं चरुम्̐ सावित्रं द्वादशकपालम्̐ सारस्वतं चरुं पौष्णं चरुम् एतानि पञ्च संचराणि ।
5.1.1.m.m: At the time of pouring out the oblations, he pours out: a sacrificial cake on eight potsherds for Agni, a mess of boiled rice for Soma, one on twelve potsherds for Savitṛ, a mess of boiled rice for Sarasvatī, and a mess of boiled rice for Pūṣan; these are the five common offerings.

5.1.1.n.s: mārutam̐ saptakapālaṃ vaiśvadevīm āmikṣāṃ dyāvāpṛthivyam ekakapālam uttareṣu parvasu sāvitram aṣṭākapālam eke samāmananti /
5.1.1.n.d: मारुतम्̐ सप्तकपालं वैश्वदेवीम् आमिक्षां द्यावापृथिव्यम् एककपालम् उत्तरेषु पर्वसु सावित्रम् अष्टाकपालम् एके समामनन्ति ।
5.1.1.n.m: [Also] one on seven potsherds for the Maruts, curd-clot for the Viśvedevas, and one on one potsherd for Dyāvāpṛthivī; in the subsequent seasonal sacrifices, some teachers prescribe a sacrificial cake on eight potsherds for Savitṛ.

5.1.1.o.s: triṣphalīkṛteṣu vibhāgamantreṇa pauṣṇam apacchidya saha puroḍāśyaiḥ pinaṣṭi /
5.1.1.o.d: त्रिष्फलीकृतेषु विभागमन्त्रेण पौष्णम् अपच्छिद्य सह पुरोडाश्यैः पिनष्टि ।
5.1.1.o.m: When the grains have been unhusked three times, having separated the portion for Pūṣan with the division mantra, he crushes it together with the substances for the sacrificial cakes.

5.1.1.p.s: prātardohasyāvṛtā prātardohaṃ dohayati tapte prātardohe sāyaṃdoham ānayaty āmikṣāṃ karoti sam̐hatām anyasmin pātra uddhṛtya vājinenopasicya prajñātāṃ nidhāyotkare vājinaśeṣaṃ nidadhāti //
5.1.1.p.d: प्रातर्दोहस्यावृता प्रातर्दोहं दोहयति तप्ते प्रातर्दोहे सायंदोहम् आनयत्य् आमिक्षां करोति सम्̐हताम् अन्यस्मिन् पात्र उद्धृत्य वाजिनेनोपसिच्य प्रज्ञातां निधायोत्करे वाजिनशेषं निदधाति ॥
5.1.1.p.m: He milks the morning milking according to the ritual procedure of the morning milking; into the heated morning milking he pours the evening milking; he makes the curd-clot; having taken it out as a firm mass into another vessel, poured whey over it, and set it down in a well-known place, he places the remainder of the whey on the heap of rubbish.

5.1.2.a.s: saṃyutānāṃ piṣṭānāṃ vibhāgamantreṇa pauṣṇam apacchidya carukalpena śrapayati /
5.1.2.a.d: संयुतानां पिष्टानां विभागमन्त्रेण पौष्णम् अपच्छिद्य चरुकल्पेन श्रपयति ।
5.1.2.a.m: Having cut off the portion for Pūṣan from the mixed flours with the division mantra, he cooks it according to the rule for a caru.

5.1.2.b.s: uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya saṃpraiṣeṇa pratipadyate \\ ājyena dadhnā codehi \\ iti saṃpraiṣasyāntam̐ saṃnamati /
5.1.2.b.d: उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य संप्रैषेण प्रतिपद्यते \\ आज्येन दध्ना चोदेहि \\ इति संप्रैषस्यान्तम्̐ संनमति ।
5.1.2.b.m: Having encompassed [the altar] with the second enclosing line, he proceeds with the ritual direction; he concludes the ritual direction with: 'And come forward with clarified butter and curd!'

5.1.2.c.s: caitryāṃ tu dvirājyasyopastīrya dvir dadhi gṛhītvā sakṛd ājyenābhighārayati /
5.1.2.c.d: चैत्र्यां तु द्विराज्यस्योपस्तीर्य द्विर् दधि गृहीत्वा सकृद् आज्येनाभिघारयति ।
5.1.2.c.m: At the Caitrī full moon, however, having spread clarified butter twice as an under-layer and taken curd twice, he bastes it once with clarified butter.

5.1.2.d.m: He undertakes the rites beginning with the taking down [from the fire].

5.1.2.e.s: anyasmin pātra ekakapālam udāsya prabhūtena sarpiṣābhyānīyāviṣpṛṣṭhaṃ karoti /
5.1.2.e.d: अन्यस्मिन् पात्र एककपालम् उदास्य प्रभूतेन सर्पिषाभ्यानीयाविष्पृष्ठं करोति ।
5.1.2.e.m: Having taken out the cake on one potsherd into another vessel and poured abundant clarified butter over it, he makes its top surface [covered with butter] without touching it directly.

5.1.2.f.m: He places the sacrificial oblations [on the altar] with the vyāhṛtis; likewise at the [offering at the end of the] year.

5.1.2.g.m: He proceeds with the churned fire according to the rule for churned fire.

5.1.2.h.m: Having laid down the veda-grass, he issues the ritual direction for the sāmidhenī verses.

5.1.2.i.s: nava prayājān yajati caturthe samānīyāṣṭame sarvam̐ samānayate /
5.1.2.i.d: नव प्रयाजान् यजति चतुर्थे समानीयाष्टमे सर्वम्̐ समानयते ।
5.1.2.i.m: He offers nine fore-offerings; having poured together [the butter] at the fourth, he pours it all together at the eighth.

5.1.2.j.m: Everywhere he sacrifices to the deities of the oblation to Savitṛ and of that on one potsherd inaudibly.

5.1.2.k.s: kṛtsnam ekakapālam avadāyāśayam anuparyasyarjuṃ pratiṣṭhitam aparyāvartayañ juhoti /
5.1.2.k.d: कृत्स्नम् एककपालम् अवदायाशयम् अनुपर्यस्यर्जुं प्रतिष्ठितम् अपर्यावर्तयञ् जुहोति ।
5.1.2.k.m: Having cut off the whole cake on one potsherd, having turned round along its base, he offers it straight, firmly supported, without turning it over.

5.1.2.l.s: yadi hutaḥ paryāvarteta vare datte sruco 'greṇa kalpayet pratyādāya vā punar juhuyān na pāṇinety ekeṣām /
5.1.2.l.d: यदि हुतः पर्यावर्तेत वरे दत्ते स्रुचो ऽग्रेण कल्पयेत् प्रत्यादाय वा पुनर् जुहुयान् न पाणिनेत्य् एकेषाम् ।
5.1.2.l.m: If it should turn over when offered, then after a boon is given, he should adjust it with the tip of the offering ladle, or having taken it back he should offer it again, but according to some, not with the hand.

5.1.2.m.s: madhuś ca mādhavaś ca \\ iti caturbhir māsanāmabhir ekakapālam abhijuhoti madhave svāhā \ mādhavāya svāhā \\ iti vā /
5.1.2.m.d: मधुश् च माधवश् च \\ इति चतुर्भिर् मासनामभिर् एककपालम् अभिजुहोति मधवे स्वाहा \ माधवाय स्वाहा \\ इति वा ।
5.1.2.m.m: With the four names of the months, 'Madhu and Mādhava...', he makes an additional offering over the cake on one potsherd; or with: 'To Madhu, svāhā! To Mādhava, svāhā!'

5.1.2.n.m: He offers nine after-offerings with clotted clarified butter.

5.1.3.a.s: saṃvatsarīṇām̐ svastim āśāste divyaṃ dhāmāśāste \\ iti sūktavākasyāśīṣṣu hotānuvartayati /
5.1.3.a.d: संवत्सरीणाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशास्ते दिव्यं धामाशास्ते \\ इति सूक्तवाकस्याशीष्षु होतानुवर्तयति ।
5.1.3.a.m: In the invocations of the Sūktavāka the hotṛ subjoins: 'He prays for well-being lasting a year; he prays for the divine dwelling.'

5.1.3.b.m: When the enclosing sticks have been cast [into the fire], having offered the remnant offering, he proceeds with the whey.

5.1.3.c.s: vājinapātra upastīrya barhiṣi viṣiñcan vājinaṃ gṛhṇāti pūrayitvā nābhighārayati /
5.1.3.c.d: वाजिनपात्र उपस्तीर्य बर्हिषि विषिञ्चन् वाजिनं गृह्णाति पूरयित्वा नाभिघारयति ।
5.1.3.c.m: Having spread an under-layer in the whey-vessel, pouring it out across the barhis, he takes the whey; having filled [the vessel], he does not baste it.

5.1.3.d.d: वाजिभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \ वाजिनो यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
5.1.3.d.m: He issues the ritual direction: 'Recite [the introductory verse] for the Vājins; sacrifice to the Vājins!'

5.1.3.e.m: Sitting with his right knee raised, the hotṛ recites the offering verse without taking a breath.

5.1.3.f.m: When the vaṣaṭ-call has been uttered, he offers with [the ladle] being continuously poured out.

5.1.3.g.m: He makes a secondary offering with: 'O Agni, enjoy the whey!'

5.1.3.h.m: With the residue of the whey he offers in the quarters, as with the residue of the omentum offering.

5.1.3.i.s: samupahūya sarve vājinaṃ bhakṣayanty anyonyasminn upahavam icchantas \\ upahvayasva \\ ity āmantraṇe \\ upahūtas \\ iti prativacanaḥ /
5.1.3.i.d: समुपहूय सर्वे वाजिनं भक्षयन्त्य् अन्योन्यस्मिन्न् उपहवम् इच्छन्तस् \\ उपह्वयस्व \\ इत्य् आमन्त्रणे \\ उपहूतस् \\ इति प्रतिवचनः ।
5.1.3.i.m: Having mutually invited one another, they all consume the whey, seeking permission from each other; 'Do invite me!' is the invitation; 'You are invited!' is the response.

5.1.3.j.s: vājināṃ bhakṣo avatu vājo asmān \ retaḥ siktam amṛtaṃ balāya / \ sa na indra indriyaṃ draviṇaṃ dadhātu \ mā riṣāma vājinaṃ bhakṣayantas \ tasya te vājin vājibhir bhakṣaṃ kṛtasya madhumata upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi \\ iti bhakṣayanti /
5.1.3.j.d: वाजिनां भक्षो अवतु वाजो अस्मान् \ रेतः सिक्तम् अमृतं बलाय । \ स न इन्द्र इन्द्रियं द्रविणं दधातु \ मा रिषाम वाजिनं भक्षयन्तस् \ तस्य ते वाजिन् वाजिभिर् भक्षं कृतस्य मधुमत उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि \\ इति भक्षयन्ति ।
5.1.3.j.m: They consume it with: 'May the portion of the Vājins help us; may their strength [help] us, / the poured seed, immortal, for vigor. / May Indra bestow on us virile power and wealth; / may we not suffer harm consuming the whey. / Of you, the whey, which has been made into food by the Vājins, honey-sweet, invited, / being invited, I consume.'

5.1.3.k.m: The sacrificer is the first or the last [to consume].

5.1.3.l.m: On the next day, having sacrificed with the Full Moon rite, either having departed [from the hall] or without having departed,

5.1.3.m.s: prasūtā devena savitrā daivyā āpa undantu dīrghāyutvāya varcase \\ iti śiro 'bhyunatti /
5.1.3.m.d: प्रसूता देवेन सवित्रा दैव्या आप उन्दन्तु दीर्घायुत्वाय वर्चसे \\ इति शिरो ऽभ्युनत्ति ।
5.1.3.m.m: with 'Impelled by the divine Savitṛ, may the divine waters moisten [you] for long life, for luster', he moistens his head.

5.1.3.n.s: ṛtam eva parameṣṭhi \\ ṛtaṃ nātyeti kiṃcana \\ ṛte samudra āhitas \\ ṛte bhūmir iyam̐ śritā \\ agnis tigmena śociṣā \ tapa ākrāntam uṣṇihā \ śiras tapasy āhitam \\ vaiśvānarasya tejasā \\ ṛtenāsya nivartaye \ satyena parivartaye \ tapasāsyānuvartaye \ śivenāsyopavartaye \ śagmenāsyābhivartaye \\ iti treṇyā śalalyekṣuśalākayā vā keśān vināyan /
5.1.3.n.d: ऋतम् एव परमेष्ठि \\ ऋतं नात्येति किंचन \\ ऋते समुद्र आहितस् \\ ऋते भूमिर् इयम्̐ श्रिता \\ अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \ तप आक्रान्तम् उष्णिहा \ शिरस् तपस्य् आहितम् \\ वैश्वानरस्य तेजसा \\ ऋतेनास्य निवर्तये \ सत्येन परिवर्तये \ तपसास्यानुवर्तये \ शिवेनास्योपवर्तये \ शग्मेनास्याभिवर्तये \\ इति त्रेण्या शलल्येक्षुशलाकया वा केशान् विनायन् ।
5.1.3.n.m: Parting the hair with a three-striped porcupine quill or with a reed of sugarcane, with: 'Truth indeed is supreme, / nothing surpasses truth; / upon truth the ocean is founded, / upon truth this earth is supported. / Agni with sharp brilliance, / heat has overcome with its fervor; / the head is set in fervor. / By the brilliance of Vaiśvānara, / by truth I turn it away, / by reality I turn it around, / by fervor I cause it to follow, / auspiciously I cause it to approach, / successfully I cause it to advance toward [him]...'

5.1.3.o.m: With an iron or udumbara razor he shaves the hair.

5.1.3.p.m: He shaves his beard, or has his entire head shaved.

5.2.4.a.s: tataś caturṣu māseṣv āṣāḍhyāṃ śrāvaṇyāṃ vā varuṇapraghāsair yajate /
5.2.4.a.d: ततश् चतुर्षु मासेष्व् आषाढ्यां श्रावण्यां वा वरुणप्रघासैर् यजते ।
5.2.4.a.m: Then, after four months, at the Āṣāḍhī or Śrāvaṇī full moon, he sacrifices with the Varuṇapraghāsa offerings.

5.2.4.b.m: Their ritual procedure is explained by [that of] the Vaiśvadeva.

5.2.4.c.s: dvāv āhavanīyāv ubhayatrāvāpaḥ kṛtsnam uttare vihāre tantraṃ kriyate tathā dakṣiṇe /
5.2.4.c.d: द्वाव् आहवनीयाव् उभयत्रावापः कृत्स्नम् उत्तरे विहारे तन्त्रं क्रियते तथा दक्षिणे ।
5.2.4.c.m: There are two āhavanīya fires; the special additions are made in both; the entire framework is performed in the northern sacrificial area, and likewise in the southern.

5.2.4.d.m: The adhvaryu [performs] those connected with the gārhapatya fire.

5.2.4.f.s: tantram aṅgānāṃ hautraṃ tad adhvaryuḥ saṃpreṣyati /
5.2.4.f.d: तन्त्रम् अङ्गानां हौत्रं तद् अध्वर्युः संप्रेष्यति ।
5.2.4.f.m: The framework of the subsidiary rites and the duties of the hotṛ: that the adhvaryu directs.

5.2.4.g.m: Those connected with the fire are [pronounced] in the singular.

5.2.4.h.m: In the sāmidhenī verses, in bringing forward the fire, and in wiping the fires.

5.2.4.i.m: Both address the brahman priest; the brahman gives permission in the dual.

5.2.4.j.s: yatrāgnī praṇeṣyantau bhavatas tasmin deśe same prācī vedī kuruto dvyaṅgulena tryaṅgulena caturaṅgulena pṛthamātreṇa vā śroṇyam̐seṣv asaṃbhinne bhavataḥ /
5.2.4.j.d: यत्राग्नी प्रणेष्यन्तौ भवतस् तस्मिन् देशे समे प्राची वेदी कुरुतो द्व्यङ्गुलेन त्र्यङ्गुलेन चतुरङ्गुलेन पृथमात्रेण वा श्रोण्यम्̐सेष्व् असंभिन्ने भवतः ।
5.2.4.j.m: In that place where the two fires will be carried forward, they prepare two equal, eastward altars; by two finger-breadths, three finger-breadths, four finger-breadths, or the breadth of a span, they remain unjoined at their buttocks and shoulders.

5.2.4.k.s: yad adhvaryuḥ karoti tat pratiprasthātā karoti /
5.2.4.k.d: यद् अध्वर्युः करोति तत् प्रतिप्रस्थाता करोति ।
5.2.4.k.m: Whatever the adhvaryu does, the pratiprasthātṛ does.

5.2.4.l.s: uttare vihāre 'dhvaryuḥ karmāṇi karoti dakṣiṇe pratiprasthātā /
5.2.4.l.d: उत्तरे विहारे ऽध्वर्युः कर्माणि करोति दक्षिणे प्रतिप्रस्थाता ।
5.2.4.l.m: The adhvaryu performs the rites in the northern sacrificial area, the pratiprasthātṛ in the southern.

5.2.4.m.s: dakṣiṇasyā veder uttarasyāḥ śroṇer uttarasyā veder dakṣiṇam am̐sam̐ sphyenaikasphyām anusaṃbhinatti /
5.2.4.m.d: दक्षिणस्या वेदेर् उत्तरस्याः श्रोणेर् उत्तरस्या वेदेर् दक्षिणम् अम्̐सम्̐ स्फ्येनैकस्फ्याम् अनुसंभिनत्ति ।
5.2.4.m.m: From the northern buttock of the southern altar to the southern shoulder of the northern altar, he connects them with the wooden sword by a single stroke of the sword.

5.2.4.n.m: Common are the rubbish heap, the brahman priest, the hotṛ, and the āgnīdhra.

5.2.4.o.m: In front of the northern sacrificial area, the pratiprasthātṛ moves toward the rubbish heap.

5.2.4.p.m: According to the rule of the high altar, he constructs the high altar on the northern [altar].

5.2.4.q.m: The requisites are on both sides; the bringing forward of the fire is as in an animal sacrifice.

5.2.4.s.s: āmikṣayor vatsān apākuruto mārutyai pratiprasthātādhvaryur vāruṇyai sāyaṃdohasyāvṛtā dadhinī kurutaḥ /
5.2.4.s.d: आमिक्षयोर् वत्सान् अपाकुरुतो मारुत्यै प्रतिप्रस्थाताध्वर्युर् वारुण्यै सायंदोहस्यावृता दधिनी कुरुतः ।
5.2.4.s.m: they drive away the calves of the two curd-and-milk oblations—the pratiprasthātṛ for the one to the Maruts, the adhvaryu for the one to Varuṇa; according to the procedure of the evening milking, they prepare the two curdled milks.

5.2.4.t.s: pātrasam̐sādanakāle yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayuṅktaḥ śamīmayyaḥ sruco bhavanti //
5.2.4.t.d: पात्रसम्̐सादनकाले यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुङ्क्तः शमीमय्यः स्रुचो भवन्ति ॥
5.2.4.t.m: At the time of arranging the vessels, they arrange the vessels according to need; the offering ladles are made of śamī wood;

5.2.5.b.s: nirvapaṇakāle 'dhvaryuḥ pañca saṃcarāṇi nirupyaindrāgnam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati /
5.2.5.b.d: निर्वपणकाले ऽध्वर्युः पञ्च संचराणि निरुप्यैन्द्राग्नम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपति ।
5.2.5.b.m: At the time of measuring out the oblations, the adhvaryu, having measured out the five recurring oblations, measures out [the cake] on eleven potsherds for Indra-and-Agni.

5.2.5.c.m: The pratiprasthātṛ measures out barley for the ewe to the Maruts.

5.2.5.d.s: adhvaryur vāruṇaṃ meṣaṃ nirupya kāyam ekakapālaṃ nirvapati /
5.2.5.d.d: अध्वर्युर् वारुणं मेषं निरुप्य कायम् एककपालं निर्वपति ।
5.2.5.d.m: The adhvaryu, having measured out [the barley for] the ram to Varuṇa, measures out [the cake] on one potsherd to Ka.

5.2.5.f.m: Having moistened the barley grains with the remainder of the sprinkling water, they pound them.

5.2.5.g.s: aindrāgnaparyanteṣūpahiteṣu pratiprasthātā dakṣiṇārdhe gārhapatyasyaikādaśa dvādaśa vā kapālāny upadadhāti /
5.2.5.g.d: ऐन्द्राग्नपर्यन्तेषूपहितेषु प्रतिप्रस्थाता दक्षिणार्धे गार्हपत्यस्यैकादश द्वादश वा कपालान्य् उपदधाति ।
5.2.5.g.m: When the potsherds up to the one for Indra-and-Agni have been laid down, the pratiprasthātṛ arranges eleven or twelve potsherds in the southern half of the gārhapatya fire.

5.2.5.h.m: Having arranged eight potsherds for the ram, the adhvaryu arranges [the one] for the cake to Ka.

5.2.5.i.s: prātardohasyāvṛtā prātardohau dohayata āmikṣe kuruto yathā purastāt /
5.2.5.i.d: प्रातर्दोहस्यावृता प्रातर्दोहौ दोहयत आमिक्षे कुरुतो यथा पुरस्तात् ।
5.2.5.i.m: According to the procedure of the morning milking, they cause the two morning milkings to be milked; they prepare the two curds as before.

5.2.5.j.m: When [the offerings] up to the one for Indra-and-Agni have been put on the fire, they fashion the two effigies of rams.

5.2.5.k.s: mārutīṃ meṣīṃ pratiprasthātā karoty adhvaryur vāruṇaṃ meṣam̐ strīvyañjanāni striyāḥ karoti puṃvyañjanāni pum̐saḥ /
5.2.5.k.d: मारुतीं मेषीं प्रतिप्रस्थाता करोत्य् अध्वर्युर् वारुणं मेषम्̐ स्त्रीव्यञ्जनानि स्त्रियाः करोति पुंव्यञ्जनानि पुम्̐सः ।
5.2.5.k.m: The pratiprasthātā makes the ewe for the Maruts; the adhvaryu makes the ram for Varuṇa. He makes female marks for the female, male marks for the male.

5.2.5.l.s: ekādaśasu dvādaśasu vā kapāleṣu pratiprasthātā meṣīm adhiśrayaty aṣṭasu meṣam adhiśrityādhvaryuḥ kāyam ekakapālam adhiśrayati /
5.2.5.l.d: एकादशसु द्वादशसु वा कपालेषु प्रतिप्रस्थाता मेषीम् अधिश्रयत्य् अष्टसु मेषम् अधिश्रित्याध्वर्युः कायम् एककपालम् अधिश्रयति ।
5.2.5.l.m: The pratiprasthātā sets the ewe [to bake] upon eleven or twelve potsherds; having set the ram [to bake] upon eight [potsherds], the adhvaryu sets the single-potsherd [cake] for Ka [to bake].

5.2.5.m.m: Or both rams are cooked in a pot.

5.2.5.n.s: anyeṣāṃ laukikānām āmapeṣāṇām īṣadupataptānāṃ yavānāṃ karambhapātrāṇi kuruto yajamānaḥ patnī ca /
5.2.5.n.d: अन्येषां लौकिकानाम् आमपेषाणाम् ईषदुपतप्तानां यवानां करम्भपात्राणि कुरुतो यजमानः पत्नी च ।
5.2.5.n.m: Out of other, worldly barley, unground [and] slightly parched, the sacrificer and his wife make porridge dishes.

5.2.5.o.s: yāvanto yajāmānasya preṣyāmātyāḥ sastrīkās tata ekādhikāni /
5.2.5.o.d: यावन्तो यजामानस्य प्रेष्यामात्याः सस्त्रीकास् तत एकाधिकानि ।
5.2.5.o.m: As many servants and dependants of the sacrificer as there are, along with their wives, one more than that [number of dishes].

5.2.5.p.s: uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya saṃpraiṣeṇa pratipadyate \\ ājyena dadhnā codehi \\ iti saṃpraiṣasyāntam̐ saṃnamataḥ /
5.2.5.p.d: उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य संप्रैषेण प्रतिपद्यते \\ आज्येन दध्ना चोदेहि \\ इति संप्रैषस्यान्तम्̐ संनमतः ।
5.2.5.p.m: Having traced the northern boundary, he proceeds with the ritual direction: 'Come forward with the clarified butter and the curd'; thus the two adapt the end of the ritual direction.

5.2.5.q.s: āṣāḍhyāṃ yathā phālgunyām evaṃ pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhṇītaḥ /
5.2.5.q.d: आषाढ्यां यथा फाल्गुन्याम् एवं पृषदाज्यं गृह्णीतः ।
5.2.5.q.m: At the full moon of Āṣāḍha, just as at that of Phālguna, so they take the curd-mixed clarified butter.

5.2.5.r.s: śrāvaṇyāṃ tu sakṛd ājyasyopastīrya dvir dadhi gṛhītvā sakṛd ājyenābhighārayataḥ /
5.2.5.r.d: श्रावण्यां तु सकृद् आज्यस्योपस्तीर्य द्विर् दधि गृहीत्वा सकृद् आज्येनाभिघारयतः ।
5.2.5.r.m: At the full moon of Śrāvaṇa, however, having under-layered once with clarified butter, having taken curd twice, they baste once with clarified butter.

5.2.5.s.m: He proceeds with the rites beginning with the taking off [from the fire].

5.2.5.t.s: aindrāgnaparyanteṣv alaṃkṛteṣv anaiḍakībhir ūrṇābhir meṣapratikṛtī lomaśau kurutas tāsv āsv avidyamānāsu kuśorṇāni śleṣayataḥ /
5.2.5.t.d: ऐन्द्राग्नपर्यन्तेष्व् अलंकृतेष्व् अनैडकीभिर् ऊर्णाभिर् मेषप्रतिकृती लोमशौ कुरुतस् तास्व् आस्व् अविद्यमानासु कुशोर्णानि श्लेषयतः ।
5.2.5.t.m: When the oblations up to the one to Indra-Agni have been adorned, they make both ram effigies woolly with sheep's wool; if that is not available, they stick kuśa-grass filaments [onto them].

5.2.5.u.m: He places the ram into the oblation for the Maruts, and the ewe into the oblation for Varuṇa.

5.2.6.a.s: uttarasyāṃ vedyām anyāni havīm̐ṣi sādayati dakṣiṇāyāṃ mārutīṃ karambhapātrāṇi ca /
5.2.6.a.d: उत्तरस्यां वेद्याम् अन्यानि हवीम्̐षि सादयति दक्षिणायां मारुतीं करम्भपात्राणि च ।
5.2.6.a.m: On the northern altar he places the other oblations; on the southern [altar] the oblation for the Maruts and the porridge dishes.

5.2.6.b.s: āsādya meṣapratikṛtī vipariharato mārutyāṃ meṣīm avadadhāti vāruṇyāṃ meṣam /
5.2.6.b.d: आसाद्य मेषप्रतिकृती विपरिहरतो मारुत्यां मेषीम् अवदधाति वारुण्यां मेषम् ।
5.2.6.b.m: Having placed them, they exchange the two ram effigies: he places the ewe into the oblation for the Maruts, and the ram into the oblation for Varuṇa.

5.2.6.c.s: tayoḥ paraḥśatāni paraḥsahasrāṇi vā śamīparṇakarīrāṇy upavapataḥ karambhapātreṣu cāvapati /
5.2.6.c.d: तयोः परःशतानि परःसहस्राणि वा शमीपर्णकरीराण्य् उपवपतः करम्भपात्रेषु चावपति ।
5.2.6.c.m: On both of them they scatter more than a hundred or more than a thousand śamī-leaves and karīra-fruits, and he scatters [some] into the porridge dishes.

5.2.6.d.m: According to the procedure for the churned fire, the two proceed with the churned fire.

5.2.6.e.m: Having laid down the grass brush, he gives the ritual direction for the sāmidhenī verses.

5.2.6.f.s: saṃmṛṣṭa uttare 'gnāv asaṃmṛṣṭe dakṣiṇe pratiprasthātā patnīṃ pṛcchati patni kati te jārās \\ iti sā yāvataḥ prabrūyāt tān varuṇo gṛhṇātu \\ iti nirdiśati yaj jāram̐ santaṃ na prabrūyāt priyaṃ jñātim̐ rundhyāt /
5.2.6.f.d: संमृष्ट उत्तरे ऽग्नाव् असंमृष्टे दक्षिणे प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नीं पृच्छति पत्नि कति ते जारास् \\ इति सा यावतः प्रब्रूयात् तान् वरुणो गृह्णातु \\ इति निर्दिशति यज् जारम्̐ सन्तं न प्रब्रूयात् प्रियं ज्ञातिम्̐ रुन्ध्यात् ।
5.2.6.f.m: When the northern fire has been swept and the southern has not been swept, the pratiprasthātā asks the sacrificer's wife: 'O wife, how many lovers do you have?' As many as she confesses, he indicates: 'May Varuṇa seize them.' If she should not confess someone who is a lover, she would injure a dear relative.

5.2.6.g.s: praghāsyān havāmahe \\ iti pratiprasthātā patnīm udānayati /
5.2.6.g.d: प्रघास्यान् हवामहे \\ इति प्रतिप्रस्थाता पत्नीम् उदानयति ।
5.2.6.g.m: With 'We invoke the voracious ones...', the pratiprasthātā leads the sacrificer's wife forward.

5.2.6.h.s: aiṣīke śūrpe karambhapātrāṇy uptāni patnī śīrṣann adhi nidhāyāntarā vedī gatvāgreṇa dakṣiṇam agniṃ pratyañcāv avatiṣṭhete yajamānaḥ patnī ca /
5.2.6.h.d: ऐषीके शूर्पे करम्भपात्राण्य् उप्तानि पत्नी शीर्षन्न् अधि निधायान्तरा वेदी गत्वाग्रेण दक्षिणम् अग्निं प्रत्यञ्चाव् अवतिष्ठेते यजमानः पत्नी च ।
5.2.6.h.m: The porridge dishes having been poured into a winnowing basket of reeds, the sacrificer's wife, placing it upon her head, having gone between the two altars, the sacrificer and his wife stand facing west in front of the southern fire.

5.2.6.i.s: mo ṣū ṇas \\ iti yajamānaḥ puronuvākyām anvāha yad grāme \\ ity ubhau saṃnigadya śūrpeṇa dakṣiṇe 'gnau juhutaḥ /
5.2.6.i.d: मो षू णस् \\ इति यजमानः पुरोनुवाक्याम् अन्वाह यद् ग्रामे \\ इत्य् उभौ संनिगद्य शूर्पेण दक्षिणे ऽग्नौ जुहुतः ।
5.2.6.i.m: With 'Do not, [O gods]...', the sacrificer recites the introductory verse; having both uttered together, 'What [evil we committed] in the village...', they offer [the dishes] into the southern fire with the winnowing basket.

5.2.6.j.m: Or the adhvaryu offers, while the other two touch him from behind.

5.2.6.k.s: akran karma karmakṛtas \\ iti viparāyantau japataḥ /
5.2.6.k.d: अक्रन् कर्म कर्मकृतस् \\ इति विपरायन्तौ जपतः ।
5.2.6.k.m: Walking away in opposite directions, they murmur: 'The workers have done the work...'

5.2.6.m.m: When the rites have been performed up to [the oblation for] Indra-Agni,

5.2.6.n.s: pratiprasthātā mārutyāḥ pūrveṇa sahāvadānena kṛtsnāṃ meṣīm avadyaty uttareṇa śamīparṇakarīrāṇi /
5.2.6.n.d: प्रतिप्रस्थाता मारुत्याः पूर्वेण सहावदानेन कृत्स्नां मेषीम् अवद्यत्य् उत्तरेण शमीपर्णकरीराणि ।
5.2.6.n.m: the pratiprasthātā cuts off the entire ewe along with the first cutting of the oblation for the Maruts, and the śamī-leaves and karīra-fruits with the second.

5.2.6.o.s: adhvaryur vāruṇyāḥ pūrveṇa sahāvadānena kṛtsnaṃ meṣam avadyaty uttareṇa śamīparṇakarīrāṇi /
5.2.6.o.d: अध्वर्युर् वारुण्याः पूर्वेण सहावदानेन कृत्स्नं मेषम् अवद्यत्य् उत्तरेण शमीपर्णकरीराणि ।
5.2.6.o.m: The adhvaryu cuts off the entire ram along with the first cutting of the oblation for Varuṇa, and the śamī-leaves and karīra-fruits with the second.

5.2.7.a.m: He gives the ritual direction for the single-potsherd oblation.

5.2.7.b.s: nabhaś ca nabhasyaś ca \\ iti caturbhir māsanāmabhir ekakapālam abhijuhoti nabhase svāhā nabhasyāya svāhā \\ iti vā /
5.2.7.b.d: नभश् च नभस्यश् च \\ इति चतुर्भिर् मासनामभिर् एककपालम् अभिजुहोति नभसे स्वाहा नभस्याय स्वाहा \\ इति वा ।
5.2.7.b.m: With the four names of the months, 'Nabhas and Nabhasya...', he makes an offering over the single-potsherd cake, or with: 'Svāhā to Nabhas, svāhā to Nabhasya...'

5.2.7.c.s: parivatsarīṇām̐ svastim āśāste \\ iti sūktavākasyāśīḥṣu hotānuvartayati /
5.2.7.c.d: परिवत्सरीणाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशास्ते \\ इति सूक्तवाकस्याशीःषु होतानुवर्तयति ।
5.2.7.c.m: The hotṛ repeats in the benedictions of the sūktavāka: 'He hopes for the well-being of the full year.'

5.2.7.d.m: When the enclosing sticks have been thrown [into the fire], having offered over [them] with the remnants, the two proceed with the whey.

5.2.7.f.s: yan me retaḥ prasicyate \ yan ma ājāyate punaḥ / \ yad vā me pratitiṣṭhati \ tena mā vājinaṃ kuru \ tena suprajasaṃ kuru \ tasya te vājin vājibhir bhakṣaṃ kṛtasya madhumata upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi \\ iti dakṣiṇe vihāre bhakṣayanti /
5.2.7.f.d: यन् मे रेतः प्रसिच्यते \ यन् म आजायते पुनः । \ यद् वा मे प्रतितिष्ठति \ तेन मा वाजिनं कुरु \ तेन सुप्रजसं कुरु \ तस्य ते वाजिन् वाजिभिर् भक्षं कृतस्य मधुमत उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि \\ इति दक्षिणे विहारे भक्षयन्ति ।
5.2.7.f.m: They consume [the whey] in the southern sacrificial area with: 'Whatever semen of mine is poured out, whatever is born to me again, or whatever is firmly established in me, by that make me a possessor of strength; by that make me possessor of good offspring. Of you, O whey, who have been consumed by the strong, sweet, being invited, I consume, being invited.'

5.2.7.g.s: ā mā viśantv indavas \\ ā gaglā dhamanīnām / \ rasena me rasaṃ pṛṇa \ tasya te vājin vājibhir bhakṣaṃ kṛtasya madhumata upahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi \\ ity uttare /
5.2.7.g.d: आ मा विशन्त्व् इन्दवस् \\ आ गग्ला धमनीनाम् । \ रसेन मे रसं पृण \ तस्य ते वाजिन् वाजिभिर् भक्षं कृतस्य मधुमत उपहूतस्योपहूतो भक्षयामि \\ इत्य् उत्तरे ।
5.2.7.g.m: In the northern [area, they consume it] with: 'May the drops enter into me, the swelling currents of the vessels. Fill my sap with sap. Of you, O whey, who have been consumed by the strong, sweet, being invited, I consume, being invited.'

5.2.7.h.s: sam̐sthāpya vāruṇyā niṣkāsena tuṣaiś cāvabhṛtham avayanti tasya saumikenāvabhṛthena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ /
5.2.7.h.d: सम्̐स्थाप्य वारुण्या निष्कासेन तुषैश् चावभृथम् अवयन्ति तस्य सौमिकेनावभृथेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः ।
5.2.7.h.m: Having concluded, with the scraped-out portion of the oblation for Varuṇa and with the husks, they go down to the purificatory bath; its procedure has been explained by the purificatory bath of the soma sacrifice.

5.2.7.k.m: having disposed of the scraped-out portion according to the rule for Varuṇa,

5.2.7.l.m: he disposes of the husks according to the rule for the soma residue.

5.2.7.m.s: avabhṛthād udetya vāsasī yasmai kāmayete tasmai dattaḥ /
5.2.7.m.d: अवभृथाद् उदेत्य वाससी यस्मै कामयेते तस्मै दत्तः ।
5.2.7.m.m: Having come up from the purificatory bath, they give their two garments to whomever they wish.

5.2.7.n.s: śvo bhūte paurṇamāseneṣṭvodavasāyānudavasāya vā prasūtā devena savitrā \\ ity undati /
5.2.7.n.d: श्वो भूते पौर्णमासेनेष्ट्वोदवसायानुदवसाय वा प्रसूता देवेन सवित्रा \\ इत्य् उन्दति ।
5.2.7.n.m: On the next day, having sacrificed with the full-moon rite, having departed or having not departed, he moistens [the hair] with: 'Impelled by the god Savitṛ...'

5.2.7.o.s: yad gharmaḥ paryavartayat \\ antān pṛthivyā divas \\ agnir īśāna ojasā \ varuṇo dhītibhiḥ saha \\ indro marudbhiḥ sakhibhiḥ saha \\ agnis tigmena śociṣā \\ iti nivartanaṃ vāpanaṃ yathā purastāt //
5.2.7.o.d: यद् घर्मः पर्यवर्तयत् \\ अन्तान् पृथिव्या दिवस् \\ अग्निर् ईशान ओजसा \ वरुणो धीतिभिः सह \\ इन्द्रो मरुद्भिः सखिभिः सह \\ अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \\ इति निवर्तनं वापनं यथा पुरस्तात् ॥
5.2.7.o.m: The turning [of the hair] and the shaving are as before, with: 'When the Gharma overturned the limits of earth and heaven; Agni, ruling through might; Varuṇa along with prayers; Indra along with the Maruts, his companions; Agni with sharp brilliance.'

5.3.9.a.s: tataś caturṣu māseṣu kārtikyāṃ mārgaśīrṣyāṃ vā dvyaham̐ sākamedhair yajate /
5.3.9.a.d: ततश् चतुर्षु मासेषु कार्तिक्यां मार्गशीर्ष्यां वा द्व्यहम्̐ साकमेधैर् यजते ।
5.3.9.a.m: Then, after four months, at the full moon of Kārttika or Mārgaśīrṣa, he sacrifices for two days with the Sākamedha offerings.

5.3.9.b.s: agnaye 'nīkavate puroḍāśam aṣṭākapālaṃ nirvapati sākam̐ sūryeṇodyatā sākam̐ raśmibhiḥ pracarantīty ekeṣāṃ marudbhyaḥ sāṃtapanebhyo madhyaṃdine caruṃ na barhir anupraharatīty ekeṣām aparāhṇe gṛhamedhīyāya vatsān apākaroti yāvanto yajamānasyāyajuṣkeṇa vatsān apākarotīty ekeṣām /
5.3.9.b.d: अग्नये ऽनीकवते पुरोडाशम् अष्टाकपालं निर्वपति साकम्̐ सूर्येणोद्यता साकम्̐ रश्मिभिः प्रचरन्तीत्य् एकेषां मरुद्भ्यः सांतपनेभ्यो मध्यंदिने चरुं न बर्हिर् अनुप्रहरतीत्य् एकेषाम् अपराह्णे गृहमेधीयाय वत्सान् अपाकरोति यावन्तो यजमानस्यायजुष्केण वत्सान् अपाकरोतीत्य् एकेषाम् ।
5.3.9.b.m: He offers a cake on eight potsherds to Agni Anīkavat, rising together with the sun; 'they proceed together with its rays,' according to some; at midday a mess of boiled rice to the Santapana Maruts; 'he does not throw the sacrificial grass [into the fire],' according to some; in the afternoon he drives away the calves for the Gṛhamedhīya rite—as many as the sacrificer owns; 'he drives away the calves without a mantra,' according to some.

5.3.9.c.d: सायम्̐ हुते ऽग्निहोत्रे गृहमेधीयस्य तन्त्रं प्रक्रमयति ।
5.3.9.c.m: In the evening, when the Agnihotra has been offered, he commences the framework of the Gṛhamedhīya rite.

5.3.9.d.m: In that regard, as much as is done, that we shall explain.

5.3.9.e.s: agnīn anvādhāya vedaṃ kṛtvāgnīn paristīrya pāṇī prakṣālyolaparājīm̐ stīrtvā yathārthaṃ pātrāṇi prayunakti /
5.3.9.e.d: अग्नीन् अन्वाधाय वेदं कृत्वाग्नीन् परिस्तीर्य पाणी प्रक्षाल्योलपराजीम्̐ स्तीर्त्वा यथार्थं पात्राणि प्रयुनक्ति ।
5.3.9.e.m: Having fueled the fires, fashioned the grass brush, strewn around the fires, washed both hands, strewn a line of coarse grass, he sets out the utensils as needed:

5.3.9.f.m: the pot and three shallow vessels.

5.3.9.g.s: nirvapaṇakāle marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyaḥ prabhūtān vrīhīn nirvapati yāvat payo manyate /
5.3.9.g.d: निर्वपणकाले मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्यः प्रभूतान् व्रीहीन् निर्वपति यावत् पयो मन्यते ।
5.3.9.g.m: At the time of offering, he pours out abundant rice grains for the Gṛhamedhin Maruts, as much as he thinks the milk will suffice for.

5.3.9.h.m: He causes a cow to be milked through a strainer.

5.3.9.i.s: na taṇḍulān utpunāti yajurutpūtenaiva payasā śrapayatīty ekeṣām /
5.3.9.i.d: न तण्डुलान् उत्पुनाति यजुरुत्पूतेनैव पयसा श्रपयतीत्य् एकेषाम् ।
5.3.9.i.m: He does not winnow the husked rice grains; 'he cooks them in milk purified only with a mantra,' according to some.

5.3.9.j.m: He cooks a neighboring mess of boiled rice on the dakṣiṇāgni fire.

5.3.9.k.s: sphyam ādāya stīrṇāyā veder lomabhyo 'dhi stambayajur harati /
5.3.9.k.d: स्फ्यम् आदाय स्तीर्णाया वेदेर् लोमभ्यो ऽधि स्तम्बयजुर् हरति ।
5.3.9.k.m: Taking the wooden sword, he removes the clump of grass from the hairs of the strewn altar.

5.3.9.l.m: Having traced the northern boundary, he proceeds with the ritual direction.

5.3.9.m.s: yad anyad idhmābarhiṣaḥ patnīsaṃnahanāc ca tat saṃpreṣyati /
5.3.9.m.d: यद् अन्यद् इध्माबर्हिषः पत्नीसंनहनाच् च तत् संप्रेष्यति ।
5.3.9.m.m: Whatever is other than the firewood and sacrificial grass and the girding of the sacrificer's wife, that he directs.

5.3.9.n.s: yat prāg ājyagrahaṇāt tat kṛtvā dhruvāyām eva gṛhṇāti /
5.3.9.n.d: यत् प्राग् आज्यग्रहणात् तत् कृत्वा ध्रुवायाम् एव गृह्णाति ।
5.3.9.n.m: Having done whatever precedes the scooping of the clarified butter, he scoops it only into the dhruvā ladle.

5.3.9.o.s: prokṣaṇīr abhimantrya brahmāṇam āmantrya vediṃ prokṣya prokṣaṇāvaśeṣaṃ ninīya pavitre apisṛjya dhruvām̐ sruvaṃ ca sādayati /
5.3.9.o.d: प्रोक्षणीर् अभिमन्त्र्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य वेदिं प्रोक्ष्य प्रोक्षणावशेषं निनीय पवित्रे अपिसृज्य ध्रुवाम्̐ स्रुवं च सादयति ।
5.3.9.o.m: Having consecrated the sprinkling waters with a mantra, addressed the brahman, sprinkled the altar, poured out the residue of the sprinkling waters, and thrown down the two strainers, he sets down the dhruvā ladle and the spoon.

5.3.9.p.m: He adapts the mantra: 'They have sat down.'

5.3.9.q.s: viṣṇv asi \ vaiṣṇavaṃ dhāma prājāpatyam ity ājyam abhimantrayate /
5.3.9.q.d: विष्ण्व् असि \ वैष्णवं धाम प्राजापत्यम् इत्य् आज्यम् अभिमन्त्रयते ।
5.3.9.q.m: He addresses the clarified butter with: 'You are Viṣṇu, the abode belonging to Viṣṇu, belonging to Prajāpati.'

5.3.9.r.s: yad ānīkavatasya barhis tat sāṃtapanīyasya tad gṛhamedhīyasya tat stīrṇam evety ekeṣām /
5.3.9.r.d: यद् आनीकवतस्य बर्हिस् तत् सांतपनीयस्य तद् गृहमेधीयस्य तत् स्तीर्णम् एवेत्य् एकेषाम् ।
5.3.9.r.m: Whatever was the sacrificial grass of the Anīkavata [offering], that belongs to the Sāṃtapanīya, that to the Gṛhamedhīya; according to some, that very [grass] remains spread.

5.3.9.s.m: He proceeds with the rites beginning with the taking off [from the fire].

5.3.9.t.s: śṛtasya haviṣaḥ śaram uddhṛtya prajñātaṃ nidhāya /
5.3.9.t.d: शृतस्य हविषः शरम् उद्धृत्य प्रज्ञातं निधाय ।
5.3.9.t.m: Having removed the cream of the cooked sacrificial oblation and placed it in a known place,

5.3.9.u.m: having spread an under-layer in the dishes, he ladles out three portions of boiled rice.

5.3.9.v.m: He sets down the pot from which [the boiled rice] has been scraped out.

5.3.9.w.m: Having inserted the stirring ladle without wiping it,

5.3.9.x.m: having poured clarified butter over them, purified them with strainers, and decorated them, he places the portions of boiled rice [upon the altar].

5.3.9.y.m: When the deities have been conveyed, having fanned the fire and performed the two clarified butter portions,

5.3.9.z.s: juhvām upastīrya sarvebhya odanebhyaḥ samavadāyābhighārya marudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo 'nubrūhi \ maruto gṛhamedhino yaja \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
5.3.9.z.d: जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य सर्वेभ्य ओदनेभ्यः समवदायाभिघार्य मरुद्भ्यो गृहमेधिभ्यो ऽनुब्रूहि \ मरुतो गृहमेधिनो यज \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
5.3.9.z.m: having spread an under-layer in the juhū ladle, taken portions from all the portions of boiled rice, and poured clarified butter over them, he gives the ritual direction: 'Recite [the introductory verse] for the Maruts, the householders; sacrifice to the Maruts, the householders.'

5.3.9.aa.s: sviṣṭakṛt prāśitram iḍā ca kriyante prāśitāyām amātyebhya odanānupaharanti ye havirbhojanā bhavanti /
5.3.9.aa.d: स्विष्टकृत् प्राशित्रम् इडा च क्रियन्ते प्राशितायाम् अमात्येभ्य ओदनानुपहरन्ति ये हविर्भोजना भवन्ति ।
5.3.9.aa.m: The Sviṣṭakṛt offering, the prāśitra portion, and the iḍā are made; when [the iḍā] has been eaten, they serve the boiled rice to the members of the household who are eaters of sacrificial oblation.

5.3.9.ab.m: The sacrificer's wife eats food cooked by a neighbor.

5.3.9.ac.m: The Gṛhamedhīya concludes ending with the iḍā.

5.3.9.ad.m: They anoint their eyes, anoint their bodies, and stable the calves with [their mothers].

5.3.9.ag.s: suhitā etām̐ rātriṃ vasanti pratītā anavartimukhinaḥ /
5.3.9.ag.d: सुहिता एताम्̐ रात्रिं वसन्ति प्रतीता अनवर्तिमुखिनः ।
5.3.9.ag.m: Well-fed, contented, and showing no signs of distress, they spend this night.

5.3.9.ah.d: पराचीनरात्रे ऽभिवान्यवत्साया अग्निहोत्र्याश् च वत्सौ बध्नाति ।
5.3.9.ah.m: In the latter part of the night, he ties up the two calves of the cow suckling an adopted calf and of the Agnihotra cow.

5.3.9.ai.m: Before the morning Agnihotra, they perform the Pūrṇadarvī rite.

5.3.9.aj.s: darvyām upastīrya śaraniṣkāsasya darvīṃ pūrayitvā nimṛṣṭaṃ darvyudāyuvanam avadāyābhighārya /
5.3.9.aj.d: दर्व्याम् उपस्तीर्य शरनिष्कासस्य दर्वीं पूरयित्वा निमृष्टं दर्व्युदायुवनम् अवदायाभिघार्य ।
5.3.9.aj.m: Having spread an under-layer in a wooden spoon, filled the wooden spoon with the cream and the scrapings [from the pot], ladled out [what adhered to] the wiped stirring ladle, and poured clarified butter over it,

5.3.9.ak.s: pūrṇā darvi \\ ity anudrutyarṣabham āhūya dehi me \\ iti tasya ravate gārhapatye juhoti /
5.3.9.ak.d: पूर्णा दर्वि \\ इत्य् अनुद्रुत्यर्षभम् आहूय देहि मे \\ इति तस्य रवते गार्हपत्ये जुहोति ।
5.3.9.ak.m: having recited: 'Full wooden spoon...', he calls a bull, and when it roars at [the words] 'give unto me', he makes the offering in the gārhapatya fire.

5.3.9.al.s: yad ṛṣabho na rūyād brahmāṇam āmantrya tenānujñāto juhuyāt /
5.3.9.al.d: यद् ऋषभो न रूयाद् ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्य तेनानुज्ञातो जुहुयात् ।
5.3.9.al.m: If the bull should not roar, he should address the brahman and, permitted by him, make the offering.

5.3.9.am.s: marudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ puroḍāśam̐ saptakapālaṃ nirvapati sākam̐ sūryenodyatā sākam̐ raśmibhiḥ pracarantīty ekeṣām //
5.3.9.am.d: मरुद्भ्यः क्रीडिभ्यः पुरोडाशम्̐ सप्तकपालं निर्वपति साकम्̐ सूर्येनोद्यता साकम्̐ रश्मिभिः प्रचरन्तीत्य् एकेषाम् ॥
5.3.9.am.m: He parcels out a sacrificial cake on seven potsherds for the sportive Maruts; according to some, they perform [this rite] together with the rising sun, together with its rays.

5.3.10.a.m: At that very time, he sacrifices with the Mahāhavis offerings.

5.3.10.b.s: pañca saṃcarāṇi nirupyaindrāgnam ekādaśakapālaṃ nirvapaty aindraṃ caruṃ vaiśvakarmaṇam ekakapālam /
5.3.10.b.d: पञ्च संचराणि निरुप्यैन्द्राग्नम् एकादशकपालं निर्वपत्य् ऐन्द्रं चरुं वैश्वकर्मणम् एककपालम् ।
5.3.10.b.m: Having parceled out the five common oblations, he parcels out [an offering] on eleven potsherds to Indra and Agni, boiled rice to Indra, and [an offering] on one potsherd to Viśvakarman.

5.3.10.c.s: kārtikyāṃ yathāṣāḍhyām evaṃ pṛṣadājyaṃ gṛhṇāti mārgaśīrṣyāṃ tu yathā śrāvaṇyām /
5.3.10.c.d: कार्तिक्यां यथाषाढ्याम् एवं पृषदाज्यं गृह्णाति मार्गशीर्ष्यां तु यथा श्रावण्याम् ।
5.3.10.c.m: On the full moon day of Kārttika he takes clotted butter just as on the full moon day of Āṣāḍha, but on the full moon day of Mārgaśīrṣa just as on the full moon day of Śrāvaṇa.

5.3.10.d.s: agne ver hotraṃ ver dūtyam \ ūrdhvo adhvare ṣṭhās \\ avatāṃ tvā dyāvāpṛthivī \ ava tvaṃ dyāvāpṛthivī \ ava sviṣṭakṛd indrāya devebhyo bhava \ juṣāṇo asya haviṣo ghṛtasya vīhi svāhā \\ iti srucyam āghāram āghārayati /
5.3.10.d.d: अग्ने वेर् होत्रं वेर् दूत्यम् \ ऊर्ध्वो अध्वरे ष्ठास् \\ अवतां त्वा द्यावापृथिवी \ अव त्वं द्यावापृथिवी \ अव स्विष्टकृद् इन्द्राय देवेभ्यो भव \ जुषाणो अस्य हविषो घृतस्य वीहि स्वाहा \\ इति स्रुच्यम् आघारम् आघारयति ।
5.3.10.d.m: With: 'Agni, enjoy the hotṛ's office, enjoy the messenger's office; stand upright at the sacrifice; may Heaven and Earth protect you; protect Heaven and Earth; become Sviṣṭakṛt to Indra and to the gods; enjoying this sacrificial oblation of ghee, partake of it, svāhā!', he pours the libation with the ladle.

5.3.10.e.s: sahaś ca sahasyaś ca \\ iti caturbhir māsanāmabhir ekakapālam abhijuhoti sahase svāhā sahasyāya svāhā \\ iti vā /
5.3.10.e.d: सहश् च सहस्यश् च \\ इति चतुर्भिर् मासनामभिर् एककपालम् अभिजुहोति सहसे स्वाहा सहस्याय स्वाहा \\ इति वा ।
5.3.10.e.m: With the four month-names: 'Sahas and Sahasya...', he makes the offering over the one-potsherd cake, or with: 'To Sahas svāhā, to Sahasya svāhā.'

5.3.10.f.s: idāvatsarīṇām̐ svastim āśāste \ divyaṃ dhāmāśāste \\ iti sūktavākasyāśīṣṣu hotānuvartayati /
5.3.10.f.d: इदावत्सरीणाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशास्ते \ दिव्यं धामाशास्ते \\ इति सूक्तवाकस्याशीष्षु होतानुवर्तयति ।
5.3.10.f.m: In the benedictions of the Sūktavāka the hotṛ adds: 'He prays for the welfare belonging to the Idāvatsara year; he prays for the divine realm.'

5.3.10.g.s: aindrāgnatuṣair avabhṛtham avayanti gamanasaṃyuktaṃ tuṣapratipādanaṃ ca kriyate //
5.3.10.g.d: ऐन्द्राग्नतुषैर् अवभृथम् अवयन्ति गमनसंयुक्तं तुषप्रतिपादनं च क्रियते ॥
5.3.10.g.m: With the husks of the Indra-Agni [offering] they step down into the purificatory bath, and the disposal of the husks accompanied by walking is performed.

5.4.11.a.m: At that very time, he sacrifices with the Mahāpitṛyajña.

5.4.11.b.s: dakṣiṇataḥpurastād dakṣiṇāgner yajamānapātrīṃ caturaśrāṃ vediṃ karoti /
5.4.11.b.d: दक्षिणतःपुरस्ताद् दक्षिणाग्नेर् यजमानपात्रीं चतुरश्रां वेदिं करोति ।
5.4.11.b.m: To the southeast of the dakṣiṇāgni fire, he makes a four-cornered altar of the size of the sacrificer's vessel.

5.4.11.c.m: Its corners point toward the cardinal directions.

5.4.11.d.m: Its middles are narrowed between the intermediary directions.

5.4.11.e.m: Everywhere he adapts a mantra mentioning the gods to refer to both gods and ancestors.

5.4.11.f.s: yathā pṛthivi devapitṛyajani devānāṃ pitṝṇāṃ pariṣūtam asi \ devapitṛbarhir mā tvānvaṅ mā tiryak \ karmaṇe vāṃ devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ śakeyam iti /
5.4.11.f.d: यथा पृथिवि देवपितृयजनि देवानां पितॄणां परिषूतम् असि \ देवपितृबर्हिर् मा त्वान्वङ् मा तिर्यक् \ कर्मणे वां देवेभ्यः पितृभ्यः शकेयम् इति ।
5.4.11.f.m: As: 'O earth, place of sacrifice for gods and ancestors, you are surrounded for the gods and ancestors'; 'O sacrificial grass of gods and ancestors, do not go across me, do not go horizontally'; 'May I be capable for the rite, for you two, for gods and ancestors.'

5.4.11.g.s: uddhananāntaṃ kṛtvā sarvataḥ pariśrityottarām̐ sraktiṃ dvāraṃ kṛtvā /
5.4.11.g.d: उद्धननान्तं कृत्वा सर्वतः परिश्रित्योत्तराम्̐ स्रक्तिं द्वारं कृत्वा ।
5.4.11.g.m: Having finished up to the digging up, enclosed [the altar] on all sides with screens, and made the northern corner the entrance,

5.4.11.h.s: dakṣiṇāgner aṅgārān āhṛtya madhye veder nyupyopasamādadhāti /
5.4.11.h.d: दक्षिणाग्नेर् अङ्गारान् आहृत्य मध्ये वेदेर् न्युप्योपसमादधाति ।
5.4.11.h.m: having fetched burning coals from the dakṣiṇāgni fire and poured them down in the middle of the altar, he adds firewood to it.

5.4.11.j.m: Having added fuel to the āhavanīya fire, the gārhapatya fire, and the dakṣiṇāgni fire,

5.4.11.k.s: idhmābarhir āharati drāghīyaḥ prākṛtāt samūlaṃ barhir dāty upamūlalūnaṃ vā /
5.4.11.k.d: इध्माबर्हिर् आहरति द्राघीयः प्राकृतात् समूलं बर्हिर् दात्य् उपमूललूनं वा ।
5.4.11.k.m: he brings the firewood and sacrificial grass; he cuts the sacrificial grass longer than usual, together with the roots, or cut near the roots.

5.4.11.l.m: He ties up two enclosing-sticks, or all [three].

5.4.11.m.m: At the time of arranging the vessels, he sets up the vessels according to need:

5.4.11.n.s: somāya pitṛmate ṣaṭ kapālāni pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo dhānārthaṃ kapālam /
5.4.11.n.d: सोमाय पितृमते षट् कपालानि पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो धानार्थं कपालम् ।
5.4.11.n.m: six potsherds for Soma accompanied by the ancestors; a potsherd for roasted grains for the ancestors seated on the sacrificial grass;

5.4.11.o.s: pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāttebhyo manthārthaṃ vāraṇaṃ pātram̐ śarāvaṃ vā /
5.4.11.o.d: पितृभ्यो ऽग्निष्वात्तेभ्यो मन्थार्थं वारणं पात्रम्̐ शरावं वा ।
5.4.11.o.m: a vessel made of vāraṇa wood or an earthen saucer for the flour-drink for the ancestors consumed by fire.

5.4.11.p.s: nirvapaṇakāle 'dhvaryur dakṣiṇataḥ śakaṭam āruhya prācīnāvītī yavān nirvapati /
5.4.11.p.d: निर्वपणकाले ऽध्वर्युर् दक्षिणतः शकटम् आरुह्य प्राचीनावीती यवान् निर्वपति ।
5.4.11.p.m: At the time of parceling out, the adhvaryu, wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder, having mounted the cart from the south, parcels out barley grains.

5.4.11.q.m: Or [he does so] from the north, wearing the sacred cord over the left shoulder.

5.4.11.r.s: somāya pitṛmate puroḍāśam̐ ṣaṭkapālaṃ nirvapaty ājyaṃ vā /
5.4.11.r.d: सोमाय पितृमते पुरोडाशम्̐ षट्कपालं निर्वपत्य् आज्यं वा ।
5.4.11.r.m: He parcels out a sacrificial cake on six potsherds for Soma accompanied by the ancestors, or clarified butter;

5.4.11.s.s: pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo dhānāḥ pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāttebhyo manthaṃ yamāya mantham ity ekeṣām /
5.4.11.s.d: पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो धानाः पितृभ्यो ऽग्निष्वात्तेभ्यो मन्थं यमाय मन्थम् इत्य् एकेषाम् ।
5.4.11.s.m: roasted grains for the ancestors seated on the sacrificial grass; a flour-drink for the ancestors consumed by fire; according to some, a flour-drink for Yama.

5.4.11.t.m: Having mixed the barley grains with the remainder of the sprinkling water, he pounds them.

5.4.11.u.m: When they are husked three times, having separated [the portion for] the six-potsherd cake with the division mantra, he grinds it.

5.4.11.v.s: dakṣiṇārdhe gārhapatyasya ṣaṭ kapālāny upadhāya prathamena kapālamantreṇa dakṣiṇāgnau bharjanārthaṃ kapālam upadadhāti /
5.4.11.v.d: दक्षिणार्धे गार्हपत्यस्य षट् कपालान्य् उपधाय प्रथमेन कपालमन्त्रेण दक्षिणाग्नौ भर्जनार्थं कपालम् उपदधाति ।
5.4.11.v.m: Having set down six potsherds on the southern half of the gārhapatya fire, he places a potsherd on the dakṣiṇāgni fire for roasting, with the first potsherd mantra.

5.4.11.w.m: Having placed [the cake on] six potsherds [on the fire] and poured [the grains into the potsherd] with the placing mantra, he roasts the barley grains.

5.4.11.x.m: They remain lying so as not to be burned.

5.4.12.a.s: akhātā vedir bhavaty uttaraṃ parigrāhaṃ parigṛhya /
5.4.12.a.d: अखाता वेदिर् भवत्य् उत्तरं परिग्राहं परिगृह्य ।
5.4.12.a.m: The altar is unexcavated; having traced the second boundary,

5.4.12.b.s: saṃpraiṣeṇa pratipadyate yad anyat patnīsaṃnahanāt tat saṃpreṣyati /
5.4.12.b.d: संप्रैषेण प्रतिपद्यते यद् अन्यत् पत्नीसंनहनात् तत् संप्रेष्यति ।
5.4.12.b.m: he proceeds with the ritual direction; whatever is other than the girding of the sacrificer's wife, he directs.

5.4.12.c.s: na patnīm̐ saṃnahyati nānvāste gṛheṣv evāsīnājyam avekṣate /
5.4.12.c.d: न पत्नीम्̐ संनह्यति नान्वास्ते गृहेष्व् एवासीनाज्यम् अवेक्षते ।
5.4.12.c.m: He does not gird the sacrificer's wife, nor does she sit nearby; seated in the house itself, she looks at the clarified butter.

5.4.12.d.s: yat prāg ājyagrahaṇāt tat kṛtvā pratihṛtya gārhapatya ājyāni gṛhṇāti /
5.4.12.d.d: यत् प्राग् आज्यग्रहणात् तत् कृत्वा प्रतिहृत्य गार्हपत्य आज्यानि गृह्णाति ।
5.4.12.d.m: Having done whatever is prior to the taking of clarified butter, having brought [the vessels] back, he takes the clarified butters at the gārhapatya fire.

5.4.12.e.m: All [ladles receive] four ladlefuls, or two in the upabhṛt.

5.4.12.f.s: prokṣaṇīr abhimantrya brahmāṇam āmantryedhmaṃ vediṃ barhiś ca prokṣaṇyavaśeṣaṃ ninīya pavitre apisṛjyāgreṣu barhir gṛhītvā /
5.4.12.f.d: प्रोक्षणीर् अभिमन्त्र्य ब्रह्माणम् आमन्त्र्येध्मं वेदिं बर्हिश् च प्रोक्षण्यवशेषं निनीय पवित्रे अपिसृज्याग्रेषु बर्हिर् गृहीत्वा ।
5.4.12.f.m: Having consecrated the sprinkling waters with a mantra, addressed the brahman priest, [and sprinkled] the kindling wood, the altar, and the sacrificial grass, having poured out the remainder of the sprinkling waters, having inserted the two strainers, and having seized the sacrificial grass by its tips,

5.4.12.g.s: triḥ prasavyam agniṃ dhūnvan paryety aurdhvaḥ prastaras taṃ dhārayamāṇas trir adhūnvan pratiparyeti /
5.4.12.g.d: त्रिः प्रसव्यम् अग्निं धून्वन् पर्येत्य् और्ध्वः प्रस्तरस् तं धारयमाणस् त्रिर् अधून्वन् प्रतिपर्येति ।
5.4.12.g.m: he walks around [the fire] three times counter-clockwise while shaking [the sacrificial grass] toward the fire; holding that high grass bundle upright, he walks back around three times without shaking it.

5.4.12.h.m: He lays down two enclosing sticks, or all [three].

5.4.12.i.s: pratiṣiddhe vidhṛtī tūṣṇīṃ prastaraṃ nyasyaty udvāsanaprabhṛtīni karmāṇi pratipadyate /
5.4.12.i.d: प्रतिषिद्धे विधृती तूष्णीं प्रस्तरं न्यस्यत्य् उद्वासनप्रभृतीनि कर्माणि प्रतिपद्यते ।
5.4.12.i.m: The two separating blades are prohibited; he places down the high grass bundle silently, and proceeds to the rites beginning with the taking off [of the offerings from the fire].

5.4.12.j.m: Having performed what comes before the decoration [of the oblations],

5.4.12.k.s: vibhāgamantreṇa dhānā vibhajya piṣṭānām āvṛtārdhān saktūn kṛtvā /
5.4.12.k.d: विभागमन्त्रेण धाना विभज्य पिष्टानाम् आवृतार्धान् सक्तून् कृत्वा ।
5.4.12.k.m: having divided the roasted grains with the division mantra, and having made groats out of half [of them] according to the procedure for flour,

5.4.12.l.s: abhivānyavatsāyai dugdhe vāraṇe pātre 'rdhaśarāve vekṣuśalākayā dakṣiṇāsīno 'nārabhamāṇas triḥ prasavyaṃ mantham upamanthati śalākāstambaṃ manthaṃ karoti /
5.4.12.l.d: अभिवान्यवत्सायै दुग्धे वारणे पात्रे ऽर्धशरावे वेक्षुशलाकया दक्षिणासीनो ऽनारभमाणस् त्रिः प्रसव्यं मन्थम् उपमन्थति शलाकास्तम्बं मन्थं करोति ।
5.4.12.l.m: in the milk of a cow whose calf has been substituted, in a vessel of Varaṇa wood or in half an earthen dish, seated to the south, not grasping [the vessel], he stirs the beverage three times counter-clockwise with a stalk of sugarcane, and makes the beverage with the bundle of stalks.

5.4.12.m.s: dakṣiṇāgner ekolmukaṃ dhūpāyat parācīnam apareṇa gārhapatyam atyāhṛtyāgreṇāhavanīyaṃ paryāhṛtya dakṣiṇenāhavanīyam antarvedi nidadhāti /
5.4.12.m.d: दक्षिणाग्नेर् एकोल्मुकं धूपायत् पराचीनम् अपरेण गार्हपत्यम् अत्याहृत्याग्रेणाहवनीयं पर्याहृत्य दक्षिणेनाहवनीयम् अन्तर्वेदि निदधाति ।
5.4.12.m.m: Taking a single smoking firebrand from the dakṣiṇāgni fire facing away, carrying it past west of the gārhapatya fire, carrying it around in front of the āhavanīya fire, he places it within the altar south of the āhavanīya fire.

5.4.12.n.m: Having decorated them, he sets down the clarified butter and the sacrificial oblations one by one.

5.4.12.o.s: dakṣiṇata āñjanam abhyañjanaṃ kaśipūpabarhaṇam udakumbhaṃ ca pratiṣṭhāpayati /
5.4.12.o.d: दक्षिणत आञ्जनम् अभ्यञ्जनं कशिपूपबर्हणम् उदकुम्भं च प्रतिष्ठापयति ।
5.4.12.o.m: To the south, he places collyrium, ointment, a grass mat, a pillow, and a jar of water.

5.4.12.p.m: He puts on the sacred cord over the left shoulder if he is wearing the sacred cord over the right shoulder.

5.4.12.q.s: agnaye devebhyaḥ pitṛbhyaḥ samidhyamānāyānubrūhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
5.4.12.q.d: अग्नये देवेभ्यः पितृभ्यः समिध्यमानायानुब्रूहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
5.4.12.q.m: He issues the ritual direction: 'Recite [the introductory verses] for the fire being kindled for the gods, for the ancestors.'

5.4.12.r.s: uśantas tvā havāmahe \\ ity etām̐ sāmidhenīṃ trir anvāha /
5.4.12.r.d: उशन्तस् त्वा हवामहे \\ इत्य् एताम्̐ सामिधेनीं त्रिर् अन्वाह ।
5.4.12.r.m: He recites this kindling verse three times: 'Desiring you, we call upon you.'

5.4.12.s.m: Having divided the kindling wood into three parts, he places all of it [on the fire].

5.4.12.t.s: oḍhāsu devatāsv agnim upavājya sruvāghāram āghārya \\ agnīt paridhīm̐ś cāgniṃ ca tristriḥ saṃmṛḍḍhi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati /
5.4.12.t.d: ओढासु देवतास्व् अग्निम् उपवाज्य स्रुवाघारम् आघार्य \\ अग्नीत् परिधीम्̐श् चाग्निं च त्रिस्त्रिः संमृड्ढि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ।
5.4.12.t.m: When the deities have been conveyed, having fanned the fire and poured the foundational offering with the dipping spoon, he issues the ritual direction: 'Agnīdh, wipe clean the enclosing sticks and the fire three times each.'

5.4.12.u.m: When it has been wiped clean, he chooses the ancestral invocation.

5.4.13.a.m: 'Be seated, hotṛ'—this is the extent of the ancestral invocation.

5.4.13.b.m: He offers the fore-offerings excluding [the one to] the sacrificial grass; he does not bring together [the butter from] the upabhṛt [into the juhū].

5.4.13.c.m: The two clarified butter portions contain [the word] jīvātu ('life').

5.4.13.e.m: they undo their sacred cords and put on the sacred cord over the right shoulder.

5.4.13.f.m: They transpose the clarified butter and the sacrificial oblations.

5.4.13.h.m: To the south of the juhū he sets down the upabhṛt.

5.4.13.i.m: To the south of the upabhṛt, the dhruvā.

5.4.13.j.s: dakṣiṇataḥ puroḍāśaṃ dhānāḥ sādayati dakṣiṇaṃ dhānābhyo mantham /
5.4.13.j.d: दक्षिणतः पुरोडाशं धानाः सादयति दक्षिणं धानाभ्यो मन्थम् ।
5.4.13.j.m: To the south of the sacrificial cake he sets down the roasted grains; to the south of the roasted grains, the beverage.

5.4.13.k.m: The hotṛ, the adhvaryu, and the āgnīdhra step around to the south.

5.4.13.l.m: The brahman priest and the sacrificer [step around] to the north.

5.4.13.m.m: The juhū and the [cake on] six potsherds remain in the same place.

5.4.13.n.m: 'The brahman priest and the sacrificer [remain in the same place],' according to some.

5.4.13.o.m: Having cut off portions from all the sacrificial oblations together, he sacrifices to each single deity.

5.4.13.p.s: juhvām upastīrya puroḍāśād avadāya dhānānām upasaṃgṛhṇīte 'tha manthasya /
5.4.13.p.d: जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य पुरोडाशाद् अवदाय धानानाम् उपसंगृह्णीते ऽथ मन्थस्य ।
5.4.13.p.m: Having made an under-layering in the juhū, having cut off from the sacrificial cake, he takes in addition from the roasted grains, and then from the beverage.

5.4.13.q.s: dvir abhighārayati catur avadānasya triḥ pañcāvattinaḥ /
5.4.13.q.d: द्विर् अभिघारयति चतुर् अवदानस्य त्रिः पञ्चावत्तिनः ।
5.4.13.q.m: He basters twice for one who takes four portions, three times for one who takes five portions.

5.4.13.r.s: somāya pitṛmate 'nu svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati dve puronuvākye anvāhaikaikāṃ yājyām̐ sapraṇave syātām /
5.4.13.r.d: सोमाय पितृमते ऽनु स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति द्वे पुरोनुवाक्ये अन्वाहैकैकां याज्याम्̐ सप्रणवे स्याताम् ।
5.4.13.r.m: He issues the ritual direction: 'Recite svadhā for Soma accompanied by the ancestors.' He recites two introductory verses and one offering verse; they should be with the syllable oṃ.

5.4.13.s.s: paridhīm̐r aporṇu \\ ity ucyamāne dakṣiṇam uttaraṃ paridhiṃ madhyamam upasamasyati /
5.4.13.s.d: परिधीम्̐र् अपोर्णु \\ इत्य् उच्यमाने दक्षिणम् उत्तरं परिधिं मध्यमम् उपसमस्यति ।
5.4.13.s.m: While 'Uncover the enclosing sticks' is being said, he draws together the southern and the northern enclosing sticks toward the middle one.

5.4.13.t.s: udaṅṅ atikramya \\ ā svadhā \\ ity āśrāvayati /
5.4.13.t.d: उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य \\ आ स्वधा \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति ।
5.4.13.t.m: Having stepped across to the north, he causes to be announced: 'To svadhā!'

5.4.13.u.s: astu svadhā \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati somaṃ pitṛmantam̐ svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati ye svadhāmahe \\ ity āgūr bhavati svadhā namas iti vaṣaṭkaroti /
5.4.13.u.d: अस्तु स्वधा \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति सोमं पितृमन्तम्̐ स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ये स्वधामहे \\ इत्य् आगूर् भवति स्वधा नमस् इति वषट्करोति ।
5.4.13.u.m: He responds: 'May there be svadhā.' He issues the ritual direction: '[Sacrifice] svadhā to Soma accompanied by the ancestors.' The call is: 'We who offer svadhā.' He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: 'Svadhā, homage!'

5.4.13.v.m: By this very procedure he performs with the subsequent two [offerings].

5.4.13.w.s: dakṣiṇātikramya juhvām upastīrya dhānānām avadāya puroḍāśād upasaṃgṛhṇīte 'tha manthasya pitṛbhyo barhiṣadbhyo 'nu svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyaty udaṅṅ atikramya \\ ā svadhā \\ ity āśrāvayati \\ astu svadhā \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati pitṝn barhiṣadaḥ svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati ye svadhāmahe \\ ity āgūr bhavati svadhā namas \\ iti vaṣaṭkaroti dakṣiṇātikramya juhvām upastīrya manthād avadāya puroḍāśād upasaṃgṛhnīte 'tha dhānānāṃ pitṛbhyo 'gniṣvāttebhyo 'nu svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyaty udaṅṅ atikramya \\ ā svadhā \\ ity āśrāvayati \\ astu svadhā \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati pitṝn agniṣvāttān svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati ye svadhāmahe \\ ity āgūr bhavati svadhā namas \\ iti vaṣaṭkaroty etenaiva kalpenāgniṃ kavyavāhanam̐ sviṣṭakṛtaṃ yajati dakṣiṇātikramya juhvām upastīrya puroḍāśād avadāya dhānānām upasaṃgṛhṇīte 'tha manthasya agnaye kavyavāhanāya sviṣṭakṛte 'nu svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyaty udaṅṅ atikramya \\ ā svadhā \\ ity āśrāvayati \\ astu svadhā \\ iti pratyāśrāvayati \\ agniṃ kavyavāhanam̐ sviṣṭakṛtam̐ svadhā \\ iti saṃpreṣyati ye svadhāmahe \\ ity āgūr bhavati svadhā namas \\ iti vaṣaṭkaroti //
5.4.13.w.d: दक्षिणातिक्रम्य जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य धानानाम् अवदाय पुरोडाशाद् उपसंगृह्णीते ऽथ मन्थस्य पितृभ्यो बर्हिषद्भ्यो ऽनु स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यत्य् उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य \\ आ स्वधा \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति \\ अस्तु स्वधा \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति पितॄन् बर्हिषदः स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ये स्वधामहे \\ इत्य् आगूर् भवति स्वधा नमस् \\ इति वषट्करोति दक्षिणातिक्रम्य जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य मन्थाद् अवदाय पुरोडाशाद् उपसंगृह्नीते ऽथ धानानां पितृभ्यो ऽग्निष्वात्तेभ्यो ऽनु स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यत्य् उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य \\ आ स्वधा \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति \\ अस्तु स्वधा \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति पितॄन् अग्निष्वात्तान् स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ये स्वधामहे \\ इत्य् आगूर् भवति स्वधा नमस् \\ इति वषट्करोत्य् एतेनैव कल्पेनाग्निं कव्यवाहनम्̐ स्विष्टकृतं यजति दक्षिणातिक्रम्य जुह्वाम् उपस्तीर्य पुरोडाशाद् अवदाय धानानाम् उपसंगृह्णीते ऽथ मन्थस्य अग्नये कव्यवाहनाय स्विष्टकृते ऽनु स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यत्य् उदङ्ङ् अतिक्रम्य \\ आ स्वधा \\ इत्य् आश्रावयति \\ अस्तु स्वधा \\ इति प्रत्याश्रावयति \\ अग्निं कव्यवाहनम्̐ स्विष्टकृतम्̐ स्वधा \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ये स्वधामहे \\ इत्य् आगूर् भवति स्वधा नमस् \\ इति वषट्करोति ॥
5.4.13.w.m: Having stepped across to the south, having made an under-layering in the juhū, having cut off from the roasted grains, he takes in addition from the sacrificial cake, and then from the beverage; he issues the ritual direction: 'Recite svadhā for the ancestors seated on the sacrificial grass.' Having stepped across to the north, he causes to be announced: 'To svadhā!' He responds: 'May there be svadhā.' He issues the ritual direction: '[Sacrifice] svadhā to the ancestors seated on the sacrificial grass.' The call is: 'We who offer svadhā.' He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: 'Svadhā, homage!' Having stepped across to the south, having made an under-layering in the juhū, having cut off from the beverage, he takes in addition from the sacrificial cake, and then from the roasted grains; he issues the ritual direction: 'Recite svadhā for the ancestors consumed by fire.' Having stepped across to the north, he causes to be announced: 'To svadhā!' He responds: 'May there be svadhā.' He issues the ritual direction: '[Sacrifice] svadhā to the ancestors consumed by fire.' The call is: 'We who offer svadhā.' He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: 'Svadhā, homage!' By this very procedure he sacrifices to Agni Kavyavāhana as Sviṣṭakṛt: having stepped across to the south, having made an under-layering in the juhū, having cut off from the sacrificial cake, he takes in addition from the roasted grains, and then from the beverage; he issues the ritual direction: 'Recite svadhā for Agni Kavyavāhana Sviṣṭakṛt.' Having stepped across to the north, he causes to be announced: 'To svadhā!' He responds: 'May there be svadhā.' He issues the ritual direction: '[Sacrifice] svadhā to Agni Kavyavāhana Sviṣṭakṛt.' The call is: 'We who offer svadhā.' He utters the vaṣaṭ-call: 'Svadhā, homage!'

5.4.14.a.m: Some teach [offering only] the beverage as the Sviṣṭakṛt.

5.4.14.d.s: mantham iḍām avadyati manthād iḍām avadyatīty ekeṣām /
5.4.14.d.d: मन्थम् इडाम् अवद्यति मन्थाद् इडाम् अवद्यतीत्य् एकेषाम् ।
5.4.14.d.m: 'He cuts off the beverage as the iḍā,' or 'He cuts off the iḍā from the beverage,' according to some.

5.4.14.e.m: Having left behind the beverage for the purpose of smelling,

5.4.14.f.m: and having gathered the remnants of the sacrificial oblations in the iḍā,

5.4.14.g.s: etat te tata \\ iti tisṛṣu sraktīṣu trīn piṇḍān nidadhāti /
5.4.14.g.d: एतत् ते तत \\ इति तिसृषु स्रक्तीषु त्रीन् पिण्डान् निदधाति ।
5.4.14.g.m: with 'This is for you, father,' he places down three rice balls in three corners [of the altar],

5.4.14.h.m: in the eastern part, in the southern part, and in the western part.

5.4.14.i.m: He wipes off the residue in the northern [part].

5.4.14.j.s: atra pitaro yathābhāgaṃ mandadhvam ity uktvodañco niṣkrāmanti /
5.4.14.j.d: अत्र पितरो यथाभागं मन्दध्वम् इत्य् उक्त्वोदञ्चो निष्क्रामन्ति ।
5.4.14.j.m: Having said: 'Here, O ancestors, exhilarate yourselves, each according to his share,' they step out toward the north.

5.4.14.k.m: Then they approach the āhavanīya fire.

5.4.14.l.s: susaṃdṛśaṃ tvā vayam ity āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhante /
5.4.14.l.d: सुसंदृशं त्वा वयम् इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठन्ते ।
5.4.14.l.m: They attend upon the āhavanīya fire with: 'May we, of good sight, [behold] you.'

5.4.14.n.s: akṣann amīmadanta hi \\ iti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhante /
5.4.14.n.d: अक्षन्न् अमीमदन्त हि \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठन्ते ।
5.4.14.n.m: They attend upon the gārhapatya fire with: 'They have eaten, they have exhilarated themselves.'

5.4.14.o.d: अक्षन् पितरो ऽमीमदन्त पितरस् \\ इति प्रतिपद्यन्ते ।
5.4.14.o.m: They recite: 'The ancestors have eaten, the ancestors have exhilarated themselves.'

5.4.14.q.m: Then the adhvaryu, then the brahman priest, then the āgnīdhra, then the sacrificer.

5.4.14.r.m: 'Having smelled the beverage, the hotṛ pours it inside the altar,' according to some.

5.4.14.s.s: udakumbham ādāya \\ ayā viṣṭhā janayan karvarāṇi \\ iti triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ pariṣiñcan paryeti /
5.4.14.s.d: उदकुम्भम् आदाय \\ अया विष्ठा जनयन् कर्वराणि \\ इति त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं परिषिञ्चन् पर्येति ।
5.4.14.s.m: Taking the jar of water, he walks around clockwise three times, sprinkling [water], with: 'Producing different forms through this...'

5.4.14.t.m: Having placed down the jar, he walks back around three times without sprinkling.

5.4.14.u.s: atrāñjanābhyañjane vāsodānaṃ namaskārān utthāpanīyaṃ pravāhaṇīm̐ sam̐sādhanīṃ manasvatīṃ paṅktiprājāpatyāś ca samāmananti /
5.4.14.u.d: अत्राञ्जनाभ्यञ्जने वासोदानं नमस्कारान् उत्थापनीयं प्रवाहणीम्̐ सम्̐साधनीं मनस्वतीं पङ्क्तिप्राजापत्याश् च समामनन्ति ।
5.4.14.u.m: Here [some teachers] mention the collyrium and ointment, the giving of a garment, the homages, the setting-up verse, the carrying-away verse, the completing verse, the manasvatī verse, and the offerings to Prajāpati in paṅkti metre.

5.4.14.x.m: They push apart the enclosing sticks.

5.4.14.y.m: Having loosened their cords worn over the right shoulder,

5.4.14.z.s: yajñopavītāni kurvata ājyāni havīm̐ṣi ca vipariharanti viparikrāmanty ṛtvijo 'pabarhiṣāv anūyājau yajati devau yaja yaja \\ iti pūrvam anūyājam̐ saṃpreṣyati yaja \\ ity uttaram̐ sūktavākaṃ prati hotā nivītaṃ kurute na patnīḥ saṃyājayanti na samiṣṭayajur juhoti sarvam anyat kriyate //
5.4.14.z.d: यज्ञोपवीतानि कुर्वत आज्यानि हवीम्̐षि च विपरिहरन्ति विपरिक्रामन्त्य् ऋत्विजो ऽपबर्हिषाव् अनूयाजौ यजति देवौ यज यज \\ इति पूर्वम् अनूयाजम्̐ संप्रेष्यति यज \\ इत्य् उत्तरम्̐ सूक्तवाकं प्रति होता निवीतं कुरुते न पत्नीः संयाजयन्ति न समिष्टयजुर् जुहोति सर्वम् अन्यत् क्रियते ॥
5.4.14.z.m: they put their sacred cords over the left shoulder, carry the clarified butters and sacrificial oblations around, and the priests step around. He performs the two after-offerings without sacred grass. He gives the ritual directions: 'Recite the offering verse for the two gods, recite the offering verse,' for the first after-offering, and 'Recite the offering verse' for the second. During the Sūktavāka the hotṛ wears his cord around his neck. They do not perform the Patnīsaṃyājas. He does not offer the Samiṣṭayajus. Everything else is performed.

5.5.15.a.m: He parcels out one-pot-sherd [cakes] dedicated to Rudra, the Traiyambakas, one for each person,

5.5.15.b.m: as many as there are members of the sacrificer's household, including the women, and one more than that.

5.5.15.d.m: They are baked on the southern half of the gārhapatya fire.

5.5.15.e.m: Either having smeared them with clarified butter or without smearing them,

5.5.15.f.m: having taken them down into a basket, two baskets, several baskets, or into a covered chest,

5.5.15.g.s: dakṣiṇāgner ekolmukaṃ dhūpāyat parācīnam apareṇa gārhapatyam atyāhṛtyāgrato haranti /
5.5.15.g.d: दक्षिणाग्नेर् एकोल्मुकं धूपायत् पराचीनम् अपरेण गार्हपत्यम् अत्याहृत्याग्रतो हरन्ति ।
5.5.15.g.m: having fetched a single smoking firebrand turned away from the dakṣiṇāgni fire past the west of the gārhapatya fire, they carry it in front.

5.5.15.h.s: yāvanto gṛhyāḥ smas \\ iti gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate /
5.5.15.h.d: यावन्तो गृह्याः स्मस् \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते ।
5.5.15.h.m: He attends upon the gārhapatya fire with: 'As many as we are of the household...'

5.5.15.i.m: They go to the north-eastern intermediate direction.

5.5.15.j.s: ākhus te rudra paśus \\ iti vrajann evākhūtkara ekaṃ puroḍāśam upavapati /
5.5.15.j.d: आखुस् ते रुद्र पशुस् \\ इति व्रजन्न् एवाखूत्कर एकं पुरोडाशम् उपवपति ।
5.5.15.j.m: While walking, he deposits one sacrificial cake upon a molehill with: 'The mole is your victim, O Rudra.'

5.5.15.k.m: Having set up the single firebrand at a crossroad and strewn around it,

5.5.15.l.s: madhyamena palāśaparṇenāntimena vā sarvebhyaḥ puroḍāśebhyaḥ samavadāyābhighārya \\ eṣa te rudra bhāgas \\ iti juhoti /
5.5.15.l.d: मध्यमेन पलाशपर्णेनान्तिमेन वा सर्वेभ्यः पुरोडाशेभ्यः समवदायाभिघार्य \\ एष ते रुद्र भागस् \\ इति जुहोति ।
5.5.15.l.m: having taken a portion from all the sacrificial cakes with the middle palāśa leaf or the end leaf, and having sprinkled it with clarified butter, he offers it with: 'This is your share, O Rudra...'

5.5.15.m.m: They attend [upon the fire] with the two [mantras beginning]: 'A medicine for the cow...'

5.5.15.n.m: Taking sacrificial cakes, one for each person,

5.5.15.o.s: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe \\ iti triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ catuṣpathaṃ pariyanti /
5.5.15.o.d: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे \\ इति त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं चतुष्पथं परियन्ति ।
5.5.15.o.m: they circumambulate the crossroad three times sunwise with: 'We sacrifice to Tryambaka...'

5.5.15.p.s: tān ūrdhvān udasya bhagavaḥ stha \ bhagasya vo lipsīya \\ iti pratigṛhya parītya yajamānāya samāvapanti /
5.5.15.p.d: तान् ऊर्ध्वान् उदस्य भगवः स्थ \ भगस्य वो लिप्सीय \\ इति प्रतिगृह्य परीत्य यजमानाय समावपन्ति ।
5.5.15.p.m: Tossing them upwards and catching them with: 'You are lordly, may I partake of your fortune,' they walk around and pour them together into the sacrificer's lap.

5.5.15.q.s: yadi yajamānasya duhitā patikāmā syāt sā viparīyāt /
5.5.15.q.d: यदि यजमानस्य दुहिता पतिकामा स्यात् सा विपरीयात् ।
5.5.15.q.m: If the sacrificer has a daughter who desires a husband, she should circumambulate counter-sunwise.

5.5.15.r.s: tryambakaṃ yajāmahe \ sugandhiṃ pativedanam / \ urvārukam iva bandhanāt \\ mṛtyor mukṣīya mā pates \\ iti parikramya japati //
5.5.15.r.d: त्र्यम्बकं यजामहे \ सुगन्धिं पतिवेदनम् । \ उर्वारुकम् इव बन्धनात् \\ मृत्योर् मुक्षीय मा पतेस् \\ इति परिक्रम्य जपति ॥
5.5.15.r.m: Having circumambulated, she whispers: 'We sacrifice to Tryambaka, the sweet-scented finder of a husband; like a cucumber from its stem, may I be freed from death, not from a husband.'

5.5.16.a.s: pūrvayoḥ parikramaṇayor yajamānāya samāvapanty uttame patikāmāyai /
5.5.16.a.d: पूर्वयोः परिक्रमणयोर् यजमानाय समावपन्त्य् उत्तमे पतिकामायै ।
5.5.16.a.m: At the first two circumambulations, they pour them together into the sacrificer's lap; at the last, into that of the [daughter] desiring a husband.

5.5.16.b.m: When she is not present, in all cases [they pour them] into the sacrificer's lap.

5.5.16.c.s: tān mūta upanahya parogavyūtiṃ gatvā vṛkṣa āsajati /
5.5.16.c.d: तान् मूत उपनह्य परोगव्यूतिं गत्वा वृक्ष आसजति ।
5.5.16.c.m: Having tied them up in a basket, he goes beyond a gavyūti and hangs it on a tree,

5.5.16.d.s: eṣa te rudra bhāgas \ taṃ juṣasva tenāvasena paro mūjavato 'tīhi \\ avatatadhanvā pinākahastaḥ kṛttivāsom iti trir avatāmyanti /
5.5.16.d.d: एष ते रुद्र भागस् \ तं जुषस्व तेनावसेन परो मूजवतो ऽतीहि \\ अवततधन्वा पिनाकहस्तः कृत्तिवासोम् इति त्रिर् अवताम्यन्ति ।
5.5.16.d.m: with: 'This is your portion, O Rudra; enjoy it; with this provision go beyond the Mūjavats; with unbent bow, pināka in hand, clad in a skin...' They hold their breath three times.

5.5.16.e.m: Having poured water all around, they return without looking back.

5.5.16.f.m: They purify themselves beyond the cowpen.

5.5.16.g.d: एधो ऽस्य् एधिषीमहि \\ इत्य् आहवनीये समिधो ऽभ्यादधाति ।
5.5.16.g.m: He puts pieces of firewood on the āhavanīya fire with: 'You are fuel, may we thrive...'

5.5.16.h.m: They attend [upon the fire] with: 'I have followed the waters...'

5.5.16.i.m: In the same way, the wife places [fuel] on the gārhapatya fire and attends [upon it].

5.5.16.j.m: Having returned, he parcels out a mess of cooked grain in ghee for Āditya.

5.5.16.k.s: śvo bhūte paurṇamāseneṣṭvodavasāyānudavasāya vā prasūtā devena savitrā \\ ity undanti / yo asyāḥ pṛthivyās tvaci \ nivartayaty oṣadhīs \\ agnir īṣāna ojasā \ varuṇo dhītibhiḥ saha \\ indro marudbhiḥ sakhibhiḥ saha \\ agnis tigmena śociṣā \\ iti nivartanaṃ vāpanaṃ yathā purastāt //
5.5.16.k.d: श्वो भूते पौर्णमासेनेष्ट्वोदवसायानुदवसाय वा प्रसूता देवेन सवित्रा \\ इत्य् उन्दन्ति । यो अस्याः पृथिव्यास् त्वचि \ निवर्तयत्य् ओषधीस् \\ अग्निर् ईषान ओजसा \ वरुणो धीतिभिः सह \\ इन्द्रो मरुद्भिः सखिभिः सह \\ अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \\ इति निवर्तनं वापनं यथा पुरस्तात् ॥
5.5.16.k.m: On the next day, having sacrificed with the Full Moon rite, whether shifting residence or not, they moisten [the sacrificer's hair] with: 'Impelled by the god Savitṛ...' The turning [of the razor] and the shaving are as before, with: 'He who on the surface of this earth / restores the plants, / Agni, ruler by his power, / Varuṇa together with the prayers, / Indra together with the Maruts as his companions, / Agni with sharp brilliance.'

5.6.17.a.s: tato dvyahe tryahe caturahe 'rdhāmāse māsa ṛtau caturṣu vā māseṣu śunāsīrīyeṇa yajate tasya vaiśvadevena kalpo vyākhyātaḥ pañca saṃcarāṇi nirupyaindrāgnaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ nirvapati vaiśvadevaṃ carum indrāya śunāsīrāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālaṃ vāyavyaṃ payaḥ sauryam ekakapālaṃ vāyavyā yavāgūḥ pratidhug vendrāya śunāsīrāya puroḍāśaṃ dvādaśakapālam uttamam eke samāmananti /
5.6.17.a.d: ततो द्व्यहे त्र्यहे चतुरहे ऽर्धामासे मास ऋतौ चतुर्षु वा मासेषु शुनासीरीयेण यजते तस्य वैश्वदेवेन कल्पो व्याख्यातः पञ्च संचराणि निरुप्यैन्द्राग्नं द्वादशकपालं निर्वपति वैश्वदेवं चरुम् इन्द्राय शुनासीराय पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालं वायव्यं पयः सौर्यम् एककपालं वायव्या यवागूः प्रतिधुग् वेन्द्राय शुनासीराय पुरोडाशं द्वादशकपालम् उत्तमम् एके समामनन्ति ।
5.6.17.a.m: Then after two days, three days, four days, a half-month, a month, a season, or four months, he sacrifices with the Śunāsīrīya; its procedure is explained by the Vaiśvadeva; having parceled out the five shared oblations, he parcels out a cake on twelve potsherds for Indra-and-Agni, a mess of cooked grain for the All-gods, a cake on twelve potsherds for Indra Śunāsīra, milk for Vāyu, and a cake on one potsherd for Sūrya; some teach barley gruel or fresh milk for Vāyu, or the cake on twelve potsherds for Indra Śunāsīra as the last.

5.6.17.b.s: sam̐sarpo 'si \\ am̐haspatyāya tvā \\ ity uttamena māsanāmnaikakapālam abhijuhoti /
5.6.17.b.d: सम्̐सर्पो ऽसि \\ अम्̐हस्पत्याय त्वा \\ इत्य् उत्तमेन मासनाम्नैककपालम् अभिजुहोति ।
5.6.17.b.m: He offers over the one-pot-sherd [cake] with the last month-name: 'You are Saṃsarpa; for Aṃhaspatya thee!'

5.6.17.c.s: anuvatsarīṇām̐ svastim āśāste divyaṃ dhāmāśāste \\ iti sūktavākasyāśīṣṣu hotānuvartayati vatsarīṇām iti vā /
5.6.17.c.d: अनुवत्सरीणाम्̐ स्वस्तिम् आशास्ते दिव्यं धामाशास्ते \\ इति सूक्तवाकस्याशीष्षु होतानुवर्तयति वत्सरीणाम् इति वा ।
5.6.17.c.m: In the blessings of the Sūktavāka, the hotṛ adds: 'He prays for well-being for the coming year, he prays for the heavenly abode,' or '...for the year.'

5.6.17.d.s: aparapakṣe samasthan svakāle paurṇamāsayeneṣṭvodavasāyānudavasāya vā prasūtā devena savitrā \\ ity undanti \\ ekaṃ māsam udasṛjat \ parameṣṭhī prajābhyas \ tenābhyo maha āvahat \\ amṛtaṃ martyābhyaḥ \ prajām anu prajāyase \ tad u te martyāmṛtam \\ yena māsā ardhamāsās \\ ṛtavaḥ parivatsarās \\ yena te te prajāpate \\ ījānasya nyavartayan \ tenāham asya brahmaṇā \ nivartayāmi jīvase \\ agnis tigmena śociṣā \\ iti nivartanaṃ vāpanaṃ yathā purastāt //
5.6.17.d.d: अपरपक्षे समस्थन् स्वकाले पौर्णमासयेनेष्ट्वोदवसायानुदवसाय वा प्रसूता देवेन सवित्रा \\ इत्य् उन्दन्ति \\ एकं मासम् उदसृजत् \ परमेष्ठी प्रजाभ्यस् \ तेनाभ्यो मह आवहत् \\ अमृतं मर्त्याभ्यः \ प्रजाम् अनु प्रजायसे \ तद् उ ते मर्त्यामृतम् \\ येन मासा अर्धमासास् \\ ऋतवः परिवत्सरास् \\ येन ते ते प्रजापते \\ ईजानस्य न्यवर्तयन् \ तेनाहम् अस्य ब्रह्मणा \ निवर्तयामि जीवसे \\ अग्निस् तिग्मेन शोचिषा \\ इति निवर्तनं वापनं यथा पुरस्तात् ॥
5.6.17.d.m: The rites conclude in the dark fortnight; having sacrificed at its proper time with the Full Moon rite, whether shifting residence or not, they moisten [his hair] with: 'Impelled by the god Savitṛ...' The turning [of the razor] and the shaving are as before, with: 'Parameṣṭhin released one month / for his creatures; / through it he brought great / immortality to mortals. / Following offspring you are born again; / that indeed, mortal, is your immortality. / With which the months, the half-months, / the seasons, the full years— / with which they shaved you, O Prajāpati, / who had sacrificed, / with that sacred formula I shave / his hair for life; / Agni with sharp brilliance.'

5.6.18.a.m: The Cāturmāsyas come to a conclusion.

5.6.18.b.m: The Phālgunī [full moon] should not overtake him without his having sacrificed with soma.

5.6.18.d.m: In the absence of an animal sacrifice, there is repetition of the Cāturmāsyas.

5.6.18.e.s: vaiśvadevena pásukāmo yajeta yasminn asya vasante bhūyiṣṭhaṃ payaḥ syāt /
5.6.18.e.d: वैश्वदेवेन प्áसुकामो यजेत यस्मिन्न् अस्य वसन्ते भूयिष्ठं पयः स्यात् ।
5.6.18.e.m: One desiring cattle should sacrifice with the Vaiśvadeva in that spring in which he would have abundant milk.

5.6.18.f.s: vaiśvadevena paśukāmo yajeta yāvat sahasraṃ paśūn prāpnuyāt /
5.6.18.f.d: वैश्वदेवेन पशुकामो यजेत यावत् सहस्रं पशून् प्राप्नुयात् ।
5.6.18.f.m: One desiring cattle should sacrifice with the Vaiśvadeva until he obtains a thousand cattle.

5.6.18.g.m: When a thousand have been obtained, he sacrifices with the other [rites] in their proper places.
