6.4.14.j.m: 'Through the divine sacrifice of Indra the averter of hostility, may I be free of rivals'; 'Through the divine sacrifice of Sarasvatī, may I foster speech and food'; 'Through the divine sacrifice of Pūṣan, may I be prosperous and possessed of cattle'; 'Through the divine sacrifice of Aditi, may I bring forth offspring and cattle'; 'Through the divine sacrifice of Heaven and Earth, may I thrive in both worlds, may I attain greatness and firm standing'; 'Through the divine sacrifice of Aryaman, may I nourish the heavenly world'; 'Through the divine sacrifice of the Viśvedevas, may I attain union with the vital breaths'; 'Through the divine sacrifice of Indra possessed of power, may I be possessed of power and cattle'; 'Through the divine sacrifice of Indra the protector, may I be protected'—these are the accompanying recitations expressly handed down.

6.5.15.a.m: We shall explain the sacrificer's duties for the establishment of the sacred fires.

6.5.15.b.s: purastād brāhmaudanikāt keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayate nakhāni nikṛntate dato dhāvate snāty ahataṃ vāsaḥ paridhatte /
6.5.15.b.d: पुरस्ताद् ब्राह्मौदनिकात् केशश्मश्रूणि वापयते नखानि निकृन्तते दतो धावते स्नात्य् अहतं वासः परिधत्ते ।
6.5.15.b.m: Before the rice mess for the brāhmaṇas, he has his head and beard shaved, cuts his nails, cleans his teeth, bathes, and puts on an unwashed garment.

6.5.15.c.m: To those who have eaten the rice mess for the brāhmaṇas, he gives a wish-boon.

6.5.15.d.m: When the firewood sticks have been placed on [the fire], he gives a pair [of animals] that have not yet discharged semen.

6.5.15.e.m: He does not travel, nor does he stay away from home.

6.5.15.f.m: They do not carry fire out from his house,

6.5.15.h.m: He keeps awake that night with amusements.

6.5.15.i.s: śalkair agnim indhānas \\ ubhau lokau sanem aham / \ ubhayor lokayor ṛddhvā \\ ati mṛtyuṃ tarāmy aham iti śalkais tām̐ rātrim agnim indhe /
6.5.15.i.d: शल्कैर् अग्निम् इन्धानस् \\ उभौ लोकौ सनेम् अहम् । \ उभयोर् लोकयोर् ऋद्ध्वा \\ अति मृत्युं तराम्य् अहम् इति शल्कैस् ताम्̐ रात्रिम् अग्निम् इन्धे ।
6.5.15.i.m: With 'Kindling the fire with chips, / may I win both worlds; / having prospered in both worlds, / may I cross beyond death,' he kindles the fire with chips that whole night.

6.5.15.j.s: mahī viśpatnī sadane ṛtasya \\ arvācī etaṃ dharuṇe rayīṇām / \ antarvatnī janyaṃ jātavedasam \ adhvarāṇāṃ janayathaḥ purogām ity araṇī pradīyamāne pratīkṣate \\ ārohataṃ daśatam̐ śakvarīr mama \\ ṛtenāgna āyuṣā varcasā saha / \ jyog jīvanta uttarāmuttarām̐ samām \\ darśam ahaṃ pūrṇamāsaṃ yajñaṃ yathā yajai \\ iti pratigṛhṇāti \\ ṛtviyavatī stho agniretasau \ garbhaṃ dadhāthāṃ te vām ahaṃ dade \ tat satyaṃ yad vīraṃ bibhṛthas \\ vīraṃ janayiṣyathaḥ / \ te mat prātaḥ prajanayiṣyethe \ te mā prajāte prajanayiṣyathaḥ / \ prajayā paśubhir brahmavarcasena suvarge loke \\ iti pratigṛhyābhimantrayate /
6.5.15.j.d: मही विश्पत्नी सदने ऋतस्य \\ अर्वाची एतं धरुणे रयीणाम् । \ अन्तर्वत्नी जन्यं जातवेदसम् \ अध्वराणां जनयथः पुरोगाम् इत्य् अरणी प्रदीयमाने प्रतीक्षते \\ आरोहतं दशतम्̐ शक्वरीर् मम \\ ऋतेनाग्न आयुषा वर्चसा सह । \ ज्योग् जीवन्त उत्तरामुत्तराम्̐ समाम् \\ दर्शम् अहं पूर्णमासं यज्ञं यथा यजै \\ इति प्रतिगृह्णाति \\ ऋत्वियवती स्थो अग्निरेतसौ \ गर्भं दधाथां ते वाम् अहं ददे \ तत् सत्यं यद् वीरं बिभृथस् \\ वीरं जनयिष्यथः । \ ते मत् प्रातः प्रजनयिष्येथे \ ते मा प्रजाते प्रजनयिष्यथः । \ प्रजया पशुभिर् ब्रह्मवर्चसेन सुवर्गे लोके \\ इति प्रतिगृह्याभिमन्त्रयते ।
6.5.15.j.m: With the words, 'Great, mistress of the clan, in the seat of truth, / turned hither, come into this support of riches; / pregnant, you two shall engender for the sacrifices / Jātavedas, born of the people, the leader,' he looks upon the two kindling sticks as they are being handed over. / With the words, 'Mount my ten powerful [fingers], / with truth, O Agni, with life, with splendour, / so that, living long through each following year, / I may perform the New- and Full-Moon sacrifice,' he accepts [them]. / Having accepted [them], he addresses [them] with the words, 'You two have the seasonal period, having the seed of Agni; / you two bear an embryo; I take you two. / That is true: since you bear a hero, / you shall give birth to a hero. / You two shall be generated from me in the morning; / born, you shall generate for me / offspring, cattle, Vedic spiritual lustre, in the heavenly world.'

6.5.15.k.s: ātmann agniṃ gṛhṇīte yathādhvaryus \\ idam aham anṛtāt satyam upaimi \ satyān mānuṣam upaimi \ mānuṣād daivyam upaimi \ daivīṃ vācaṃ yacchāmi \\ iti vācaṃ yacchati prajāpates tvā prāṇenābhiprāṇimi pūṣṇaḥ poṣeṇa mahyam / \ dīrghāyutvāya śataśāradāya śatam̐ śaradbhya āyuṣe varcase jīvātvai puṇyāya \\ iti jātam abhiprāṇiti \\ ahaṃ tvad asmi mad asi tvam etat \\ mamāsi yonis tava yonir asmi / \ mamaiva san vaha havyāny agne \ putraḥ pitre lokakṛj jātavedas \\ iti jātam abhimantrya varaṃ dadāti /
6.5.15.k.d: आत्मन्न् अग्निं गृह्णीते यथाध्वर्युस् \\ इदम् अहम् अनृतात् सत्यम् उपैमि \ सत्यान् मानुषम् उपैमि \ मानुषाद् दैव्यम् उपैमि \ दैवीं वाचं यच्छामि \\ इति वाचं यच्छति प्रजापतेस् त्वा प्राणेनाभिप्राणिमि पूष्णः पोषेण मह्यम् । \ दीर्घायुत्वाय शतशारदाय शतम्̐ शरद्भ्य आयुषे वर्चसे जीवात्वै पुण्याय \\ इति जातम् अभिप्राणिति \\ अहं त्वद् अस्मि मद् असि त्वम् एतत् \\ ममासि योनिस् तव योनिर् अस्मि । \ ममैव सन् वह हव्यान्य् अग्ने \ पुत्रः पित्रे लोककृज् जातवेदस् \\ इति जातम् अभिमन्त्र्य वरं ददाति ।
6.5.15.k.m: He takes the fire into himself in the same manner as the adhvaryu. / With the words, 'Here I enter from falsehood into truth; / from truth I enter into human [speech]; / from human [speech] I enter into divine [speech]; / I restrain divine speech,' he restrains speech. With the words, 'With the breath of Prajāpati I breathe upon thee, with the nourishment of Pūṣan for me, / for long life, of a hundred autumns, for a life of a hundred autumns, for splendour, for survival, for merit,' he breathes upon the [fire] born. / Having addressed the [fire] born with the words, 'I am from thee, thou art from me; / thou art my womb, I am thy womb; / being my own, O Agni, convey the oblations, / as a son for his father, creating a world, O Jātavedas,' he gives a choice gift.

6.5.15.l.s: vācaṃ visṛjate 'tra kṣaume vāsasī paridadhāte yajamānaḥ patnī ca /
6.5.15.l.d: वाचं विसृजते ऽत्र क्षौमे वाससी परिदधाते यजमानः पत्नी च ।
6.5.15.l.m: He releases speech. At this point the sacrificer and the sacrificer's wife put on two linen garments.

6.5.15.m.s: te apavṛtte 'gnyādheye 'dhvaryave datto yābhyāṃyābhyāṃ vyāhṛtībhyāṃ yenayena yatharṣy ādhānena yābhyāṃyābhyām̐ sārparājñībhyāṃ yenayena ca gharmaśirasā dadhāti sarvatra tenatenopatiṣṭhate //
6.5.15.m.d: ते अपवृत्ते ऽग्न्याधेये ऽध्वर्यवे दत्तो याभ्यांयाभ्यां व्याहृतीभ्यां येनयेन यथर्ष्य् आधानेन याभ्यांयाभ्याम्̐ सार्पराज्ञीभ्यां येनयेन च घर्मशिरसा दधाति सर्वत्र तेनतेनोपतिष्ठते ॥
6.5.15.m.m: When the establishment of the fires is concluded, those two [garments] are given to the adhvaryu. With whichever two mystical utterances, with whichever establishment [rite] according to the ṛṣis, with whichever two Sārparājñī [verses], and with whichever Gharmaśiras [formula] he establishes [the fire], he worships [it] everywhere with each corresponding one.

6.5.16.a.s: sugārhapatyo vidahann arātīs \\ uṣasaḥ śreyasīḥśreyasīr dadhat / \ agne sapatnām̐ apabādhamānas \\ rāyaspoṣam iṣam ūrjam asmāsu dhehi \\ ity āhitaṃ gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate \\ imā u māmupatiṣṭhantu rāyas \\ ābhiḥ prajābhiriha saṃvaseya / \ iho iḍā tiṣṭhatu viśvarūpī \ madhye vasor dīdihi jātavedas \\ iti madhyadeśe hriyamāṇam abhimantrayate samayārdhe varaṃ dadāti \\ ānaśe vyānaśe \ sarvam āyur vyānaśe \\ ity āhitam āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate /
6.5.16.a.d: सुगार्हपत्यो विदहन्न् अरातीस् \\ उषसः श्रेयसीःश्रेयसीर् दधत् । \ अग्ने सपत्नाम्̐ अपबाधमानस् \\ रायस्पोषम् इषम् ऊर्जम् अस्मासु धेहि \\ इत्य् आहितं गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते \\ इमा उ मामुपतिष्ठन्तु रायस् \\ आभिः प्रजाभिरिह संवसेय । \ इहो इडा तिष्ठतु विश्वरूपी \ मध्ये वसोर् दीदिहि जातवेदस् \\ इति मध्यदेशे ह्रियमाणम् अभिमन्त्रयते समयार्धे वरं ददाति \\ आनशे व्यानशे \ सर्वम् आयुर् व्यानशे \\ इत्य् आहितम् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते ।
6.5.16.a.m: With the words, 'Having a good domestic fire, burning up enemies, / bringing ever better dawns, / O Agni, repelling rivals, / establish among us increase of wealth, food, and sap,' he worships the established gārhapatya fire. / With the words, 'May these riches attend on me; / may I live here together with these offspring; / may all-formed Iḍā stand here; / shine forth in the midst of wealth, O Jātavedas,' he addresses [the fire] being carried in the middle region; halfway, he gives a choice gift. / With the words, 'It has reached, it has spread out, / it has completely pervaded full life,' he worships the established āhavanīya fire.

6.5.16.b.s: ye te agne śive tanuvau virāṭ ca svarāṭ ca te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām \\ ye te agne śive tanuvau samrāṭ cābhibhūś ca te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām \\ ye te agne śive tanuvau vibhūś ca paribhūś ca te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām \\ ye te agne śive tanuvau prabhvī ca prabhūtiś ca te mā viśatāṃ te mā jinvatām \\ yās te agne śivās tanuvas tābhis tvā dadhe \\ iti śivābhis tanūbhir āhitam āhavanīyam upatiṣṭhate snik ca snīhitiś ca snihitiś ca \ sadāmnī cāmatiś cānāhutiś ca nirṛtis \\ etās te agne ghorās tanuvo 'martyo martyas tān gacchantu yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas \\ iti purastāt pūrṇāhuterghorābhir upatiṣṭhate pūrṇāhutau varaṃ dadāty upariṣṭāt pūrṇāhuteḥ śivābhir upasthāya /
6.5.16.b.d: ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ विराट् च स्वराट् च ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् \\ ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ सम्राट् चाभिभूश् च ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् \\ ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ विभूश् च परिभूश् च ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् \\ ये ते अग्ने शिवे तनुवौ प्रभ्वी च प्रभूतिश् च ते मा विशतां ते मा जिन्वताम् \\ यास् ते अग्ने शिवास् तनुवस् ताभिस् त्वा दधे \\ इति शिवाभिस् तनूभिर् आहितम् आहवनीयम् उपतिष्ठते स्निक् च स्नीहितिश् च स्निहितिश् च \ सदाम्नी चामतिश् चानाहुतिश् च निरृतिस् \\ एतास् ते अग्ने घोरास् तनुवो ऽमर्त्यो मर्त्यस् तान् गच्छन्तु यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस् \\ इति पुरस्तात् पूर्णाहुतेर्घोराभिर् उपतिष्ठते पूर्णाहुतौ वरं ददात्य् उपरिष्टात् पूर्णाहुतेः शिवाभिर् उपस्थाय ।
6.5.16.b.m: With the auspicious bodies, [saying,] 'Which two auspicious bodies are thine, O Agni, the Virāj and the Svarāj, may they two enter me, may they two invigorate me; / which two auspicious bodies are thine, O Agni, the Samrāj and the Abhibhū, may they two enter me, may they two invigorate me; / which two auspicious bodies are thine, O Agni, the Vibhū and the Paribhū, may they two enter me, may they two invigorate me; / which two auspicious bodies are thine, O Agni, the Prabhvī and the Prabhūti, may they two enter me, may they two invigorate me; / with those auspicious bodies that are thine, O Agni, I establish thee,' he worships the established āhavanīya fire. / Before the full-spill offering, he worships [it] with the terrible [bodies, saying,] 'Snik and Snīhiti and Snihiti, / Sadāmnī and Amati and Anāhuti and Nirṛti: / these are thy terrible bodies, O Agni; may they, immortal, go to the mortal / who hates us and whom we hate.' At the full-spill offering he gives a choice gift, having worshipped with the auspicious [bodies] after the full-spill offering.

6.5.16.c.s: virājakramair upatiṣṭhate \\ atharva pituṃ me gopāya \\ annaṃ prāṇena saṃmitam / \ tvayā guptā iṣam ūrjaṃ madantaḥ \ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ savīrās \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim \\
6.5.16.c.d: विराजक्रमैर् उपतिष्ठते \\ अथर्व पितुं मे गोपाय \\ अन्नं प्राणेन संमितम् । \ त्वया गुप्ता इषम् ऊर्जं मदन्तः \ शतं जीवेम शरदः सवीरास् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् \\
6.5.16.c.m: He worships with the Virāj-steps: / with the words, 'O Atharvan, protect my food, / the nourishment measured with the breath; / guarded by thee, revelling in food and sap, / may we live a hundred autumns, accompanied by heroes,' [he worships] the dakṣiṇāgni fire;

6.5.16.d.s: narya prajāṃ me gopāya \ mūlaṃ lokasya saṃtatim / \ ātmano hṛdayān nirmitām \\ tāṃ te paridadāmy aham iti gārhapatyam \\
6.5.16.d.d: नर्य प्रजां मे गोपाय \ मूलं लोकस्य संततिम् । \ आत्मनो हृदयान् निर्मिताम् \\ तां ते परिददाम्य् अहम् इति गार्हपत्यम् \\
6.5.16.d.m: with the words, 'O Narya, protect my offspring, / the root of the world, the lineage / fashioned from my own heart; / that I commit to thee,' [he worships] the gārhapatya fire;

6.5.16.e.s: śam̐sya paśūn me gopāya \ viśvarūpaṃ dhanaṃ vasu / \ gṛhāṇāṃ puṣṭim ānandam \\ tām̐s te paridadāmy aham ity āhavanīyam \\
6.5.16.e.d: शम्̐स्य पशून् मे गोपाय \ विश्वरूपं धनं वसु । \ गृहाणां पुष्टिम् आनन्दम् \\ ताम्̐स् ते परिददाम्य् अहम् इत्य् आहवनीयम् \\
6.5.16.e.m: with the words, 'O Śaṃsya, protect my cattle, / the multiform wealth, the treasure, / the nourishment of the home, the delight; / those I commit to thee,' [he worships] the āhavanīya fire;

6.5.16.f.s: sapratha sabhāṃ me gopāya \\ indriyaṃ bhūtivardhanam / \ viśvajanasya chāyām \\ tāṃ te paridadāmy aham iti sapratha sabhāṃ me gopāya \ ye ca sabhyāḥ sabhāsadaḥ / \ tān indriyāvataḥ kuru \ sarvam āyur upāsatām iti sabhyam
6.5.16.f.d: सप्रथ सभां मे गोपाय \\ इन्द्रियं भूतिवर्धनम् । \ विश्वजनस्य छायाम् \\ तां ते परिददाम्य् अहम् इति सप्रथ सभां मे गोपाय \ ये च सभ्याः सभासदः । \ तान् इन्द्रियावतः कुरु \ सर्वम् आयुर् उपासताम् इति सभ्यम्
6.5.16.f.m: with the words, 'O Saprathas, protect my assembly, / the vigor that increases prosperity, / the shade of all people; / that I commit to thee; / O Saprathas, protect my assembly / and those who belong to the assembly, who sit in the assembly; / make them endowed with vigor; / may they attend during their full life,' [he worships] the sabhya fire;

6.5.16.g.s: ahe budhniya mantraṃ me gopāya \ śriyaṃ ca yaśasā saha / \ ahaye budhniyāya mantraṃ śriyai \ yaśaḥ paridadāmy aham ity āvasathyam \\
6.5.16.g.d: अहे बुध्निय मन्त्रं मे गोपाय \ श्रियं च यशसा सह । \ अहये बुध्नियाय मन्त्रं श्रियै \ यशः परिददाम्य् अहम् इत्य् आवसथ्यम् \\
6.5.16.g.m: with the words, 'O Ahi Budhnya, protect my mantra, / and prosperity together with fame; / to Ahi Budhnya I commit the mantra, / to prosperity, fame,' [he worships] the āvasathya fire;

6.5.16.h.s: pañcadhāgnīn vyakrāmat \\ virāṭ sṛṣṭā prajāpateḥ / \ ūrdhvārohad rohiṇī \ yonir agneḥ pratiṣṭhitis \\ iti sarvān /
6.5.16.h.d: पञ्चधाग्नीन् व्यक्रामत् \\ विराट् सृष्टा प्रजापतेः । \ ऊर्ध्वारोहद् रोहिणी \ योनिर् अग्नेः प्रतिष्ठितिस् \\ इति सर्वान् ।
6.5.16.h.m: with the words, 'The Virāj, created by Prajāpati, / strode forth fivefold across the fires; / Rohiṇī mounted upward, / the womb of Agni, the firm foundation,' [he worships] all [the fires].

6.5.17.a.s: śatam akṣān prayacchati teṣu kṛtaṃ vijitya sabhāsadbhyaḥ prayacchati te yaj jayanti tad ubhayam annam̐ sam̐skṛtya brāhmaṇān bhojayati /
6.5.17.a.d: शतम् अक्षान् प्रयच्छति तेषु कृतं विजित्य सभासद्भ्यः प्रयच्छति ते यज् जयन्ति तद् उभयम् अन्नम्̐ सम्̐स्कृत्य ब्राह्मणान् भोजयति ।
6.5.17.a.m: He gives one hundred dice to him; having won the winning throw (kṛta) among them, he gives [the stake] to the members of the assembly; whatever they win, having prepared both as food, he feeds the brāhmaṇas.

6.5.17.b.s: āgneyasya dakṣiṇākāle 'jaṃ pūrṇapātram upabarhaṇam̐ sārvasūtram aśvam̐ rathaṃ vāsaḥ ṣaṅgā dvādaśa caturvim̐śatir aparimitā vardhamānā dadāti tāsāṃ dhenur anaḍvān mithunau cādiṣṭarūpāṇy ajaṃ pūrṇapātram upabarhaṇaṃ cāgnīdhe dadāty aśvaṃ brahmaṇe dhenum̐ hotre gārhapatyadeśe 'naḍvāham āhavanīyadeśe 'dhvaryave śeṣaḥ sādhāraṇas trim̐śanmāne pūrvayoḥ pavamānahaviṣor hiraṇye dakṣiṇāṃ dadāti catvārim̐śanmānam uttame dhenum āditye /
6.5.17.b.d: आग्नेयस्य दक्षिणाकाले ऽजं पूर्णपात्रम् उपबर्हणम्̐ सार्वसूत्रम् अश्वम्̐ रथं वासः षङ्गा द्वादश चतुर्विम्̐शतिर् अपरिमिता वर्धमाना ददाति तासां धेनुर् अनड्वान् मिथुनौ चादिष्टरूपाण्य् अजं पूर्णपात्रम् उपबर्हणं चाग्नीधे ददात्य् अश्वं ब्रह्मणे धेनुम्̐ होत्रे गार्हपत्यदेशे ऽनड्वाहम् आहवनीयदेशे ऽध्वर्यवे शेषः साधारणस् त्रिम्̐शन्माने पूर्वयोः पवमानहविषोर् हिरण्ये दक्षिणां ददाति चत्वारिम्̐शन्मानम् उत्तमे धेनुम् आदित्ये ।
6.5.17.b.m: At the time of the sacrificial gift for the cake to Agni, he gives a goat, a full vessel, a pillow filled with all kinds of threads, a horse, a chariot, a garment, six, twelve, twenty-four, or unmeasured [cattle] increasing in number; of these, a milch cow, a draft ox, and a pair are the specified forms: he gives the goat, the full vessel, and the pillow to the āgnīdhra; the horse to the brahman priest; the cow to the hotṛ; the draft ox in the region of the gārhapatya fire, [and in] the region of the āhavanīya fire to the adhvaryu; the remainder is shared in common; for the first two Pavamāna oblations he gives a sacrificial gift of gold weighing thirty units; a [piece of gold] weighing forty units for the last; a cow for the cake to Aditi.

6.5.17.c.m: From the establishment [of the fires] onwards, he should not speak falsehood for the rest of his life.

6.5.17.d.m: A brāhmaṇa should not stay in his house without having eaten.

6.5.17.e.m: He should not turn away for lodging a guest who arrives at sunset.

6.5.17.f.m: At night, he should not give anything other than food.

6.5.17.g.m: Giving food, he should not eat at night.

6.5.17.h.m: He should not eat [food] cooked in an earthen oven.

6.5.17.i.s: yā antar nāvyā āpas tāsāṃ nāśnīyat /
6.5.17.i.d: या अन्तर् नाव्या आपस् तासां नाश्नीयत् ।
6.5.17.i.m: He should not drink of the waters that are within a navigable river.

6.5.17.j.m: He should not give white gold (silver) on the sacrificial grass.

6.5.17.k.m: He should not put wet wood [on the fire], or he may put [it].

6.5.17.l.m: He should not dwell in a natural salt flat or a fissure.

6.5.17.m.m: Having uttered 'hiṃ', he should unite with his wife with restrained speech,

6.5.17.o.m: During this year, without having sacrificed with an animal [sacrifice], he should not eat meat unless instructed.

6.5.17.p.s: yadi bhakṣayen manasāgnibhyaḥ prahiṇomi bhakṣam \\ mama vācā taṃ saha bhakṣayantu / \ apramādyann apramattaś carāmi \ śivena manasā saha bhakṣayata \\ ity uktvādiṣṭo bhakṣayati /
6.5.17.p.d: यदि भक्षयेन् मनसाग्निभ्यः प्रहिणोमि भक्षम् \\ मम वाचा तं सह भक्षयन्तु । \ अप्रमाद्यन्न् अप्रमत्तश् चरामि \ शिवेन मनसा सह भक्षयत \\ इत्य् उक्त्वादिष्टो भक्षयति ।
6.5.17.p.m: If he should eat, having uttered: "With my mind I dispatch the portion to the fires; / let them eat it together with my speech. / Not being heedless, heedful I walk; / eat together with an auspicious mind," [thus] directed, he eats.

6.5.17.q.s: dvādaśarātram ajasreṣv agniṣv ājyena svayam agnihotraṃ juhoti /
6.5.17.q.d: द्वादशरात्रम् अजस्रेष्व् अग्निष्व् आज्येन स्वयम् अग्निहोत्रं जुहोति ।
6.5.17.q.m: For twelve nights he offers the Agnihotra himself with clarified butter into the unextinguished fires.

6.5.17.u.m: On the thirteenth [day], he makes the offering himself.

6.5.17.v.s: yāṃ prathamām agnihotrāya duhanti sāgnihotrasya dakṣiṇā /
6.5.17.v.d: यां प्रथमाम् अग्निहोत्राय दुहन्ति साग्निहोत्रस्य दक्षिणा ।
6.5.17.v.m: The cow which they milk first for the Agnihotra is the sacrificial fee for the Agnihotra.

6.5.17.w.s: mithunau gāvāv anvārambhaṇīyāyāṃ dadāty ubhayīḥ punarādheya agnyādheyikīr dattvā paunarādheyikīr dadāti punarniṣkṛto rathaḥ punarutsyūtaṃ vāsaḥ punarutsṛṣṭo 'naḍvāñ śatamānaṃ ca hiraṇyaṃ punarādheyasya dakṣiṇāpi vā paunarādheyikīr eva dadyād iti paiṅgyabrāhmaṇam //
6.5.17.w.d: मिथुनौ गावाव् अन्वारम्भणीयायां ददात्य् उभयीः पुनराधेय अग्न्याधेयिकीर् दत्त्वा पौनराधेयिकीर् ददाति पुनर्निष्कृतो रथः पुनरुत्स्यूतं वासः पुनरुत्सृष्टो ऽनड्वाञ् शतमानं च हिरण्यं पुनराधेयस्य दक्षिणापि वा पौनराधेयिकीर् एव दद्याद् इति पैङ्ग्यब्राह्मणम् ॥
6.5.17.w.m: At the Anvārambhaṇīyā rite he gives a pair of cattle; having given both [kinds of fees]—those pertaining to the setting up of the fires and those pertaining to the re-establishment of the fires—at the re-establishment of the fires, he gives a repaired chariot, a resewn garment, a re-released ox, and a gold piece of one hundred mānas as the sacrificial fee for the re-establishment of the fires; or rather, he should give only those pertaining to the re-establishment of the fires, so states the Paiṅgya-Brāhmaṇa.

6.6.18.a.s: agnihotrasya yājamānaṃ vyākhyāsyāmaḥ svayam idhmam āharan /
6.6.18.a.d: अग्निहोत्रस्य याजमानं व्याख्यास्यामः स्वयम् इध्मम् आहरन् ।
6.6.18.a.m: We shall explain the duties of the sacrificer for the Agnihotra: bringing the firewood himself,

6.6.18.b.s: viśvadānīm ābharantas \\ anātureṇa manasā / \ agne mā te prativeśā riṣāma \\ iti vihāram abhyeti /
6.6.18.b.d: विश्वदानीम् आभरन्तस् \\ अनातुरेण मनसा । \ अग्ने मा ते प्रतिवेशा रिषाम \\ इति विहारम् अभ्येति ।
6.6.18.b.m: he approaches the sacrificial area with [the verse]: "Bringing ever [firewood] with an untroubled mind, / O Agni, may we, your neighbours, not suffer harm."

6.6.18.c.s: yad agne yāni kāni ca \\ iti pratimantram āhavanīye varṣiṣṭham idhmam ādadhāti /
6.6.18.c.d: यद् अग्ने यानि कानि च \\ इति प्रतिमन्त्रम् आहवनीये वर्षिष्ठम् इध्मम् आदधाति ।
6.6.18.c.m: With the mantras beginning: "Whatever, O Agni..." [and] "Whatever [wrongs]...", he places the largest firewood stick on the āhavanīya fire with each respective mantra.

6.6.18.d.m: He addresses [the fire] being taken out with: "Take out!"

6.6.18.e.s: uddharaṇaprabhṛti nāśnīyād āhomāt \\ vidyud asi \\ ity apa upaspṛśyāpareṇāhavanīyaṃ dakṣiṇātikramya dakṣiṇata upaviśati patnī patnyā loka iḍāsi vratabhṛt \\ ahaṃ nāv ubhayor vrataṃ cariṣyāmi \\ āditya vratabhṛt \\ ahaṃ nāv ubhayor vrataṃ cariṣyāmi \ surūpe \\ ahaṃ nāv ubhayor vrataṃ cariṣyāmi \\ iḍa ehi \ mayi śrayasva \\ iti yad agnihotryāṃ vrataṃ tad ātman kurute /
6.6.18.e.d: उद्धरणप्रभृति नाश्नीयाद् आहोमात् \\ विद्युद् असि \\ इत्य् अप उपस्पृश्यापरेणाहवनीयं दक्षिणातिक्रम्य दक्षिणत उपविशति पत्नी पत्न्या लोक इडासि व्रतभृत् \\ अहं नाव् उभयोर् व्रतं चरिष्यामि \\ आदित्य व्रतभृत् \\ अहं नाव् उभयोर् व्रतं चरिष्यामि \ सुरूपे \\ अहं नाव् उभयोर् व्रतं चरिष्यामि \\ इड एहि \ मयि श्रयस्व \\ इति यद् अग्निहोत्र्यां व्रतं तद् आत्मन् कुरुते ।
6.6.18.e.m: From the taking out [of the fire] onward, he must not eat until the offering. Having touched water with: "You are lightning," [and] having stepped past the āhavanīya fire to the south, the sacrificer's wife sits down to the south in the seat of the wife with: "You are Iḍā, bearer of the ritual observance; / I shall observe the ritual observance of both of us. / O Āditya, bearer of the ritual observance; / I shall observe the ritual observance of both of us. / O beautiful one; / I shall observe the ritual observance of both of us. / Come, Iḍā; / rest in me." Thus she takes upon herself whatever ritual observance belongs to the Agnihotra cow.

6.6.18.f.s: śraddha ehi \ satyena tvāhvayāmi \\ ity āhūyamānām iyam asi tasyās te 'gnir vatsaḥ sā me svargaṃ ca lokam ubhayaṃ ca dhukṣva \\ iti duhyamānām om unneṣyāmi \\ unnayāmi \\ iti vocyamāne havir devānām asi \ mṛtyor me 'bhayam̐ svasti me 'stu \\ abhayṃ me astu \\ ity upām̐śūktvā \\ om unnaya \\ ity uccaiḥ pratyāhonnīyamāne tiṣṭhati na caṃkramyate vācaṃ yacchaty ā homād unnīta upaviśati /
6.6.18.f.d: श्रद्ध एहि \ सत्येन त्वाह्वयामि \\ इत्य् आहूयमानाम् इयम् असि तस्यास् ते ऽग्निर् वत्सः सा मे स्वर्गं च लोकम् उभयं च धुक्ष्व \\ इति दुह्यमानाम् ओम् उन्नेष्यामि \\ उन्नयामि \\ इति वोच्यमाने हविर् देवानाम् असि \ मृत्योर् मे ऽभयम्̐ स्वस्ति मे ऽस्तु \\ अभय्ं मे अस्तु \\ इत्य् उपाम्̐शूक्त्वा \\ ओम् उन्नय \\ इत्य् उच्चैः प्रत्याहोन्नीयमाने तिष्ठति न चंक्रम्यते वाचं यच्छत्य् आ होमाद् उन्नीत उपविशति ।
6.6.18.f.m: With: "Faith, come; / I summon you with truth," [he addresses the cow] being summoned. With: "You are this [earth]; Agni is your calf; milk both the heavenly world and [this world] for me," [he addresses her] being milked. When it is spoken: "Om! I will draw [the milk] out," [or] "I draw [the milk] out," having muttered inaudibly: "You are the sacrificial oblation of the gods; / may I have freedom from fear of death; may it be well with me; / may I have freedom from fear," he responds aloud: "Om, draw [it] out!" While it is being drawn out, he stands; he does not walk around; he restrains his speech until the offering; once it is drawn out, he sits down.

6.6.18.g.m: Having risen near the later offering, slightly sideways, as it were,

6.6.18.h.m: he attends upon the āhavanīya fire with all the attendance mantras:

6.6.18.i.s: upaprayanto adhvaram iti ṣaḍbhis tāsām agnīṣomīyayā pūrvapakṣa upatiṣṭhetaindrāgnyāparapakṣe /
6.6.18.i.d: उपप्रयन्तो अध्वरम् इति षड्भिस् तासाम् अग्नीषोमीयया पूर्वपक्ष उपतिष्ठेतैन्द्राग्न्यापरपक्षे ।
6.6.18.i.m: with the six [verses] beginning: "Approaching the sacrifice..."; of these, he should attend with the verse addressed to Agni-and-Soma during the first half of the month, and with the verse addressed to Indra-and-Agni during the second half of the month.

6.6.18.j.s: agnīṣomāv imam̐ su me \\ ity agnīṣomīyā \\ ubhā vām indrāgnī ity aindrāgnī tayoḥ /
6.6.18.j.d: अग्नीषोमाव् इमम्̐ सु मे \\ इत्य् अग्नीषोमीया \\ उभा वाम् इन्द्राग्नी इत्य् ऐन्द्राग्नी तयोः ।
6.6.18.j.m: "O Agni-and-Soma, this [hymn] well for me..." is the verse to Agni-and-Soma; "Both of you, Indra and Agni..." is the verse to Indra-and-Agni.

6.6.18.k.m: After these two, he attends with the first four verses of the Vihavya [hymn].

6.6.18.l.s: tāsām upariṣṭāt \\ agna āyūm̐ṣi pavase \\ iti ṣaḍbhir āgnipāvamānībhiḥ /
6.6.18.l.d: तासाम् उपरिष्टात् \\ अग्न आयूम्̐षि पवसे \\ इति षड्भिर् आग्निपावमानीभिः ।
6.6.18.l.m: Above these, [he attends] with the six purifying verses to Agni beginning: "O Agni, you purify our life-spans..."

6.6.18.m.s: saṃvatsare gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate \\ āyurdā agne 'si \\ āyur me dehi \\ iti caturbhir āhavanīyaṃ citrāvaso svasti te pāram aśīya \\ iti dvir āvartayati \\ asau svasti te 'stu \\ asau svasti te 'stu \\ iti sarveṣāṃ putrāṇāṃ nāmāni gṛhṇāti dvirdvir ekaikasya /
6.6.18.m.d: संवत्सरे गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते \\ आयुर्दा अग्ने ऽसि \\ आयुर् मे देहि \\ इति चतुर्भिर् आहवनीयं चित्रावसो स्वस्ति ते पारम् अशीय \\ इति द्विर् आवर्तयति \\ असौ स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु \\ असौ स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु \\ इति सर्वेषां पुत्राणां नामानि गृह्णाति द्विर्द्विर् एकैकस्य ।
6.6.18.m.m: In a year, he attends upon the gārhapatya fire; he attends upon the āhavanīya fire with the four [mantras] beginning: "Giver of life-span are you, O Agni; / give life-span to me"; he repeats twice: "O Citrāvasu, may I safely reach your farther shore"; he utters the names of all his sons, twice for each one: "May there be safety for you, N.N.! / May there be safety for you, N.N.!"

6.6.18.n.s: agneḥ samid asi \\ abhiśastyā mā pāhi \ somasya samid asi \ parasyā ma ehi \ yamasya samid asi \ mṛtyor mā pāhi \\ ity etais tisraḥ samidha ādadhyāt \\ indhānās tvā śatam̐ himās \\ iti caturthīm /
6.6.18.n.d: अग्नेः समिद् असि \\ अभिशस्त्या मा पाहि \ सोमस्य समिद् असि \ परस्या म एहि \ यमस्य समिद् असि \ मृत्योर् मा पाहि \\ इत्य् एतैस् तिस्रः समिध आदध्यात् \\ इन्धानास् त्वा शतम्̐ हिमास् \\ इति चतुर्थीम् ।
6.6.18.n.m: He should put on three firewood sticks with these [mantras]: "You are Agni's kindling stick; / protect me from accusation. / You are Soma's kindling stick; / come to me from the beyond. / You are Yama's kindling stick; / protect me from death"; [and] the fourth with: "Kindling you for a hundred winters..."

6.6.18.o.s: vayam̐ soma vrate tava \ manas tanūṣu bibhrataḥ / \ prajāvanto aśīmahi \\ iti mukhaṃ vimṛṣṭe saṃ tvam agne sūryasya varcasāgathās \\ iti ca /
6.6.18.o.d: वयम्̐ सोम व्रते तव \ मनस् तनूषु बिभ्रतः । \ प्रजावन्तो अशीमहि \\ इति मुखं विमृष्टे सं त्वम् अग्ने सूर्यस्य वर्चसागथास् \\ इति च ।
6.6.18.o.m: With: "O Soma, in your ritual observance / may we, bearing mind in our bodies / and having offspring, attain [wealth]," and with: "You have united, O Agni, with the splendor of the sun," he wipes his face.

6.6.19.b.s: ambha sthāmbo vo bhakṣīya \\ iti paśūn
6.6.19.b.d: अम्भ स्थाम्बो वो भक्षीय \\ इति पशून्
6.6.19.b.m: With: "You are waters, may I partake of your water," [he attends upon] the cattle.

6.6.19.c.s: revatī ramadhvam ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati
6.6.19.c.d: रेवती रमध्वम् इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति
6.6.19.c.m: With: "O wealthy ones, take delight here," standing between the two fires, he mutters.

6.6.19.d.s: sam̐hitāsi viśvarūpīs \\ iti gām ālabhate vatsaṃ vā \\
6.6.19.d.d: सम्̐हितासि विश्वरूपीस् \\ इति गाम् आलभते वत्सं वा \\
6.6.19.d.m: With: "You are united, having all forms," he touches a cow or a calf.

6.6.19.e.s: upa tvāgne divedive \\ iti ṣaḍbhir gāyatrībhir dvipadābhir gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate \\
6.6.19.e.d: उप त्वाग्ने दिवेदिवे \\ इति षड्भिर् गायत्रीभिर् द्विपदाभिर् गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते \\
6.6.19.e.m: With the six two-line gāyatrī verses beginning: "To you, O Agni, day by day..." he attends upon the gārhapatya fire.

6.6.19.f.s: ūrjā vaḥ paśyāmi \\ ūrjā mā paśyata \\ iti goṣṭhaṃ
6.6.19.f.d: ऊर्जा वः पश्यामि \\ ऊर्जा मा पश्यत \\ इति गोष्ठं
6.6.19.f.m: With: "With vigor I look upon you; / look upon me with vigor," [he attends upon] the cow-pen.

6.6.19.g.s: bhuvanam asi sahasrapoṣaṃpuṣi \ sahasrapoṣasyeśiṣe \ tasyās te bhūyiṣṭhabhājo bhūyāsma \\ iti punar eva gām ālabhate vatsaṃ vā
6.6.19.g.d: भुवनम् असि सहस्रपोषंपुषि \ सहस्रपोषस्येशिषे \ तस्यास् ते भूयिष्ठभाजो भूयास्म \\ इति पुनर् एव गाम् आलभते वत्सं वा
6.6.19.g.m: With: "You are the world, thriving with thousandfold nourishment; / you rule over thousandfold nourishment; / may we share most abundantly in that [nourishment] of yours," he again touches the cow or the calf.

6.6.19.h.s: mahi trīṇām avo 'stu \ dyukṣaṃ mitrasyāryamṇaḥ / \ durādharṣaṃ varuṇasya / \ nahi teṣām amā cana \ nādhvasu vāraṇeṣu / \ īśe ripur aghaśam̐saḥ / \ te ha putrāso aditeḥ \ śarma yacchantv ajasram / \ pra dāśuṣe vāryāṇi \\ iti māhitreṇa tṛcenopatiṣṭhate tat savitur vareṇyam iti sāvitryā somānam̐ svaraṇam ity eṣā somānam̐ svaraṇaṃ kṛṇuhi brahmaṇaspate / \ kakṣīvantaṃ ya auśijaḥ / \ yo revān yo amīvahā \ vasuvit puṣṭivardhanaḥ / \ sa naḥ siṣaktu yas turaḥ / \ mā naḥ śam̐so araruṣas \\ dhūrtiḥ praṇaṅ martyasya / \ rakṣā ṇo brahmaṇaspate \\ iti brāhmaṇaspatyābhir upatiṣṭhate kadācana starīr asi \ kadācana prayucchasi \\ iti dve pari tvāgne puraṃ vayam ity eṣā pari te dūḍhabho rathas \\ asmām̐ aśnotu viśvataḥ / \ yena rakṣasi dāśuṣas \\ iti paryāvartyāntata upatiṣṭhate /
6.6.19.h.d: महि त्रीणाम् अवो ऽस्तु \ द्युक्षं मित्रस्यार्यम्णः । \ दुराधर्षं वरुणस्य । \ नहि तेषाम् अमा चन \ नाध्वसु वारणेषु । \ ईशे रिपुर् अघशम्̐सः । \ ते ह पुत्रासो अदितेः \ शर्म यच्छन्त्व् अजस्रम् । \ प्र दाशुषे वार्याणि \\ इति माहित्रेण तृचेनोपतिष्ठते तत् सवितुर् वरेण्यम् इति सावित्र्या सोमानम्̐ स्वरणम् इत्य् एषा सोमानम्̐ स्वरणं कृणुहि ब्रह्मणस्पते । \ कक्षीवन्तं य औशिजः । \ यो रेवान् यो अमीवहा \ वसुवित् पुष्टिवर्धनः । \ स नः सिषक्तु यस् तुरः । \ मा नः शम्̐सो अररुषस् \\ धूर्तिः प्रणङ् मर्त्यस्य । \ रक्षा णो ब्रह्मणस्पते \\ इति ब्राह्मणस्पत्याभिर् उपतिष्ठते कदाचन स्तरीर् असि \ कदाचन प्रयुच्छसि \\ इति द्वे परि त्वाग्ने पुरं वयम् इत्य् एषा परि ते दूढभो रथस् \\ अस्माम्̐ अश्नोतु विश्वतः । \ येन रक्षसि दाशुषस् \\ इति पर्यावर्त्यान्तत उपतिष्ठते ।
6.6.19.h.m: He attends with the triplet to the Great Ones: "May the great help of the three / be heavenly, of Mitra and of Aryaman, / difficult to overpower, of Varuṇa. / / For not at home, nor / on the paths among hostile forces, / does the evil-speaking enemy hold power over them. / / May those sons of Aditi / grant unceasing protection / and desirable goods to the worshipper"; with the Sāvitrī verse: "That excellent [splendor] of Savitṛ..."; with the verses to Brahmaṇaspati: "Making Soma resound..."—that is: "Make Soma resound, O Brahmaṇaspati, / Kakṣīvat who is the son of Uśij. / / He who is wealthy, who slays disease, / who finds wealth and increases prosperity, / may he, who is swift, attach himself to us. / / Let not the curse of the ungenerous, / the deceit of a mortal, reach [us]; / protect us, O Brahmaṇaspati!"; with the two verses: "Never are you barren; / never do you neglect"; with the verse: "Around you, O Agni, a stronghold, we..."—that is: "May your difficult-to-injure chariot / reach around us from all sides, / with which you protect the worshippers"—having turned around, he attends [upon the fire] at the end.

6.6.19.i.s: dūḍhabhavatīm uttamām eke samāmananti nimṛdo 'si \ ny ahaṃ taṃ mṛdhāsaṃ yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas \\ iti purastāt prapadenāvagṛhṇīyād yadi śreyasā spardheta prabhūr asi \ prāhaṃ tam abhi bhūyāsaṃ yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas \\ iti dakṣiṇataḥ pado 'vagṛhṇīyād yadi sadṛśena spardheta \\ abhibhūr asi \\ abhy ahaṃ tam abhibhūyāsaṃ yo 'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmas \\ iti paścāt pārṣṇyāvagṛhṇīyād yadi pāyīyasā spardheta //
6.6.19.i.d: दूढभवतीम् उत्तमाम् एके समामनन्ति निमृदो ऽसि \ न्य् अहं तं मृधासं यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस् \\ इति पुरस्तात् प्रपदेनावगृह्णीयाद् यदि श्रेयसा स्पर्धेत प्रभूर् असि \ प्राहं तम् अभि भूयासं यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस् \\ इति दक्षिणतः पदो ऽवगृह्णीयाद् यदि सदृशेन स्पर्धेत \\ अभिभूर् असि \\ अभ्य् अहं तम् अभिभूयासं यो ऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि यं च वयं द्विष्मस् \\ इति पश्चात् पार्ष्ण्यावगृह्णीयाद् यदि पायीयसा स्पर्धेत ॥
6.6.19.i.m: Some teach the verse containing 'dūḍhabha' as the last. With: "You are the trampler; down may I trample him who hates us and whom we hate," he should press down with the front of his foot in front, if he is vying with a superior; with: "You are the powerful one; forth may I overcome him who hates us and whom we hate," he should press down with the foot on the right side, if he is vying with an equal; with: "You are the overcomer; fully may I overcome him who hates us and whom we hate," he should press down with the heel behind, if he is vying with an inferior.

6.6.20.a.s: pūṣā mā paśupāḥ pātu \ pūṣā mā pathipāḥ pātu \ pūṣā mādhipāḥ pātu \ pūṣā mādhipatiḥ pātu \\ iti japitvā
6.6.20.a.d: पूषा मा पशुपाः पातु \ पूषा मा पथिपाः पातु \ पूषा माधिपाः पातु \ पूषा माधिपतिः पातु \\ इति जपित्वा
6.6.20.a.m: Having muttered: "May Pūṣan, guardian of cattle, protect me; / may Pūṣan, guardian of paths, protect me; / may Pūṣan, sovereign ruler, protect me; / may Pūṣan, supreme lord, protect me..."

6.6.20.b.s: prācī dik \\ agnir devatā \ yo maitasyai diśo bhidāsād agnim̐ sa ṛcchatu \\ agnir me tasyai diśo gopāyatu
6.6.20.b.d: प्राची दिक् \\ अग्निर् देवता \ यो मैतस्यै दिशो भिदासाद् अग्निम्̐ स ऋच्छतु \\ अग्निर् मे तस्यै दिशो गोपायतु
6.6.20.b.m: "The eastern quarter; Agni is the deity. Whoever schemes against me from this quarter, let him encounter Agni; let Agni protect me from that quarter."

6.6.20.c.s: dakṣiṇā dik \\ indro devatā \ yo maitasyai diśo bhidāsād indram̐ sa ṛcchatu \\ indro me tasyai diśo gopāyatu
6.6.20.c.d: दक्षिणा दिक् \\ इन्द्रो देवता \ यो मैतस्यै दिशो भिदासाद् इन्द्रम्̐ स ऋच्छतु \\ इन्द्रो मे तस्यै दिशो गोपायतु
6.6.20.c.m: "The southern quarter; Indra is the deity. Whoever schemes against me from this quarter, let him encounter Indra; let Indra protect me from that quarter."

6.6.20.d.s: pratīcī dik \\ maruto devatā \ yo maitasyai diśo bhidāsān marutaḥ sa ṛcchatu \ maruto me tasyai diśo gopāyantu
6.6.20.d.d: प्रतीची दिक् \\ मरुतो देवता \ यो मैतस्यै दिशो भिदासान् मरुतः स ऋच्छतु \ मरुतो मे तस्यै दिशो गोपायन्तु
6.6.20.d.m: "The western quarter; the Maruts are the deities. Whoever schemes against me from this quarter, let him encounter the Maruts; let the Maruts protect me from that quarter."

6.6.20.e.s: udīcī dik \\ mitrāvaruṇau devatā \ yo maitasyai diśo bhidāsān mitrāvaruṇau sa ṛcchatu \ mitrāvaruṇau me tasyai diśo gopāyetām /
6.6.20.e.d: उदीची दिक् \\ मित्रावरुणौ देवता \ यो मैतस्यै दिशो भिदासान् मित्रावरुणौ स ऋच्छतु \ मित्रावरुणौ मे तस्यै दिशो गोपायेताम् ।
6.6.20.e.m: "The northern quarter; Mitra and Varuṇa are the deities. Whoever schemes against me from this quarter, let him encounter Mitra and Varuṇa; let Mitra and Varuṇa protect me from that quarter."

6.6.20.f.s: ūrdhvā dik \\ bṛhaspatir devatā \ yo maitasyai diśo bhidāsād bṛhaspatim̐ sa ṛcchatu \ bṛhaspatir me tasyai diśo gopāyatu /
6.6.20.f.d: ऊर्ध्वा दिक् \\ बृहस्पतिर् देवता \ यो मैतस्यै दिशो भिदासाद् बृहस्पतिम्̐ स ऋच्छतु \ बृहस्पतिर् मे तस्यै दिशो गोपायतु ।
6.6.20.f.m: "The upward quarter; Bṛhaspati is the deity. Whoever schemes against me from this quarter, let him encounter Bṛhaspati; let Bṛhaspati protect me from that quarter."

6.6.20.g.s: iyaṃ dik \\ aditir devatā \ yo maitasyai diśo bhidāsād aditim̐ sa ṛcchatu \\ aditir me tasyai diśo gopāyatu \\ iti diśa upasthāya
6.6.20.g.d: इयं दिक् \\ अदितिर् देवता \ यो मैतस्यै दिशो भिदासाद् अदितिम्̐ स ऋच्छतु \\ अदितिर् मे तस्यै दिशो गोपायतु \\ इति दिश उपस्थाय
6.6.20.g.m: "This [downward] quarter; Aditi is the deity. Whoever schemes against me from this quarter, let him encounter Aditi; let Aditi protect me from that quarter." Having thus paid reverence to the quarters,

6.6.20.h.s: dharmo mā dharmiṇaḥ pātu \ vidharmo mā vidharmiṇaḥ pātu \\ āyuś ca prāyuś ca cakṣuś ca vicakṣuś ca prāṇaś cāpānaś ca prāñ cāvāñ ca \\ uruga urugas \\ arkasya te vayaṃ vācā \ saṃ bhaktena gamemahi \\ acchinno daivyas tantur mā manuṣyaś chedi \ divyād dhāmno mā chitsi \ mām āyuṣā \ jyotiṣe tantave tvā \\ asāv anu mā jyotiṣā tanu \\ ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati \\ agna āyūm̐ṣi \\ agne pavasva \\ ity āgnipāvamānībhyāṃ gārhapatyam upatiṣṭhate \\ agne gṛhapate \\ iti ca tām āśiṣam āśāse tantave jyotiṣmatīm ity ajātaputro brūyāt tām āśiṣam āśāse 'muṣmai jyotiṣmatīm iti jātaputro bahuputraḥ sarveṣāṃ putrāṇāṃ nāmāny anudrutya jyotiṣmatīm ity antato vadati sāyam̐sāyam upatiṣṭhate //
6.6.20.h.d: धर्मो मा धर्मिणः पातु \ विधर्मो मा विधर्मिणः पातु \\ आयुश् च प्रायुश् च चक्षुश् च विचक्षुश् च प्राणश् चापानश् च प्राञ् चावाञ् च \\ उरुग उरुगस् \\ अर्कस्य ते वयं वाचा \ सं भक्तेन गमेमहि \\ अच्छिन्नो दैव्यस् तन्तुर् मा मनुष्यश् छेदि \ दिव्याद् धाम्नो मा छित्सि \ माम् आयुषा \ ज्योतिषे तन्तवे त्वा \\ असाव् अनु मा ज्योतिषा तनु \\ इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति \\ अग्न आयूम्̐षि \\ अग्ने पवस्व \\ इत्य् आग्निपावमानीभ्यां गार्हपत्यम् उपतिष्ठते \\ अग्ने गृहपते \\ इति च ताम् आशिषम् आशासे तन्तवे ज्योतिष्मतीम् इत्य् अजातपुत्रो ब्रूयात् ताम् आशिषम् आशासे ऽमुष्मै ज्योतिष्मतीम् इति जातपुत्रो बहुपुत्रः सर्वेषां पुत्राणां नामान्य् अनुद्रुत्य ज्योतिष्मतीम् इत्य् अन्ततो वदति सायम्̐सायम् उपतिष्ठते ॥
6.6.20.h.m: Standing between the fires, he mutters: "May order protect me from the righteous; may disorder protect me from the unrighteous. Life and extended life, sight and insight, out-breath and in-breath, directed forward and directed backward. Wide-goer, wide-goer! May we unite with your voice, O Arka, through the portion. Unbroken is the divine thread; let not the human [thread] be cut. Let me not be severed from the divine realm, nor I from life. For the light, for the thread, to you! O such-and-such [fire], extend me along with light!" With the two Agni-Pāvamāna verses, "O Agni, lives…" and "O Agni, purify…", he attends upon the gārhapatya fire. And with: "O Agni, lord of the house…" If he has no son born, he should say: "I pray for that blessing, full of light for the thread." If he has a son born, he should say: "I pray for that blessing, full of light for so-and-so." If he has many sons, he recites the names of all his sons and at the end says: "…full of light." He attends upon [them] every evening.

6.6.21.b.s: bhūr bhuvaḥ suvar \\ suprajāḥ prajayā bhūyāsam̐ suvīro vīraiḥ suvarcā varcasā supoṣaḥ poṣais \\ iti vā kāmam aindro vittāt \\ iti vā śraddhā me mā vyagāt \\ iti vā bhartuṃ vaḥ śakeyam iti vā /
6.6.21.b.d: भूर् भुवः सुवर् \\ सुप्रजाः प्रजया भूयासम्̐ सुवीरो वीरैः सुवर्चा वर्चसा सुपोषः पोषैस् \\ इति वा कामम् ऐन्द्रो वित्तात् \\ इति वा श्रद्धा मे मा व्यगात् \\ इति वा भर्तुं वः शकेयम् इति वा ।
6.6.21.b.m: Or [he mutters] at will: "Bhūr, bhuvas, suvar! May I be rich in offspring through offspring, rich in heroes through heroes, rich in splendour through splendour, rich in nourishment through nourishments"; or "May Indra know of it"; or "May my faith not depart"; or "May I be able to support you."

6.6.21.d.m: He should attend upon [the fires] in the morning after morning ablutions.

6.6.21.e.m: There, when [the milk] is placed on the fire or being poured out,

6.6.21.f.m: having attended with the first four [verses] of the Vihavya hymn,

6.6.21.g.s: apāṃ pate \\ iti trīn udakāñjalīn ninayati pratiṣiktā arātayas \\ iti triḥ pariṣiñcati kālāya vāṃ jaitriyāya vām iti pāṇī prakṣālayate \\ idam ahaṃ duradmanyāṃ niḥplāvayāmi \\ ity apa ācamya niṣṭhīvati bhrātṛvyāṇām̐ sapatnānām iti punar eva pāṇī prakṣālayate \\ indriyavatīm adyāhaṃ vācam udyāsam iti yathārūpaṃ prāṇāyatanāni saṃmṛjyottareṇānuvākenopatiṣṭhate tatrārvāgvasoḥ svasti te pāram aśīya \\ iti trir āvartayati \\ asau svasti te 'stu \\ asau svasti te 'stu \\ iti sarveṣāṃ putrāṇāṃ nāmāni gṛhṇāti trir ekaikasya purastād agnīṣomīyād vihavyasyottarābhiś catasṛbhir upasthāyānuvākaśeṣeṇopatiṣṭhate //
6.6.21.g.d: अपां पते \\ इति त्रीन् उदकाञ्जलीन् निनयति प्रतिषिक्ता अरातयस् \\ इति त्रिः परिषिञ्चति कालाय वां जैत्रियाय वाम् इति पाणी प्रक्षालयते \\ इदम् अहं दुरद्मन्यां निःप्लावयामि \\ इत्य् अप आचम्य निष्ठीवति भ्रातृव्याणाम्̐ सपत्नानाम् इति पुनर् एव पाणी प्रक्षालयते \\ इन्द्रियवतीम् अद्याहं वाचम् उद्यासम् इति यथारूपं प्राणायतनानि संमृज्योत्तरेणानुवाकेनोपतिष्ठते तत्रार्वाग्वसोः स्वस्ति ते पारम् अशीय \\ इति त्रिर् आवर्तयति \\ असौ स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु \\ असौ स्वस्ति ते ऽस्तु \\ इति सर्वेषां पुत्राणां नामानि गृह्णाति त्रिर् एकैकस्य पुरस्ताद् अग्नीषोमीयाद् विहव्यस्योत्तराभिश् चतसृभिर् उपस्थायानुवाकशेषेणोपतिष्ठते ॥
6.6.21.g.m: with "O lord of the waters…", he pours out three hollowed handfuls of water; with "The foes are sprinkled down…", he sprinkles around thrice; with "To time, to victory, to the two of you!", he washes both hands; with "Here I rinse away bad food…", having sipped water, he spits; with "…of the rivals, of the enemies", he washes both hands again; with "May I speak speech endowed with power today…", having wiped the seats of the vital breaths according to their form, he attends with the subsequent anuvāka; there, with "O Arvāgvasu, may I safely reach your far shore!", he repeats thrice; with "O so-and-so, may there be well-being to you! O so-and-so, may there be well-being to you!", he takes the names of all his sons, thrice for each, before the Agni-Soma [verse]; having attended with the last four [verses] of the Vihavya hymn, he attends with the remainder of the anuvāka.

6.6.21.h.s: tasmāt purā prātaragnihotre nopāvarohed ity ekeṣām /
6.6.21.h.d: तस्मात् पुरा प्रातरग्निहोत्रे नोपावरोहेद् इत्य् एकेषाम् ।
6.6.21.h.m: According to some teachers, he should not descend [from the domestic platform] before the morning Agnihotra.

6.6.21.i.s: agnes tṛṇāny apacinoti tejasvī brahmavarcasī bhavatīti vijñāyate //
6.6.21.i.d: अग्नेस् तृणान्य् अपचिनोति तेजस्वी ब्रह्मवर्चसी भवतीति विज्ञायते ॥
6.6.21.i.m: "He who removes the grass from Agni becomes radiant and endowed with spiritual lustre," so it is known [from sacred tradition].

6.7.22.a.m: We shall explain leaving home on a journey without one's household.

6.7.22.b.s: agnīn samādhehi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati pravatsyan bhāsvata upatiṣṭhate mama nāma prathamaṃ jātavedas \\ iti catasṛbhir āhavanīyaṃ paśūn me śam̐sya pāhi \ tān me gopāyāsmākaṃ punar āgamāt \\ ity āhavanīyam upasthāyābhiprāṇya \\ agne sahasrākṣa \\ ity upatiṣṭhate prajāṃ me narya pāhi \ tāṃ me gopāyāsmākaṃ punar āgamāt \\ iti gārhapatyam upasthāyābhiprāṇya \\ agne gṛhapate \\ ity upatiṣṭhate \\ annaṃ me budhnya pāhi \ tan me gopāyāsmākaṃ punar āgamāt \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim upasthāyābhiprāṇya \\ agne vahne \\ ity upasthāya virājakramair upatiṣṭhate yathā purastāt \\ imān me mitrāvaruṇā \ gṛhān gopāyataṃ yuvam / \ avinaṣṭān avihṛtān \ pūṣainān abhirakṣatu \\ asmākaṃ punar āgamāt \\ ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati mā pragāma patho vayam \\ mā yajñād indra sominaḥ / \ māṃtasthur no arātayaḥ / \ ud asmām̐ uttarān naya \\ agne ghṛtenāhuta / \ rāyaspoṣeṇa sam̐sṛja \ prajayā ca bahūn kṛdhi \\ iti prakrāmati sakāśe 'gnīnāṃ vācaṃ yacchaty asakāśe visṛjate vratakāleṣu vrataṃ carati /
6.7.22.b.d: अग्नीन् समाधेहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति प्रवत्स्यन् भास्वत उपतिष्ठते मम नाम प्रथमं जातवेदस् \\ इति चतसृभिर् आहवनीयं पशून् मे शम्̐स्य पाहि \ तान् मे गोपायास्माकं पुनर् आगमात् \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपस्थायाभिप्राण्य \\ अग्ने सहस्राक्ष \\ इत्य् उपतिष्ठते प्रजां मे नर्य पाहि \ तां मे गोपायास्माकं पुनर् आगमात् \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् उपस्थायाभिप्राण्य \\ अग्ने गृहपते \\ इत्य् उपतिष्ठते \\ अन्नं मे बुध्न्य पाहि \ तन् मे गोपायास्माकं पुनर् आगमात् \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् उपस्थायाभिप्राण्य \\ अग्ने वह्ने \\ इत्य् उपस्थाय विराजक्रमैर् उपतिष्ठते यथा पुरस्तात् \\ इमान् मे मित्रावरुणा \ गृहान् गोपायतं युवम् । \ अविनष्टान् अविहृतान् \ पूषैनान् अभिरक्षतु \\ अस्माकं पुनर् आगमात् \\ इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति मा प्रगाम पथो वयम् \\ मा यज्ञाद् इन्द्र सोमिनः । \ मांतस्थुर् नो अरातयः । \ उद् अस्माम्̐ उत्तरान् नय \\ अग्ने घृतेनाहुत । \ रायस्पोषेण सम्̐सृज \ प्रजया च बहून् कृधि \\ इति प्रक्रामति सकाशे ऽग्नीनां वाचं यच्छत्य् असकाशे विसृजते व्रतकालेषु व्रतं चरति ।
6.7.22.b.m: He gives the ritual direction: "Place the fires [upon the hearths]!" About to go on a journey, he attends upon the blazing ones. With the four [verses beginning]: "My first name, O Jātavedas…", [he attends upon] the āhavanīya fire; having attended upon the āhavanīya fire with: "Protect my cattle, O praiseworthy one; guard them for me until our return!", and having breathed upon it, he attends with: "O Agni of a thousand eyes…"; having attended upon the gārhapatya fire with: "Protect my offspring, O friend of men; guard it for me until our return!", and having breathed upon it, he attends with: "O Agni, lord of the house…"; having attended upon the dakṣiṇāgni fire with: "Protect my food, O Budhnya; guard it for me until our return!", and having breathed upon it, having attended with: "O Agni, bearer [of oblations]…", he attends with the Virāj steps as previously. Standing between the fires, he mutters: "Protect these houses of mine, O Mitra and Varuṇa, both of you! / Undestroyed, undisturbing, / let Pūṣan protect them / until our return!" With: "May we not wander away from the path, / nor from the sacrifice, O Indra, we who offer soma! / May foes not bar our way! / Lead us upward to higher things, / O Agni, offered with clarified butter! / Unite [us] with increase of wealth, / and make [us] many with offspring!", he sets forth. In the presence of the fires, he restrains speech; out of their presence, he releases [it]; at the times of ritual observance, he performs the ritual observance.

6.7.22.c.m: He attends [upon the fires] in every season.

6.7.22.d.m: If a journey occurs without having attended upon the fires,

6.7.22.e.s: ihaiva san tatra sato vo agnayaḥ \ prāṇena vācā manasā bibharmi / \ tiro mā santam āyur mā prahāsīt \\ jyotiṣā vo vaiśvānareṇopatiṣṭhe \\ ity upatiṣṭhate /
6.7.22.e.d: इहैव सन् तत्र सतो वो अग्नयः \ प्राणेन वाचा मनसा बिभर्मि । \ तिरो मा सन्तम् आयुर् मा प्रहासीत् \\ ज्योतिषा वो वैश्वानरेणोपतिष्ठे \\ इत्य् उपतिष्ठते ।
6.7.22.e.m: he attends with: "Being here, I maintain you who are there, O fires, / with breath, with speech, and with mind; / may life not abandon me who am away; / with Vaiśvānara's light do I attend upon you!"

6.7.22.g.s: samidho dhārayan viśvadānīm ābharantas \\ anātureṇa manasā / \ agne mā te prativeśā riṣāma \\ iti vihāram abhyetya sakāśe 'gnīnāṃ vācaṃ yacchati sakāśe visṛjate \\ agnīn samādhehi \\ iti saṃpreṣyati //
6.7.22.g.d: समिधो धारयन् विश्वदानीम् आभरन्तस् \\ अनातुरेण मनसा । \ अग्ने मा ते प्रतिवेशा रिषाम \\ इति विहारम् अभ्येत्य सकाशे ऽग्नीनां वाचं यच्छति सकाशे विसृजते \\ अग्नीन् समाधेहि \\ इति संप्रेष्यति ॥
6.7.22.g.m: holding pieces of firewood, [saying]: "Bringing ever continually / with untroubled mind, / O Agni, may we, your neighbours, not suffer harm!", he approaches the sacrificial area; in the presence of the fires, he restrains speech; in their presence, he releases [it]; he gives the ritual direction: "Place the fires [upon the hearths]!"

6.7.23.a.s: jvalata upatiṣṭhate namas te astu mīḍhuṣe \ namas ta upasadvane / \ agne śumbhasva tanvā \ saṃ mā rayyā sam̐sṛja \\ ity upasamindhe \\ agneḥ samid asi \\ abhiśastyā mā pāhi \\ ity etais tribhis tisraḥ samidha ādadhyāt \\ indhānās tvā śatam̐ himās \\ iti caturthīṃ mano jyotir juṣatām ity adhvaryur āhutiṃ juhoti yadi daśamīm atipravasati mama nāma tava ca jātavedas \\ iti catasṛbhir āhavanīyaṃ paśūn me śam̐syājugupas \ tān me punar dehi \\ ity āhavanīyam upasthāyābhyapānya \\ agne sahasrākṣa \\ ity upātiṣṭhate prajāṃ me naryājugupas \ tāṃ me punar dehi \\ iti gārhapatyam upasthāyābhyapānya \\ agne gṛhapate \\ ity upatiṣṭhate \\ annaṃ me budhnājugupas \ tan me punar dehi \\ iti dakṣiṇāgnim upasthāyābhyapānya \\ agne vahne \\ ity upasthāya virājakramair upatiṣṭhate yathā purastāt \\ imān me mitrāvaruṇā \ gṛhān ajugupataṃ yuvam / \ avinaṣṭān avihṛtān \ pūṣainān abhyarākṣīt \\ āsmākaṃ punar āgamāt \\ ity antarāgnī tiṣṭhañ japati gopāyājugupas \\ iti sarvatrānuṣajati gopāya \\ iti vā /
6.7.23.a.d: ज्वलत उपतिष्ठते नमस् ते अस्तु मीढुषे \ नमस् त उपसद्वने । \ अग्ने शुम्भस्व तन्वा \ सं मा रय्या सम्̐सृज \\ इत्य् उपसमिन्धे \\ अग्नेः समिद् असि \\ अभिशस्त्या मा पाहि \\ इत्य् एतैस् त्रिभिस् तिस्रः समिध आदध्यात् \\ इन्धानास् त्वा शतम्̐ हिमास् \\ इति चतुर्थीं मनो ज्योतिर् जुषताम् इत्य् अध्वर्युर् आहुतिं जुहोति यदि दशमीम् अतिप्रवसति मम नाम तव च जातवेदस् \\ इति चतसृभिर् आहवनीयं पशून् मे शम्̐स्याजुगुपस् \ तान् मे पुनर् देहि \\ इत्य् आहवनीयम् उपस्थायाभ्यपान्य \\ अग्ने सहस्राक्ष \\ इत्य् उपातिष्ठते प्रजां मे नर्याजुगुपस् \ तां मे पुनर् देहि \\ इति गार्हपत्यम् उपस्थायाभ्यपान्य \\ अग्ने गृहपते \\ इत्य् उपतिष्ठते \\ अन्नं मे बुध्नाजुगुपस् \ तन् मे पुनर् देहि \\ इति दक्षिणाग्निम् उपस्थायाभ्यपान्य \\ अग्ने वह्ने \\ इत्य् उपस्थाय विराजक्रमैर् उपतिष्ठते यथा पुरस्तात् \\ इमान् मे मित्रावरुणा \ गृहान् अजुगुपतं युवम् । \ अविनष्टान् अविहृतान् \ पूषैनान् अभ्यराक्षीत् \\ आस्माकं पुनर् आगमात् \\ इत्य् अन्तराग्नी तिष्ठञ् जपति गोपायाजुगुपस् \\ इति सर्वत्रानुषजति गोपाय \\ इति वा ।
6.7.23.a.m: He reverences [the fires] when they are burning: 'Homage to you, the bountiful; homage to you, the one to be approached. O Agni, shine with your body; unite me with wealth!' With this he kindles [them]. With these three [mantras]: 'You are Agni's kindling stick', 'Protect me from imprecation', he places three kindling sticks. With: 'Kindling you for a hundred winters', [he places] the fourth. 'May the light accept the mind', with this the adhvaryu offers an oblation if he stays away beyond the tenth [day]. With the four [verses]: 'My name and yours, O Jātavedas', [he reverences] the āhavanīya fire. Having reverenced the āhavanīya fire with: 'O praise-worthy one, you protected my cattle; give them back to me', having exhaled, he reverences it with: 'O Agni of a thousand eyes'. Having reverenced the gārhapatya fire with: 'O protector of men, you protected my offspring; give them back to me', having exhaled, he reverences it with: 'O Agni, lord of the house'. Having reverenced the dakṣiṇāgni fire with: 'O deep one, you protected my food; give it back to me', having exhaled, and having reverenced it with: 'O Agni, conveyor [of oblations]', he reverences [the fires] with the Virāj-steps as previously. Standing between the fires he mutters: 'These houses of mine, O Mitra and Varuṇa, / you two have protected, / undamaged, undisturbed; / Pūṣan has guarded them / until our return.' He subjoins everywhere: 'Protect [them] as you have protected [them]'; or [simply]: 'Protect [them]!'

6.7.23.b.s: athaikeṣāṃ vijñāyate kaḥ śreyām̐saṃ viṣuptaṃ bodhayiṣyatīty aprāduṣkṛtānām evopasthānam̐ syāt \\ abhayaṃkarābhayaṃ me kuru \ svasti me 'stu pravatsyāmi \\ iti pravatsyan \\ abhayaṃkarābhayaṃ me 'kārṣīḥ \ svasti me 'stu prāvātsyam iti proṣya //
6.7.23.b.d: अथैकेषां विज्ञायते कः श्रेयाम्̐सं विषुप्तं बोधयिष्यतीत्य् अप्रादुष्कृतानाम् एवोपस्थानम्̐ स्यात् \\ अभयंकराभयं मे कुरु \ स्वस्ति मे ऽस्तु प्रवत्स्यामि \\ इति प्रवत्स्यन् \\ अभयंकराभयं मे ऽकार्षीः \ स्वस्ति मे ऽस्तु प्रावात्स्यम् इति प्रोष्य ॥
6.7.23.b.m: Now the view of some is known: 'Who would awaken an eminent person who is asleep?' Therefore there should be reverencing of them even when not manifested [in flame]. With: 'O maker of fearlessness, make me fearless; may welfare be mine; I shall go on a journey', [he says] when about to go on a journey. With: 'O maker of fearlessness, you have made me fearless; may welfare be mine; I have returned from the journey', [he says] after having returned from the journey.

6.7.24.a.s: gṛhā mā bibhīta mā vepīḍhvam \ ūrjam bibhrata emasi / \ ūrjaṃ bibhrad vasuvaniḥ sumedhās \ gṛhān emi manasā modamānaḥ / \ yeṣām abhyeti pravasan \ yeṣu saumanaso babhuḥ / \ gṛhān upahvayāmahe \ te no jānantu jānataḥ / \ upahūtā iha gāvas \\ upahūtā ajāvayaḥ / \ atho annasya kīlālas \\ upahūto gṛheṣu naḥ / \ upahūtā bhūrisakhāḥ \ sakhāyaḥ svādusaṃmudaḥ / \ ariṣṭāḥ sarvapūruṣās \\ gṛhā naḥ santu sarvadā / \ ūrjasvantaḥ payasvantas \\ irāvanto hasāmudraḥ / \ anaśyā atṛṣyās \\ gṛhā māsmad bibhītana \\ iti grāhān abhyeti kṣemāya vaḥ śāntyai prapadye śivam̐ śagmam̐ śaṃyoḥ śaṃyos \\ iti praviśati na tad ahar āgataḥ kalahaṃ karoti gṛhānaham̐ sumanasaḥ prapadye \ vīraghno vīratamaḥ suśevān / \ irāṃ vahantaḥ sumanasyamānās \ teṣv aham̐ sumanāḥ saṃviśāmi \\ iti saṃviśati viśvā uta tvayā vayam \\ dhārā udanyā iva / \ atigāhemahi dviṣas \\ iti bhāryām̐ samīkṣate //
6.7.24.a.d: गृहा मा बिभीत मा वेपीढ्वम् \ ऊर्जम् बिभ्रत एमसि । \ ऊर्जं बिभ्रद् वसुवनिः सुमेधास् \ गृहान् एमि मनसा मोदमानः । \ येषाम् अभ्येति प्रवसन् \ येषु सौमनसो बभुः । \ गृहान् उपह्वयामहे \ ते नो जानन्तु जानतः । \ उपहूता इह गावस् \\ उपहूता अजावयः । \ अथो अन्नस्य कीलालस् \\ उपहूतो गृहेषु नः । \ उपहूता भूरिसखाः \ सखायः स्वादुसंमुदः । \ अरिष्टाः सर्वपूरुषास् \\ गृहा नः सन्तु सर्वदा । \ ऊर्जस्वन्तः पयस्वन्तस् \\ इरावन्तो हसामुद्रः । \ अनश्या अतृष्यास् \\ गृहा मास्मद् बिभीतन \\ इति ग्राहान् अभ्येति क्षेमाय वः शान्त्यै प्रपद्ये शिवम्̐ शग्मम्̐ शंयोः शंयोस् \\ इति प्रविशति न तद् अहर् आगतः कलहं करोति गृहानहम्̐ सुमनसः प्रपद्ये \ वीरघ्नो वीरतमः सुशेवान् । \ इरां वहन्तः सुमनस्यमानास् \ तेष्व् अहम्̐ सुमनाः संविशामि \\ इति संविशति विश्वा उत त्वया वयम् \\ धारा उदन्या इव । \ अतिगाहेमहि द्विषस् \\ इति भार्याम्̐ समीक्षते ॥
6.7.24.a.m: With: 'O houses, fear not, tremble not; / bearing strength we come. / Bearing strength, winning wealth, wise, / I go to the houses rejoicing in mind. / Those which he approaches when returning from a journey, / in which they became well-disposed, / we summon those houses; / may they, knowing us, know us. / Summoned here are the cattle; / summoned are goats and sheep; / and the sweet drink of food / is summoned to our houses. / Summoned are the many friends, / friends of sweet rejoicing; / may our houses always be / unharmed, with all their men. / Possessing strength, possessing milk, / possessing refreshments, rich in laughter, / never perishing, never thirsting, / O houses, do not fear us', he approaches the houses. With: 'For your security, for [your] pacification, I enter; auspicious, soothing, blessing, blessings', he enters. Returned on that day, he does not quarrel. With: 'I enter the houses well-disposed, / not slaying men, most manly, most kindly; / carrying food, well-disposed, / in them, well-disposed, I lie down', he lies down. With: 'And through you may we / cross over all our enemies / like torrents of water', he looks at his wife.

6.8.25.a.s: āgrayaṇeṣṭau vatsaṃ prathamajaṃ dadāti nānātantre śyāmāke vabhruṃ piṅgalam madhuparkaṃ madhumanthaṃ dadhimanthaṃ kṣīraudanasya vā pātraṃ kṣaumaṃ vāso varṣādhṛtaṃ bhadrān naḥ śreyaḥ samanaiṣṭa devās \\ iti vrīhīṇāṃ prāśnāti \\ agniḥ prathamaḥ prāśnātu \ sa hi veda yathā haviḥ / \ śivā asmabhyam oṣadhīḥ \ kṛṇotu viśvacarṣaṇis \\ iti śyāmākānām etamu tyaṃ madhunā saṃyutaṃ yavam \\ sarasvatyā adhi manāv acarkṛṣuḥ / \ indra āsīt sīrapatiḥ śatakratuḥ \ kīnāśā āsan marutaḥ sudānavas \\ iti yavānām /
6.8.25.a.d: आग्रयणेष्टौ वत्सं प्रथमजं ददाति नानातन्त्रे श्यामाके वभ्रुं पिङ्गलम् मधुपर्कं मधुमन्थं दधिमन्थं क्षीरौदनस्य वा पात्रं क्षौमं वासो वर्षाधृतं भद्रान् नः श्रेयः समनैष्ट देवास् \\ इति व्रीहीणां प्राश्नाति \\ अग्निः प्रथमः प्राश्नातु \ स हि वेद यथा हविः । \ शिवा अस्मभ्यम् ओषधीः \ कृणोतु विश्वचर्षणिस् \\ इति श्यामाकानाम् एतमु त्यं मधुना संयुतं यवम् \\ सरस्वत्या अधि मनाव् अचर्कृषुः । \ इन्द्र आसीत् सीरपतिः शतक्रतुः \ कीनाशा आसन् मरुतः सुदानवस् \\ इति यवानाम् ।
6.8.25.a.m: At the Āgrayaṇa sacrifice he gives a first-born calf. In the independent performance with wild millet, [he gives] a reddish-brown, yellowish [ox], a honey mixture, a stirred drink with honey, a stirred drink with curd, or a vessel of rice cooked in milk, or a linen garment worn during the rains. With: 'From good to better have the gods led us', he partakes of the rice grains. With: 'Let Agni partake first, / for he knows how the oblation is; / may he, who attends to all people, / make the plants auspicious for us', [he partakes] of the wild millet. With: 'That barley mixed with honey, / which they plowed on the Sarasvatī for Manu; / Indra of a hundred rites was the lord of the plow, / the Maruts, bountiful givers, were the plowmen', [he partakes] of the barley grains.

6.8.25.b.m: He accompanies the eleven fore-offerings in the animal sacrifice with mantras according to their modification.

6.8.25.c.s: caturaś caturbhir āditaś caturthasyānumantraṇena duraḥprabhṛtīm̐ś catura uttamenetarān /
6.8.25.c.d: चतुरश् चतुर्भिर् आदितश् चतुर्थस्यानुमन्त्रणेन दुरःप्रभृतीम्̐श् चतुर उत्तमेनेतरान् ।
6.8.25.c.m: [He accompanies] the four from the beginning with four [mantras]; the four beginning with the doors with the accompaniment-mantra of the fourth; the others with the last.

6.8.25.d.s: svarvid asi \ svar vittvā svar ihi \ svar mahyam \\ svaḥ paśubhyas \\ lokavid asi \ lokaṃ vittvā lokam ihi \ lokaṃ mahyam \ lokaṃ paśubhyas \\ gātuvid asi \ gātuṃ vittvā gātum ihi \ gātuṃ mahyam \\ gātuṃ paśubhyas \ nāthavid asi \ nāthaṃ vittvā nātham ihi \ nāthaṃ mahyam \\ nāthaṃ paśubhyas \ na vā uv etan mriyase \\ āśānāṃ tvā \ viśvā āśās \\ iti paśau saṃjñapyamāne japati hutāyāṃ vapāyāṃ paraṃ dadāti tisro vā dakṣiṇā nayet /
6.8.25.d.d: स्वर्विद् असि \ स्वर् वित्त्वा स्वर् इहि \ स्वर् मह्यम् \\ स्वः पशुभ्यस् \\ लोकविद् असि \ लोकं वित्त्वा लोकम् इहि \ लोकं मह्यम् \ लोकं पशुभ्यस् \\ गातुविद् असि \ गातुं वित्त्वा गातुम् इहि \ गातुं मह्यम् \\ गातुं पशुभ्यस् \ नाथविद् असि \ नाथं वित्त्वा नाथम् इहि \ नाथं मह्यम् \\ नाथं पशुभ्यस् \ न वा उव् एतन् म्रियसे \\ आशानां त्वा \ विश्वा आशास् \\ इति पशौ संज्ञप्यमाने जपति हुतायां वपायां परं ददाति तिस्रो वा दक्षिणा नयेत् ।
6.8.25.d.m: With: 'You are the finder of heaven; having found heaven, go to heaven; heaven for me, heaven for the cattle; you are the finder of space; having found space, go to space; space for me, space for the cattle; you are the finder of a way; having found a way, go on the way; a way for me, a way for the cattle; you are the finder of refuge; having found refuge, go to refuge; refuge for me, refuge for the cattle; nor indeed do you die now; I [direct] you to the quarters; to all the quarters', he mutters while the animal is being quieted. When the omentum is offered, he gives another [gift], or he should bring three sacrificial gifts.

6.8.25.e.s: yathāvikāraṃ paśāv ekādaśānūyājān anumantrayate trīm̐strīn ekaikena prathamena daśamam uttamenottamam /
6.8.25.e.d: यथाविकारं पशाव् एकादशानूयाजान् अनुमन्त्रयते त्रीम्̐स्त्रीन् एकैकेन प्रथमेन दशमम् उत्तमेनोत्तमम् ।
6.8.25.e.m: He accompanies the eleven after-offerings in the animal sacrifice with mantras according to their modification: three each with each single one; the tenth with the first; the last with the last.

6.8.25.f.s: śṛṅgāṇīvec chṛṅgiṇām̐ saṃdadṛśrire \ caṣālavantaḥ svaravaḥ pṛthivyām / \ te devāsaḥ svaravas tasthivām̐sas \\ namaḥ sakhibhyaḥ sannān māvagāta \\ iti //
6.8.25.f.d: शृङ्गाणीवेच् छृङ्गिणाम्̐ संददृश्रिरे \ चषालवन्तः स्वरवः पृथिव्याम् । \ ते देवासः स्वरवस् तस्थिवाम्̐सस् \\ नमः सखिभ्यः सन्नान् मावगात \\ इति ॥
6.8.25.f.m: With: 'Like horns of horned [beasts] they have appeared, / the chips [of the sacrificial post] possessing the top-ring on the earth; / those divine chips, standing firm, / homage to [our] friends; do not depart from me!'

6.8.26.a.s: hutam̐ svarum upatiṣṭhate \\ āśāsānaḥ suvīryam iti sam̐sthite yūpam /
6.8.26.a.d: हुतम्̐ स्वरुम् उपतिष्ठते \\ आशासानः सुवीर्यम् इति सम्̐स्थिते यूपम् ।
6.8.26.a.m: He reverences the offered chip of the sacrificial post; when [the rite] is completed, [he reverences] the sacrificial post with: 'Praying for good heroic power'.

6.8.26.b.s: cāturmāsyeṣv anaḍvāham anaḍuho vā hiraṇyaṃ vaiśvānare dadāti dhenuṃ pārjanye yathāvikāraṃ nava prayājān anumantrayate caturaś caturbhir āditaś caturthasyānumantraṇena duraḥprabhṛtīm̐ś catura uttamenottamaṃ vatsaṃ prathamajaṃ vaiśvadeve dadāti yathāvikāraṃ navānūyājān anumantrayate trīm̐strīn ekaikena /
6.8.26.b.d: चातुर्मास्येष्व् अनड्वाहम् अनडुहो वा हिरण्यं वैश्वानरे ददाति धेनुं पार्जन्ये यथाविकारं नव प्रयाजान् अनुमन्त्रयते चतुरश् चतुर्भिर् आदितश् चतुर्थस्यानुमन्त्रणेन दुरःप्रभृतीम्̐श् चतुर उत्तमेनोत्तमं वत्सं प्रथमजं वैश्वदेवे ददाति यथाविकारं नवानूयाजान् अनुमन्त्रयते त्रीम्̐स्त्रीन् एकैकेन ।
6.8.26.b.m: In the seasonal sacrifices, he gives a draft-ox or gold to the value of a draft-ox at the Vaiśvānara [rite]; a milch-cow at the Pārjanya [rite]. He accompanies the nine fore-offerings with mantras according to their modification: the four from the beginning with four; the four beginning with the doors with the accompaniment-mantra of the fourth; the last with the last. He gives a first-born calf at the Vaiśvadeva rite. He accompanies the nine after-offerings with mantras according to their modification: three each with each single one.

6.8.26.c.s: tad ṛtam \\ tat satyam \\ tad vratam \\ tac chakeyam \\ tena śakeyam \\ tena rādhyāsam iti sarvatra keśeṣūpyamāneṣu japati caturo māsān nānṛtaṃ vadati na mām̐sam aśnāti na striyam upaiti noparyāste jugupsetānṛtāt prāṅ śete na madhv aśnāti nāñjīta nābhyañjītartau jāyām upeyāt sarveṣāṃ cāturmāsyānām etāny antarālavratāni bhavanti dhenuṃ varuṇapraghāseṣu dadāty ṛṣabhaṃ pravayasam̐ sākamedheṣu yasya ravate juhoti tam eva paurṇādarvye 'śvam̐ śvetam āditye gāṃ vā śvetam̐ ṣaḍgavaṃ dvādaśagavaṃ vā sīram uṣṭārau voṣṭāraṃ vānyataram̐ śunāsīrīye 'śvam̐ śvetam̐ saurye gāṃ vā śvetaṃ tadabhāve 'gauḥ śvetaḥ syāc chvetaḥ syāt //
6.8.26.c.d: तद् ऋतम् \\ तत् सत्यम् \\ तद् व्रतम् \\ तच् छकेयम् \\ तेन शकेयम् \\ तेन राध्यासम् इति सर्वत्र केशेषूप्यमानेषु जपति चतुरो मासान् नानृतं वदति न माम्̐सम् अश्नाति न स्त्रियम् उपैति नोपर्यास्ते जुगुप्सेतानृतात् प्राङ् शेते न मध्व् अश्नाति नाञ्जीत नाभ्यञ्जीतर्तौ जायाम् उपेयात् सर्वेषां चातुर्मास्यानाम् एतान्य् अन्तरालव्रतानि भवन्ति धेनुं वरुणप्रघासेषु ददात्य् ऋषभं प्रवयसम्̐ साकमेधेषु यस्य रवते जुहोति तम् एव पौर्णादर्व्ये ऽश्वम्̐ श्वेतम् आदित्ये गां वा श्वेतम्̐ षड्गवं द्वादशगवं वा सीरम् उष्टारौ वोष्टारं वान्यतरम्̐ शुनासीरीये ऽश्वम्̐ श्वेतम्̐ सौर्ये गां वा श्वेतं तदभावे ऽगौः श्वेतः स्याच् छ्वेतः स्यात् ॥
6.8.26.c.m: 'That is cosmic order, that is truth, that is the ritual observance; may I be capable of that; by that may I be capable; by that may I succeed'—with this he mutters everywhere while his hair is being shaved. For four months he does not speak untruth, he does not eat meat, he does not approach a woman, he does not sit on a raised seat, he should shrink from untruth, he sleeps facing east, he does not eat honey, he should not apply eye-salve, he should not anoint himself; he may approach his wife in her fertile period. These are the interim observances of all the seasonal sacrifices. He gives a milch-cow at the Varuṇapraghāsa rites; an aged bull at the Sākamedha rites; at the Paurṇādarvya [rite], he gives precisely that [animal] whose braying he makes an offering [over]; a white horse or a white ox at the Āditya [rite]; a plow with six oxen or twelve oxen, or two draft-camels or either one draft-camel at the Śunāsīrīya rite; a white horse or a white ox at the Saurya [rite]; in the absence of that, it may be a white non-cow [animal], it may be white.

7.1.1.d.m: With it he should sacrifice spring after spring.

7.1.1.e.m: There is no bringing of it when the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices have not been commenced.

7.1.1.g.m: Some teach the Atirātra as the first sacrifice.

7.1.1.h.s: amāvāsyāyāṃ yajanīye 'hani dīkṣate paurṇamāsyāṃ yajanīye 'hani sutyam ahaḥ /
7.1.1.h.d: अमावास्यायां यजनीये ऽहनि दीक्षते पौर्णमास्यां यजनीये ऽहनि सुत्यम् अहः ।
7.1.1.h.m: He undergoes consecration on the day for sacrifice on the New Moon; the pressing day is on the day for sacrifice on the Full Moon.

7.1.1.i.m: [Or] on the New Moon or on the Full Moon.

7.1.1.j.s: yadi tv ekā dīkṣā dve tisraś catasro 'parimitā vā tatrāparvaṇi sutyam ahar dīkṣā vā /
7.1.1.j.d: यदि त्व् एका दीक्षा द्वे तिस्रश् चतस्रो ऽपरिमिता वा तत्रापर्वणि सुत्यम् अहर् दीक्षा वा ।
7.1.1.j.m: If, however, there is one consecration, or two, three, four, or an unlimited number, then the pressing day or the consecration falls on a non-parvan day.

7.1.1.k.s: mahan me 'vocas \\ yaśo me 'vocas \\ bhargo me 'vocas \\ bhuktiṃ me 'vocaḥ \ stomaṃ me 'vocaḥ \ sarvaṃ me 'vocas \ tan māvatu \ tan mā viśatu \ tena bhukṣiṣīya \\ iti vṛtovṛto japati /
7.1.1.k.d: महन् मे ऽवोचस् \\ यशो मे ऽवोचस् \\ भर्गो मे ऽवोचस् \\ भुक्तिं मे ऽवोचः \ स्तोमं मे ऽवोचः \ सर्वं मे ऽवोचस् \ तन् मावतु \ तन् मा विशतु \ तेन भुक्षिषीय \\ इति वृतोवृतो जपति ।
7.1.1.k.m: Each time he is chosen, he mutters: "Greatness have you spoken to me; renown have you spoken to me; brilliance have you spoken to me; enjoyment have you spoken to me; praise have you spoken to me; everything have you spoken to me. Let that protect me; let that enter me; may I enjoy through that!"

7.1.1.l.s: devo devam etu somaḥ somam etv ṛtasya pathā \ vihāya dauṣkṛtyam ity abhipravrajati /
7.1.1.l.d: देवो देवम् एतु सोमः सोमम् एत्व् ऋतस्य पथा \ विहाय दौष्कृत्यम् इत्य् अभिप्रव्रजति ।
7.1.1.l.m: With: "Let god go to god, let soma go to soma along the path of truth, / having abandoned wrongdoing", he walks forth toward [the hall].

7.1.1.m.s: padvā nāmāsi srutiḥ somasaraṇī somaṃ gameyam iti panthānam ātiṣṭhate /
7.1.1.m.d: पद्वा नामासि स्रुतिः सोमसरणी सोमं गमेयम् इति पन्थानम् आतिष्ठते ।
7.1.1.m.m: With the formula, “A path named Padvā art thou, leading to soma; may I go to soma,” he steps upon the path.

7.1.1.n.s: pitaro bhūs \\ iti triḥ pitṝn abhimantrayate /
7.1.1.n.d: पितरो भूस् \\ इति त्रिः पितॄन् अभिमन्त्रयते ।
7.1.1.n.m: Three times he addresses the fathers with the formula, “Fathers, earth!”

7.1.1.o.s: dīkṣiṣyamāṇasya \\ agnir yajurbhis \\ iti dvādaśa saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi juhoti /
7.1.1.o.d: दीक्षिष्यमाणस्य \\ अग्निर् यजुर्भिस् \\ इति द्वादश संभारयजूम्̐षि जुहोति ।
7.1.1.o.m: For him who is about to be consecrated, he offers the twelve saṃbhārayajus offerings with the formula, “Agni with the Yajuses…”

7.1.1.p.s: saptahotāraṃ manasānudrutya sagraham̐ hutvā dīkṣaṇīyām iṣṭiṃ nirvapati /
7.1.1.p.d: सप्तहोतारं मनसानुद्रुत्य सग्रहम्̐ हुत्वा दीक्षणीयाम् इष्टिं निर्वपति ।
7.1.1.p.m: Having mentally recited the saptahotṛ formula and offered it with the graha, he pours out the oblation for the consecratory offering.

7.1.1.q.m: [It is] dedicated to Agni and Viṣṇu on eleven potsherds, or a caru cooked in clarified butter dedicated to Agni and Viṣṇu.

7.1.1.s.s: na yajamānabhāgam avadyati sarveṣu saumikeṣv iṣṭipaśubandheṣu /
7.1.1.s.d: न यजमानभागम् अवद्यति सर्वेषु सौमिकेष्व् इष्टिपशुबन्धेषु ।
7.1.1.s.m: He does not cut off the portion for the sacrificer in all offerings and animal sacrifices belonging to a soma sacrifice.

7.1.1.u.m: He leaves a residue in the dhruvā ladle.

7.1.1.v.m: The consecratory offering concludes with the patnīsaṃyāja offerings; having consumed the clarified butter iḍā, they cease.

7.1.1.x.m: They construct the enclosed hut with its beams pointing eastward.

7.1.1.y.m: Enclosing it, they make openings at the corners,

7.1.1.z.m: and a fifth facing the north-eastern intermediate direction.

7.1.1.ab.m: There are optional designs with a single door:

7.1.1.ac.s: prāgdvāram̐ svargakāmasya dakṣiṇādvaraṃ pitṛlokakāmasya pratyagdvāraṃ manuṣyalokakāmasyodagdvāraṃ prajākāmasyottarataḥpurastād yaḥ kāmayetobhayorlokayor ṛdhnuyām iti /
7.1.1.ac.d: प्राग्द्वारम्̐ स्वर्गकामस्य दक्षिणाद्वरं पितृलोककामस्य प्रत्यग्द्वारं मनुष्यलोककामस्योदग्द्वारं प्रजाकामस्योत्तरतःपुरस्ताद् यः कामयेतोभयोर्लोकयोर् ऋध्नुयाम् इति ।
7.1.1.ac.m: with an eastern door for one desiring heaven; with a southern door for one desiring the world of the fathers; with a western door for one desiring the world of men; with a northern door for one desiring offspring; to the north-east for one who desires, “May I prosper in both worlds”;

7.1.1.ad.s: sarvatodvāraṃ yaḥ kāmayeta sarvāsu dikṣv ṛdhunyām iti /
7.1.1.ad.d: सर्वतोद्वारं यः कामयेत सर्वासु दिक्ष्व् ऋधुन्याम् इति ।
7.1.1.ad.m: with doors on all sides for one who desires, “May I prosper in all directions.”

7.1.1.ae.m: And they make portico-like structures corresponding to them in the directions.

7.1.1.af.s: uttareṇa prāgvam̐śaṃ pariśrite yajamānasya keśaśmaśrūṇi vāpayate /
7.1.1.af.d: उत्तरेण प्राग्वम्̐शं परिश्रिते यजमानस्य केशश्मश्रूणि वापयते ।
7.1.1.af.m: To the north of the eastern hall, in an enclosed space, he causes the hair and beard of the sacrificer to be shaved.

7.1.1.ag.d: श्मश्रूण्य् अग्रे वापयते ऽथोपपक्षाव् अथ केशान् ।
7.1.1.ag.m: He causes the beard to be shaved first, then the armpits, then the hair of the head.

7.1.1.ah.s: āpa undantu jīvase \\ iti dakṣiṇaṃ godānam unatti /
7.1.1.ah.d: आप उन्दन्तु जीवसे \\ इति दक्षिणं गोदानम् उनत्ति ।
7.1.1.ah.m: With the formula, “May the waters moisten thee for life,” he moistens the right side of the head above the ear.

7.1.1.ai.s: oṣadhe trāyasvainam ity ūrdhvāgrām oṣadhim antardadhāti /
7.1.1.ai.d: ओषधे त्रायस्वैनम् इत्य् ऊर्ध्वाग्राम् ओषधिम् अन्तर्दधाति ।
7.1.1.ai.m: With the formula, “O plant, protect him,” he inserts a blade of grass pointing upward.

7.1.1.aj.m: With the formula, “O razor, do not harm him,” he applies the razor.

7.1.1.ak.m: With the formula, “Serving the gods, I shave these,” he shaves [it].

7.1.2.a.s: abhyantaraṃ nakhāni nikṛntate hastyān agre 'tha padyāni savyasyāgre kaniṣṭhikāto 'tha dakṣiṇasya /
7.1.2.a.d: अभ्यन्तरं नखानि निकृन्तते हस्त्यान् अग्रे ऽथ पद्यानि सव्यस्याग्रे कनिष्ठिकातो ऽथ दक्षिणस्य ।
7.1.2.a.m: He pares the nails inward: the fingernails first, then the toenails; first of the left [hand or foot], beginning from the little finger, then of the right.

7.1.2.b.s: sa yadāktākṣo bhavaty athainam ekavim̐śatyā darbhapuñjīlais tredhā vibhaktais triḥ saptabhiḥsaptabhiḥ pāvayati citpatis tvā punātu \\ ity etair mantrair dvir ūrdhvaṃ nābher unmārṣṭi sakṛd avāṅ avamārṣṭy acchidreṇa pavitreṇeti sarvatrānuṣajati /
7.1.2.b.d: स यदाक्ताक्षो भवत्य् अथैनम् एकविम्̐शत्या दर्भपुञ्जीलैस् त्रेधा विभक्तैस् त्रिः सप्तभिःसप्तभिः पावयति चित्पतिस् त्वा पुनातु \\ इत्य् एतैर् मन्त्रैर् द्विर् ऊर्ध्वं नाभेर् उन्मार्ष्टि सकृद् अवाङ् अवमार्ष्ट्य् अच्छिद्रेण पवित्रेणेति सर्वत्रानुषजति ।
7.1.2.b.m: When his eyes have been anointed, he purifies him with twenty-one tufts of darbha grass divided into three parts, three times with seven each; with the mantras, “May the lord of thought purify thee…,” he rubs upward twice above the navel, and rubs downward once, appending throughout the words, “with an uninjured strainer.”

7.1.2.c.s: taṃ prāgvam̐śaṃ prapādyātra dīkṣṇīyām eke samāmananti /
7.1.2.c.d: तं प्राग्वम्̐शं प्रपाद्यात्र दीक्ष्णीयाम् एके समामनन्ति ।
7.1.2.c.m: Some teach that having led him into the eastern hall, they perform the consecratory offering at this point.

7.1.2.d.s: dhruvāśeṣāt \\ ākūtyai prayuje 'ganaye svāhā \\ iti sruveṇa catasro dīkṣāhutīr juhoti /
7.1.2.d.d: ध्रुवाशेषात् \\ आकूत्यै प्रयुजे ऽगनये स्वाहा \\ इति स्रुवेण चतस्रो दीक्षाहुतीर् जुहोति ।
7.1.2.d.m: From the residue in the dhruvā ladle, he offers four consecration libations with the spoon, with the formula, “To impulse, to the instigator, to Agni, svāhā!”

7.1.2.e.m: With the ladle, a fifth with the formula, “The waters, divine…”

7.1.2.f.s: viśve devasya netur iti ṣaṣṭhīṃ dvādaśagṛhītena srucaṃ pūrayitvā bilāvakāśāṃ vā kṛtvottamasruve 'bhipūrayatyupottame vā /
7.1.2.f.d: विश्वे देवस्य नेतुर् इति षष्ठीं द्वादशगृहीतेन स्रुचं पूरयित्वा बिलावकाशां वा कृत्वोत्तमस्रुवे ऽभिपूरयत्युपोत्तमे वा ।
7.1.2.f.m: Having filled the ladle with twelve portions, or having made a cavity in the opening, he fills it with the last spoonful, or with the penultimate one, [and offers] the sixth with the formula, “Of the divine leader, all [men]…”

7.1.2.g.s: kṛṣṇājinasya dakṣiṇaṃ pūrvapādam antar mām̐saṃ pariṣīvyati /
7.1.2.g.d: कृष्णाजिनस्य दक्षिणं पूर्वपादम् अन्तर् माम्̐सं परिषीव्यति ।
7.1.2.g.m: He stitches the right forefoot of the black antelope skin with the flesh-side inside.

7.1.2.h.m: Or he joins two [skins] turned away from each other, with their flesh-sides touching.

7.1.2.i.s: indra śākvara gāyatrīṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmi \\ indra śākvara triṣṭubhaṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmi \\ indra śākvara jagatīṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmi \\ indra śākvarānuṣṭubhaṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmi \\ indra śākvara paṅktiṃ prapadye tāṃ te yunajmi \\ ity antarvedi kṛṣṇājinaṃ prācīnagrīvam uttaralomāstṛṇāti /
7.1.2.i.d: इन्द्र शाक्वर गायत्रीं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मि \\ इन्द्र शाक्वर त्रिष्टुभं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मि \\ इन्द्र शाक्वर जगतीं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मि \\ इन्द्र शाक्वरानुष्टुभं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मि \\ इन्द्र शाक्वर पङ्क्तिं प्रपद्ये तां ते युनज्मि \\ इत्य् अन्तर्वेदि कृष्णाजिनं प्राचीनग्रीवम् उत्तरलोमास्तृणाति ।
7.1.2.i.m: With the formulas, “O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the gāyatrī, that do I harness for thee; O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the triṣṭubh, that do I harness for thee; O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the jagatī, that do I harness for thee; O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the anuṣṭubh, that do I harness for thee; O mighty Indra, I take refuge in the paṅkti, that do I harness for thee,” he spreads the black antelope skin inside the altar with its neck to the east and its hairy side facing upward.

7.1.2.j.s: tadārūḍhe yajamāne patnyāḥ śirasi jālaṃ pratimuñcati /
7.1.2.j.d: तदारूढे यजमाने पत्न्याः शिरसि जालं प्रतिमुञ्चति ।
7.1.2.j.m: When the sacrificer has mounted it, he places a net upon the wife's head.

7.1.2.k.m: He consecrates her with an unwashed linen garment worn as an upper garment.

7.1.2.l.m: A triple-plaited girdle of śara-reed or muñja-grass should be made.

7.1.2.m.s: ūrg asi \\ iti tayā yajamānaṃ nābhideśe triḥ pradakṣiṇaṃ parivyayati dvir ity eke pūṣā te granthiṃ prathnātu \\ ity uttarato nābher niṣṭarkyaṃ granthiṃ kṛtvā sa te māsthāt \\ iti dakṣiṇato nābheḥ parikarṣati yaṃ dviṣyāt taṃ dhyāyet /
7.1.2.m.d: ऊर्ग् असि \\ इति तया यजमानं नाभिदेशे त्रिः प्रदक्षिणं परिव्ययति द्विर् इत्य् एके पूषा ते ग्रन्थिं प्रथ्नातु \\ इत्य् उत्तरतो नाभेर् निष्टर्क्यं ग्रन्थिं कृत्वा स ते मास्थात् \\ इति दक्षिणतो नाभेः परिकर्षति यं द्विष्यात् तं ध्यायेत् ।
7.1.2.m.m: With the formula, “Strength art thou,” he girds the sacrificer around the navel three times clockwise—or twice, according to some—; having tied an easily loosened knot to the north of the navel with the formula, “May Pūṣan untie thy knot,” he pulls it around to the south of the navel with the formula, “May it not stay in thee.” He should meditate on whomsoever he hates.

7.1.2.n.s: saṃ tvā nahyāmi \\ iti patnīm̐ saṃnahyati yathā darśapūrṇamāsayoḥ /
7.1.2.n.d: सं त्वा नह्यामि \\ इति पत्नीम्̐ संनह्यति यथा दर्शपूर्णमासयोः ।
7.1.2.n.m: With the formula, “I gird thee,” he girds the wife as in the New- and Full-Moon sacrifices.

7.1.2.o.s: indrasya yonir asi \\ iti trivalaṃ pañcavalaṃ vā kṛṣṇaviṣāṇāṃ yajamānāya prayacchaty ābadhnāti vā /
7.1.2.o.d: इन्द्रस्य योनिर् असि \\ इति त्रिवलं पञ्चवलं वा कृष्णविषाणां यजमानाय प्रयच्छत्य् आबध्नाति वा ।
7.1.2.o.m: With the formula, “The womb of Indra art thou,” he hands a black antelope horn with three or five ridges to the sacrificer, or ties it [to his garment].

7.1.2.p.s: patnyāḥ śirasi jālaṃ yathā suṣṭhu kalpayati //
7.1.2.p.d: पत्न्याः शिरसि जालं यथा सुष्ठु कल्पयति ॥
7.1.2.p.m: He arranges the net properly on the wife's head.

7.1.3.a.s: audumbaro dīkṣitadaṇḍo yo vā kaścana vṛkṣaḥ phalagrahis tasya /
7.1.3.a.d: औदुम्बरो दीक्षितदण्डो यो वा कश्चन वृक्षः फलग्रहिस् तस्य ।
7.1.3.a.m: The staff of the consecrated one is of udumbara wood, or of whichever tree is fruit-bearing.

7.1.3.b.m: It is of a fist's thickness, level with his face or reaching up to his chin.

7.1.3.c.s: ūrdhvasūr asi vānaspatyaḥ \ sudyumno dyumnaṃ yajamānāya dhehi \\ iti taṃ yajamānāya pradāya saṃbhārayajūm̐ṣi vācayati juhoti caitair mantraiḥ /
7.1.3.c.d: ऊर्ध्वसूर् असि वानस्पत्यः \ सुद्युम्नो द्युम्नं यजमानाय धेहि \\ इति तं यजमानाय प्रदाय संभारयजूम्̐षि वाचयति जुहोति चैतैर् मन्त्रैः ।
7.1.3.c.m: Having given it to the sacrificer with the formula, “An upward-shooting tree of the forest art thou; very splendid, bestow splendor upon the sacrificer,” he causes him to recite the saṃbhārayajus mantras, and offers with these mantras.

7.1.3.d.s: taṃ vāgyatam adīkṣiṣṭāyaṃ brāhmaṇas \\ asāv āmuṣyāyaṇo 'muṣya putro 'muṣya pautro 'muṣya naptāmuṣyāḥ putro 'muṣyāḥ pautro 'muṣyā naptā \\ iti trir upām̐śv āvedayati trir uccaiḥ /
7.1.3.d.d: तं वाग्यतम् अदीक्षिष्टायं ब्राह्मणस् \\ असाव् आमुष्यायणो ऽमुष्य पुत्रो ऽमुष्य पौत्रो ऽमुष्य नप्तामुष्याः पुत्रो ऽमुष्याः पौत्रो ऽमुष्या नप्ता \\ इति त्रिर् उपाम्̐श्व् आवेदयति त्रिर् उच्चैः ।
7.1.3.d.m: While he restrains his speech, he announces him three times inaudibly and three times aloud: “This brāhmaṇa has been consecrated, so-and-so, of such-and-such lineage, son of so-and-so, grandson of so-and-so, great-grandson of so-and-so, son of such-and-such a woman, grandson of such-and-such a woman, great-grandson of such-and-such a woman.”

7.1.3.e.s: asau \\ iti nāma gṛhṇāti \\ āmuṣyāyaṇas \\ iti pitur nāmadheyena /
7.1.3.e.d: असौ \\ इति नाम गृह्णाति \\ आमुष्यायणस् \\ इति पितुर् नामधेयेन ।
7.1.3.e.m: At “so-and-so,” he takes his name; at “of such-and-such lineage,” by the name of his father.

7.1.3.f.s: yaḥ kaścid dīkṣate brāhmaṇas \\ ity evāvedayet /
7.1.3.f.d: यः कश्चिद् दीक्षते ब्राह्मणस् \\ इत्य् एवावेदयेत् ।
7.1.3.f.m: Whosoever is consecrated, he should announce only as: “A brāhmaṇa [has been consecrated].”

7.1.3.g.s: devāñ janam agan yakṣas \ tato mā yajñasyāśīr āgacchatu \ gandharvāñ janam agan yajñas \ tato mā yajñasyāśīr āgacchatu \ pitṝñ janam agan yajñas \ tato mā yajñasyāśīr āgacchatu \\ apa oṣadhīr vanaspatīñ janam agan yajñas \ tato mā yajñasyāśīr āgacchatu \ pañcajanāñ janam agan yajñas tato mā yajñasyāśīr āgacchatu \ vardhatāṃ bhūtir dadhnā ghṛten \ muñcatu yajño yajñapatim am̐hasas \\ bhūpataye svāhā \\ ity abhimantrayate yady anyatra kṛṣṇājinād āsīta nityavṛttāv ata ūrdhvam /
7.1.3.g.d: देवाञ् जनम् अगन् यक्षस् \ ततो मा यज्ञस्याशीर् आगच्छतु \ गन्धर्वाञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \ ततो मा यज्ञस्याशीर् आगच्छतु \ पितॄञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \ ततो मा यज्ञस्याशीर् आगच्छतु \\ अप ओषधीर् वनस्पतीञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् \ ततो मा यज्ञस्याशीर् आगच्छतु \ पञ्चजनाञ् जनम् अगन् यज्ञस् ततो मा यज्ञस्याशीर् आगच्छतु \ वर्धतां भूतिर् दध्ना घृतेन् \ मुञ्चतु यज्ञो यज्ञपतिम् अम्̐हसस् \\ भूपतये स्वाहा \\ इत्य् अभिमन्त्रयते यद्य् अन्यत्र कृष्णाजिनाद् आसीत नित्यवृत्ताव् अत ऊर्ध्वम् ।
7.1.3.g.m: If he should sit elsewhere than upon the black antelope skin in the regular course of conduct from this time forward, he addresses it with the formulas: “The sacrifice has gone to the divine folk; from there may the blessing of the sacrifice come to me. The sacrifice has gone to the Gandharvas; from there may the blessing of the sacrifice come to me. The sacrifice has gone to the fathers; from there may the blessing of the sacrifice come to me. The sacrifice has gone to the waters, plants, and trees; from there may the blessing of the sacrifice come to me. The sacrifice has gone to the five classes of men; from there may the blessing of the sacrifice come to me. May prosperity increase with curds and clarified butter; may the sacrifice release the lord of sacrifice from distress; svāhā to the lord of the earth!”

7.1.3.h.s: agnīñ jyotiṣmataḥ kuruta \ dīkṣita \ vācaṃ yaccha \ patni vācaṃ yaccha \\ iti purodayam adhivṛkṣasūrye ca vratapradaḥ saṃpreṣyati /
7.1.3.h.d: अग्नीञ् ज्योतिष्मतः कुरुत \ दीक्षित \ वाचं यच्छ \ पत्नि वाचं यच्छ \\ इति पुरोदयम् अधिवृक्षसूर्ये च व्रतप्रदः संप्रेष्यति ।
7.1.3.h.m: Before sunrise, and when the sun is above the trees, the giver of the fast-food directs: “Make the fires bright! Consecrated one, restrain speech! Wife, restrain speech!”

7.1.3.i.s: udite 'stamite ca vrataṃ dohayati vatsasyaikam̐ stanam avaśeṣya /
7.1.3.i.d: उदिते ऽस्तमिते च व्रतं दोहयति वत्सस्यैकम्̐ स्तनम् अवशेष्य ।
7.1.3.i.m: At sunrise and at sunset, he milks the fast-food, leaving one teat for the calf.

7.1.3.j.s: gārhapatye dīkṣitasya vratam̐ śrapayati patnyā dakṣiṇāgnau /
7.1.3.j.d: गार्हपत्ये दीक्षितस्य व्रतम्̐ श्रपयति पत्न्या दक्षिणाग्नौ ।
7.1.3.j.m: On the gārhapatya fire he cooks the fast-food of the consecrated one, and on the dakṣiṇāgni fire that of the wife.

7.1.3.k.m: Bringing the fast-food across to the west of the āhavanīya fire, he gives it to the consecrated one.

7.1.3.l.s: bhadrād abhi śreyaḥ prehi \\ iti dīkṣitaṃ prayātam anumantrayate /
7.1.3.l.d: भद्राद् अभि श्रेयः प्रेहि \\ इति दीक्षितं प्रयातम् अनुमन्त्रयते ।
7.1.3.l.m: With the formula, “Go forward from good to better,” he accompanies the consecrated one who has set forth.
